reviews.author: Anna-riitta
reviews.positive:
Review of Acanto Loft – 6‑Week Stay
We stayed for six weeks in the Acanto Loft apartment and overall had a pleasant experience. The location is excellent – just a short walk from shops and essential services. The building itself is quiet, as are the neighbours. Some noise from the nearby road could be heard even with the windows closed, but nighttime traffic was minimal and did not disturb our sleep.
For a longer stay, the apartment’s equipment had a few shortcomings. Cleaning, as well as changing of bed linen and towels, was provided every two weeks, but no extra towels or sheets were available. There was a washing machine but no dryer, so laundry dried slowly in the humid climate.
The bedroom had one large bed with a single large duvet for two people. During the first week we struggled with sharing it, but after requesting an additional duvet, we received one quickly.
The apartment lacked some basic cleaning supplies, such as a vacuum cleaner, all‑purpose cleaner, dishwasher tablets, a dish brush, a cleaning cloth, a bathroom squeegee, and microfiber cloths. Toilet paper was replenished during cleaning, but kitchen paper was not. After requesting a vacuum cleaner and cleaning solution, we received them promptly. These missing items are inexpensive, and considering the relatively high rent for a six‑week stay, it would have been reasonable for them to be included from the beginning.
The customer service team was friendly and responded quickly to all our inquiries. Despite the minor shortcomings, we enjoyed our stay — largely thanks to the helpful and welcoming customer service.

reviews.author: Pamela
reviews.title: A lovely apartment in a great location.
reviews.positive:
The apartment was in an excellent location in the heart of Fuchal town and above the main shopping centre which has a huge supermarket where you can get everything that you need for self catering. It is very quiet as it looks out on a side street and there are good views up to the fort from the balcony.
Getting in to the apartment was easy as we were sent a short video showing us what to do. The apartment building is kept very clean and there are lifts. The apartment itself was excellent with a well-equipped kitchen, large lounge with comfortable sofa and a large dining table, a very comfortable bedroom with loads of wardrobe space and a great bathroom with large walk-in shower. There was also a balcony, as mentioned earlier. We had a problem with the toilet seat which seemed to be broken when we arrived, but there was someone out to fix it within an hour of reporting it. I would definitely recommend staying here.
reviews.negative:
I do think that 2 rolls of toilet paper for two people for a week is very mean. It would have only cost pence to provide more. The same goes for dishwasher tablets. If there is a dishwasher it seems only sensible to provide the tablets. I asked about this and they quickly brought me a handful of tablets but said that they didn't normally supply them. Previous occupants had obviously made do with washing up by hand, as I could see from the state of the wine glasses. Both these items cost very little, but make a big difference. 
This apartment wasn't cheap, so please don't be so mean in future.

The kitchen was very well stocked with crockery, cutlery and cooking pots and pans.  However it had no cooking utensils (ie. fish fry, ladle, large spoon etc) at all and once again we had to purchase a fish fry in order to make a cooked breakfast.  This is an issue the owners must address and will only cost pennies.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us. We’re glad you appreciated the cleanliness and spaciousness of the apartment. As part of our self-catering service, we provide an initial set of toilet paper, and additional supplies are typically the responsibility of the guest. We do encourage all our guests to inform us during their stay if any items are missing, such as kitchen utensils, so that we can promptly resolve the issue. We appreciate your feedback and will take it into account to ensure we provide the best experience for future guests.
We would love to welcome you back for another stay, and we hope your next experience with us will be even better!

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

GuestReady Team

GuestReady Team

reviews.comment:
Die Unterkunft entsprach den Bildern und Beschreibungen. Im Großen und Ganzen war alle sauber und ordentlich. Nur im Bett wurden ein paar Haare gefunden. Die Einrichtung ist etwas älter aber reicht für die meisten Zwecke vollkommen aus. Die Ausstattung der Küche war ebenso ausreichend. 
Die Lage war super. Kurze Wege zum Meer und zu Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. 
Die zugehörige Parkgarage ist ein großer Pluspunkt in der kleinen Stadt.
reviews.response:
Vielen Dank, Til, für Ihr detailliertes Feedback. Es freut uns sehr, dass die Unterkunft Ihren Erwartungen entsprochen hat und Sie die nahe Lage zum Meer und den Geschäften genießen konnten. Die Parkgarage ist in der Tat ein großer Vorteil!
Es tut uns leid zu hören, dass Haare im Bett gefunden wurden. Wir werden sicherstellen, dass unser Reinigungsteam einen genaueren Blick darauf wirft, um solche Vorfälle in Zukunft zu vermeiden. Vielen Dank nochmals für Ihre ehrlichen Worte. 
GuestReady Team

Onze pubers konden er dus ook zelf naar toe. Verder zit het handig voor allerlei hikes en activiteiten richting Porto Moniz. Het appartement is klein maar heeft alles en van alles voldoende, dat is ook erg fijn. Zeker als je met 5 of 6 personen bent. De faciliteiten zijn echt goed; vaatwasser, wasmachine, veel servies
reviews.negative: De weg langs het appartement is erg druk. Je gaat daardoor echt niet buiten zitten. Het was dus of binnen of echt weg, dat vonden we wel jammer. Verder moet je er rekening mee houden dat het was vochtig is binnen; schijnt door de berg te komen waar het tegen staat. En we vonden t best wel vol op een paar vierkante meter met 5 personen, ookal is t slim ingericht. De verschillende ruimtes zijn best klein. En weinig plek voor natte handdoeken behalve buiten aan een rek.

We are glad that, overall, you had a positive stay and enjoyed the facilities available at the property.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Katharina
reviews.title: Gemütliches Haus mit Dachterrasse
reviews.positive:
Das Haus ist sauber, gut eingerichtet und die Zimmeraufteilung ist sehr praktisch. Im Erdgeschoss befinden sich neben Küche und großzügigem Aufenthaltsbereich zwei Schlafzimmer mit je einem Doppelbett und ein kleines Badezimmer. Eine schmale Treppe führt nach oben, wo sich ein kleiner Stauraum, ein drittes Schlafzimmer mit Etagenbett und ein großes Badezimmer mit einer sehr guten Dusche befinden. Die Matratzen sind sehr gut, eher fest. Den traumhaften Ausblick aufs Meer und Landschaft bekommt man nur von der langen, schmalen Terrasse, die von außen über eine hohe Metalltreppe zu erreichen ist. Aus dem Haus selbst kann man nicht viel von der Schönheit der Umgebung sehen. 
Zu betonen wäre, dass diese Unterkunft nicht geeignet ist für Menschen mit schlechter körperlicher Kondition, die ohne Auto unterwegs sind: Der 10 - 15-minütige Fußweg vom Strand zum Haus ist anstrengend (je nach Fitness).
reviews.negative: Auf der Terrasse standen zwar genug Stühle, doch fehlte uns ein kleiner Tisch und Sonnenliegen. Das ist nur eine Anregung zur Verbesserung des Wohlbefindens.

Good location away from busy high street but still within walking distance to the old town and San Martinho if you don't mind walking downhill and returning uphill.
reviews.negative: It was easy for us to collect the keys on arrival as we hired a car on arrival to Funchal, so just made that extra stop on our way to the apartment, but I guess it will be much less convenient for somebody without a car. Quite late check-in (at 4pm), considering the check-out is at 11am. Both bedrooms face a busy street with cars driving uphill at full capacity, so this car engine noise may be a bit disturbing at night.
reviews.response:
Dear Tatiana,

Thank you for your detailed review. We’re glad to hear that the apartment’s spacious layout, ocean-facing balcony, and well-equipped kitchen enhanced your stay. It’s great that the en-suite bedrooms, secure parking, and location were ideal for exploring Funchal.

Our self check-in process is designed for flexibility, allowing guests to arrive at their convenience. For those without a car, we also offer a paid transfer service that retrieves the keys and takes you directly to the property for a smoother arrival.

We set check-in and check-out times to ensure thorough cleaning and preparation, though we accommodate early check-ins when possible. While street noise is beyond our control, we hope the apartment’s comfort outweighed this aspect.

We appreciate your feedback and look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.negative: To nie tak, że mi się nie podobało, bo podziemny garaż jest super zaletą na Maderze, ale jest ciasny, więc jeśli chcecie tam zaparkować auto, to wynajmijcie jakieś małe. Miałem nowego Juka i udało mi się go nie poobijać. Sedan nie zmieściłby się bez uszczerbku na lakierze.

reviews.author: Len
reviews.title: We wouldn't touch this property with a barge pole again!
reviews.positive: We have stayed in Funchal for many years at New Year. Obviously we see this place as special and always enjoy our visits, both on cruise ships and land based. To answer the question, this is what we like, however I presume the question relates specifically to this property and to say we were disappointed is an understatement. The only positive aspect for us was the location, although not central it was walkable into the town, albeit at the top of an avenue which is challenging to walk which we knew, as we are regular visitors to Funchal.
reviews.negative:
We would find it difficult to limit our issues in the space provided, from the start of our visit it wasn't a good experience to say the least. I will limit  our issues to the first challenge!
I was only notified days before arrival that the keys were to be collected from a key box remote from the property. I had already booked our taxi by then who wouldn't vary our journey to pick up the keys. We had to engage another taxi, once at the apartment, to pick up the keys - more expense. The local taxi driver, having been given the address written down, couldn't find the location of the Atlantic office.  He eventually found it after driving around and we picked up the keys from the key lock without difficulty. Once back at the apartment they wouldn't open the outside door. We tried several times but each time the door wouldn't open. Each of us tried in turn, several keys, several times, still the door wouldn't open. We had been up since 5am, had a 4 hour flight, taxi from airport and in we are in our 70's. The last thing we need is a failed attempt to access our rented property.
It appeared that we were now stuck outside the property with nowhere to stay. I used the contact telephone number supplied with property details to contact them but a message said that the number was unavailable. At this point the shop worker, next door from the car parts shop, saw us struggling and came to the rescue. He didn't speak any English but it was clear he had seen this same issue before with the lock because he took charge of the keys and put them in the lock . He juggled and positioned the key in and out until eventually he got it to open. He clearly knew that others had had the same issue and knew what the problem was. Either the key needs replacing or the lock because there is some wear which is causing a malfunction. Every time we left the property we had the same challenge to re enter, not knowing if the door would open or not.
reviews.response:
Dear Len.

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We are glad to know that you enjoy visiting Funchal and appreciate the property’s location.
We would like to clarify a few points regarding your check-in. The key collection instructions were sent in advance of your arrival, and we also offer a transfer service to assist guests with this process if needed. Had you experienced any difficulty picking up the keys, we would have been happy to provide guidance or support to make check-in smoother.
Regarding the apartment entrance, it is true that the front door requires a small technique to operate, but all keys work correctly. Additionally, access via the garage is always available, which guests can use.
We would also like to note that we did not receive any messages or calls from your number during your arrival, so we were not aware of any issues at the time and therefore could not assist directly.

We appreciate your feedback as it helps us provide even more clear guidance to future guests, and we are always happy to support guests whenever needed to ensure a smooth arrival and stay.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Wiebke
reviews.title: Es war okay
reviews.positive:
- die 3 Schlafzimmer
- die Größe
- die Lage
- dass es einen Parkplatz gibt
- Fahrstuhl
reviews.negative:
- Laut, da an einer Straße und nicht gut isoliert
- Küche nicht gut ausgestattet 
- Parkplatz nur für geübte Menschen :) 
- Couch ist nicht mehr so couchig 
- Kaffeemaschine nicht für Vieltrinker geeignet
- keine Klima- oder Heizmöglichkeit
- Schlüsselsituation (Abholort woanders, Haustür an Wohnung wahrscheinlich defekt)
reviews.response:
Dear Wiebke.

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We truly appreciate your comments, as they help us continually improve our guests’ experience.

We’re pleased to know that you valued the apartment’s size, the three bedrooms, its location, and the convenience of having both a parking space and an elevator.

At the same time, we regret that certain aspects of your stay did not fully meet your expectations. As the property is centrally located and part of an apartment building, some street noise can unfortunately be expected. The parking space is indeed somewhat tight, but it is suitable for a standard-sized car. Regarding the coffee machine, it is a standard capsule model, with capsules readily available at local supermarkets. We have also taken note of your other comments and will review them carefully, as we always strive to improve.

With regard to the key collection, we are unfortunately unable to install a key box at the property. For this reason, keys must be collected from our office, which is conveniently located on the way to the apartment.

Thank you once again for your valuable feedback.

Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Eleonora

reviews.positive: Замечательные апартаменты,в пешей доступности от центра ,от набережной,квартира чистая,просторная,имеется все необходимое , огромный плюс ставлю за матрасы и подушки)спасибо,за наше комфортное пребывание на Мадейре

reviews.response:
Dear Eleonora.

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly appreciate your kind words.

We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment’s convenient walking-distance location near the city center and waterfront, and that you found the space clean, spacious, and well equipped for a comfortable stay. We are especially happy to know that the quality of the mattresses and pillows made a positive difference to your experience.

Thank you for choosing to stay with us during your time in Madeira. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to welcome you again in the future.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.title: A beautiful, conveniently situated and generously equiped apartment but with a little imperfection
reviews.positive: The apartment is beautiful, conveniently situated in the tourist center of Funchal, within walking distance to the historical center. There are three comfortable bedrooms, two bathrooms, one balcony in the front, one in the back. A large comfortable living room, well equiped kitchen with a fridge, an oven, a hotplate and basic utensils. There is a room with a washing machine and a sink, a clothes horse, everythink one can dream about when travelling and staying somewhere for a longer period. Well equiped first aid kit is available to, I was simply impressed. The fla can be aseily reached by lift. There is also a parking place in the basement, which we didn´t use. There is a buss stop in front of the building with a convenient connection to several attractive tourist destinations on the island like Monte or The Valley of The Nuns. Another bus stop only 30-40 meters away in front of the Savoy Palace hotel with very frequent buses to the center if one doesn´t want to take the 15 minutes´ walk. If I wanted to live in Funchal, the flat would a good choice I think.
reviews.negative: Unfortunately the flat was not cleaned at the time of arrival, there were dirty towels in the bathrooms and dirty bed linen on the beds, the floor wasn´t clean either and there was a bag with rubbish in the kitchen. It was a shock for me though I am used to improvise, but the situation was even worse this time because I travelled with my old mother. I called to the property owners, but nobody answered the phone. I called the support of Booking but they couldn´t reach the owners either. I took photos of status quo and sent them to the owners via WhatsApp and then I received an apology and two cleaning ladies came and cleaned the apartment thoroughly. I got finacial compensation both from the owner and Booking, that gave me credit points for future use.

reviews.author: Anita
reviews.title: Fun in Funchal
reviews.positive: The location is excellent (loud as it's on a busy street), the linens clean, the kitchen quite usable, and any TV channel you could want.  The 2 balconies were great, and we spent more time on the back, quiet, shady one as it was more peaceful. The video instructions they sent covered any potential questions we could have, and it was wonderful to see how to get in and where to park before we arrived.  Took away any guesswork that sometimes comes with an apartment rental.  It was wonderful having a washing machine and a drying rack, as we stayed almost 2 weeks.
reviews.negative:
Well, the saying you get what you pay for is very true in this case. We received an off-season discount, so I should actually rate this apartment FOUR stars, except the sewer smell in the afternoons prevents that. Every day, we would come back in the early afternoon to the smell of sewer in the apartment. 

One weird thing is that the second shower is almost unuseable. It is a 24" square shower with the door opening inward. Unless you are a tiny adult or a small child, getting in and out is impossible without pressing your back against the corner walls. Yuck.  But there is another larger shower to use, so it was fine.  

We would still happily rent this apartment in the future!

reviews.negative: Be aware that the hot tub cleaning only happens on Monday, the nearby road was loud since the cars are going uphill and some kitchen supplies were not the best at times

reviews.negative: Las almohadas

reviews.author: Maxim
reviews.title: Podría haber sido un 8
reviews.positive: En general, podría haber sido un lugar excepcional para pasar las vacaciones y con una valoración sobre las 8/10, pero con una gestión así de indebida, nos resultó en una experiencia relativamente decepcionante, aunque ello no perjudicó nuestras vacaciones, ya que la isla Madeira es preciosa, y la ubicación sí está muy bien, hay playas de arena y zonas de hiking muy cerca, aeropuerto a unos 15 minutos y Funchal a unos 30. Por supuesto, es muy recomendable ir en coche, a pie casi todo queda lejos. Jacuzzi está bien, pero tiene sus problemas.
reviews.negative:
Dos cosas que nos parecieron inadecuadas:
1. En la casa hay dos pisos - para dos diferentes reservas, pero en el Booking cuando reservas, las fotos están mezcladas entre sí, y antes no ponía qué es lo que reservas (ahora al parecer sí). Arriba hay una cama doble y dos camas individuales, abajo - una doble, una individual y una sofá para 4ª persona. Pues para nosotros nos pareció mal no saber que la 4ª persona dormirá en un sofá, sin ningún preaviso de esta circunstancia, lo que llevó a conflictos dentro del grupo y afectó a la buena convivencia.
2. Esta parte es relativa al piso de abajo, no puedo decir nada en cuanto a la primera planta. La gestión de la propiedad está simplemente mal. Aparecen unas 3-5 cucarachas cada mañana, menos mal que los espacios están tratados contra los insectos, y por lo menos no se mueven y aparecen muertos, pero asco dan. Por la zona viven unos gatos sin dueño, que invaden las zonas de la propiedad y orinan por el jardín (lo que da lugar a mal olor al salir de la casa) y molestan con los ruidos por la noche. La casa necesita más ventilación - la cama doble está en un cuarto interior sin ventanas, por lo menos pusieron un fan para hacer correr el aire. No hay caldera de tamaño suficiente para 4 personas, no queda agua caliente para todos y los últimos tendrán que ducharse con el agua fría. Tendrían que haber puesto una caldera mayor. Las puertas no se cierran bien, hay amueblado roto, la cama individual está de calidad baja, bien para un niño, pero no es adecuada para un adulto mayor de 20 años. En el jacuzzi podrían cambiar el agua, pero en lugar de hacerlo añaden más hipoclorito cada lunes y el agua huele mucho a este compuesto químico.

Pues esto. Valoración inicial habría sido de 8/10, menos 2 puntos por la necesidad de dormir en el sofá sin el aviso previo alguno, fue una cosa imprevista para nada. Menos 1 punto por el cuarto sin ventanas, poca agua caliente, y menos 1 punto por los insectos. 4/10 mejorable.

reviews.author: Agnieszka
reviews.positive: Ładne i przestronne pokoje, dobre wyposażenie, ładny widok na ocean.
reviews.negative:
Lokalizacja przy ulicy, niestety ulica bardzo mocno uczęszczana, dużo aut w ciągu całego dnia i do późnego wieczora,
co powoduje uciążliwy hałas. Słaby ekspres do kawy.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.title: Gostámos da Madeira mas foi dificil descansar pelas razões que já descrevi
reviews.positive: A localização é perto do aeroporto e da vila de Machico, que tem uma boa praia de areia branca e bons restaurantes.
reviews.negative:
A casa fica numa estrada muito íngreme e mal insonorizada. O barulho dos carros durante a noite torna difícil descansar.

O ruído dos aviões é constante, por estar muito próxima do aeroporto.

As toalhas entregues tinham um cheiro desagradável, como se tivessem sido lavadas apenas com água.

Reservámos para 5 pessoas, mas uma das camas não estava feita e não havia toalhas de banho suficientes. Só foram entregues no dia seguinte.

A cozinha não tinha toalha de mesa nem pano de limpeza adequado — apenas toalha de mãos e pano para secar loiça.

reviews.author: Olesiak
reviews.title: it's a great apartment despite some minor issues
reviews.positive:
Communication with the host was amazing! Easy self check-in, great video instruction. They were always responsive, very professional and helpful. Provided a crib and a feeding chair for our baby despite we requested it the very last minute.
It's a 2 floor building with 2 units with a separate entrance for each apartment. We stayed in the ground floor unit. There is super nice patio with table, umbrella and chairs, so nice for breakfasts or dinners with a view. There was plenty of kitchen ware, big toaster, coffee machine, microwave, all the plates, utensils and everything you may need in the kitchen. Additional blankets, pillows, bed sheets. Washing machine (just buy some detergent) was great to have. Dedicated parking spots were also so good to have.
reviews.negative:
In general it's a great property but there were couple small things some of which can be improved.  We stayed in the ground floor unit, and there is one significant trouble which is I'm not sure can be fixed by the host - it's cats pee smell. Most likely it appears because of the windows on the ground level in the kitchen and one bathroom, so cats simply do their stuff on the street but it smells inside apartment in the kitchen area. We bought some electric Glade against pet odors, so it helped a bit.
Another annoying issue (but it is common for most places in Madeira as far as I understand) is ants. We had to clean all surfaces immediately after meals and keep ALL food in the fridge, and still there is a garbage bin, so you can't avoid ants :(( 
One bathroom definitely need some towel hooks or bars (we ended up using hangers from the wardrobe because there was literally nowhere to hang towel). And soundproofing is so bad, we could hear everything from the apartment above. 
But just as I said, it didn't mess our staying there, it's still a pleasant place

reviews.author: Goutch
reviews.negative:
Appartement donnant sur une rue à sens unique et en pente, ce qui engendre d'énormes nuisances sonores de jour comme de nuit. 
Mal isolé, odeur d'humidité et odeur d'égout dans la salle d'eau. 
Je ne comprends pas la note de 8 pour cet appartement. 
De plus, il y a tromperie car ce sont les commentaires les plus élogieux qui sont mis en avant...
Attention à bien lire tous les avis.
reviews.response:
Dear Goutch.

Thank you for your feedback.
We would like to clarify a few points regarding your review. The property is indeed located on a one-way street with a slight incline. However, it is not a busy road, and while there may be occasional traffic, the area is generally quiet, especially at night. Additionally, please note that inclined roads are common throughout Madeira due to the island’s mountainous terrain, and the incline near our property is relatively mild compared to many others on the island.

The property is thoroughly cleaned by a professional cleaning team between every guest stay to ensure high standards of hygiene and comfort.
We have always made an effort to remain communicative and available during your stay. Unfortunately, none of the concerns mentioned in your review were brought to our attention at the time, which would have allowed us the opportunity to address them promptly.
Please note that guest reviews are managed by the booking platform and reflect individual experiences and personal opinions, which can naturally vary.
Thank you once again for your input.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.negative: Le processus de check-in a été absolument pénible. L'agence s'occupant de la location m'a envoyé de nombreux messages, des formulaires à compléter et surtout, une demande de paiement de taxes de touristes (24 euros dans notre cas, donc une somme peu élevée) à payer AVANT notre prise de possession des clés par virement bancaire international. Cette demande a été faite à peine quelques jours avant notre départ pour Madère. J'ai donc dû appeler en urgence mon institution bancaire pour effectuer un virement international et j'ai dû assumer des frais de 15euros pour que le virement se fasse «en urgence» afin que le paiement soit reçu avant notre arrivée. Cette procédure, en plus d'être stressante, de m'avoir occasionné des frais inutiles, a terni mon arrivée à Madère. Ceci étant dit, outre les procédures de check-in les hôtes (une agence de location) se sont montrés très gentils et accueillants.

reviews.response:
Dear Agnieszka.

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed the location, the quiet surroundings, and the easy access to the city centre and nearby shops.

Regarding the lock, we would like to clarify that in the information provided prior to arrival, we explain that it is necessary to turn the key fully to operate it correctly. We are also always available to assist and support whenever needed.

As for the parking space, we understand your comment, as spaces in Madeira are often more compact.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Peinetti
reviews.title: Agence à eviter
reviews.positive: L'emplacement.
reviews.negative:
Accueil et contact déshumanisés, uniquement par mails. Demander plusieurs fois notre heure d'arrivée alors que personne n'accueille. Seulement aller récupérer la clé de (dans un boîtier à numéro) moà une adresse que notre taxi n'a pas trouvée. Demander 42'50 € pour le transfert depuis l'aéroport alors que booking l'offre à 16€. Appartement ( entrée, cuisine, salon) pas chauffé ( très froid en février 2026 avec les tempêtes) . Pas de climatisation. SDF qui dort dehors derrière l'entrée. Incessants aboiements du chien du dessus. Aucune souplesse pour quitter les lieux sous prétexte de nettoyage ( impérativement à 10h ( répété) pourtant un agent n'est venu récupérer les clés qu'à 11h50.). Demander avec insistance si la taxe a bien été payée et même réclamer un justificatif du virement sur la banque allemande.
En bref rien de portugais, aucune courtoisie. " Aucune chaleur". Mais beaucoup de "thank you to staying with us"
reviews.response:
Dear Peinetti.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent stay.

We would like to clarify a few points mentioned in your review. The property operates with a self check-in system, and the detailed check-in instructions are always sent to guests a few days prior to arrival to ensure they can organize their arrival accordingly. This information includes the procedure for collecting the keys from the secure lockbox at the property.

Regarding airport transportation, the amount quoted corresponds to a private transfer service provided by an external driver we collaborate with. The price varies depending on the arrival time and includes assistance with key collection. Guests are, of course, free to choose alternative transportation options if they prefer.

We would also like to clarify that the apartment is not advertised as having air conditioning, and this information is clearly stated in the listing. Additionally, during your stay we did not receive any communication regarding the apartment being cold. Had we been informed at the time, we would have gladly done our best to assist and find a suitable solution.

As the accommodation is located within a residential building, some level of noise from neighboring apartments may occasionally occur. However, we have not previously received similar feedback regarding this specific unit.

The check-in and check-out times are clearly stated prior to booking, and while we are always happy to be flexible whenever operationally possible, on this occasion the check-out time had unfortunately already passed when our team needed to prepare the apartment for the next guests.Despite this, you remained in the property beyond the agreed time, which left us with no option but to insist that the apartment be vacated.

Finally, regarding the tourist tax, we kindly ask for confirmation of payment when it is transferred separately, as required for accounting and compliance purposes.

We appreciate your feedback and remain committed to continuously improving our service and ensuring a comfortable stay for our guests.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Roman
reviews.title: Great
reviews.positive: Everything, from transfer to check out was perfect. Great location for cozy family vacations. Actual apartment looks even better than on the pictures.

reviews.author: Harry
reviews.title: Geweldig
reviews.positive: Locatie perfect! Dichtbij is een busstop, supermarkten op loopafstand, lekkere restaurants op loopafstand. Het appartement zelf is ontzettend ruim, alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Wij waren met 3 personen, waardoor we meer dan genoeg ruimte hadden.
reviews.negative: In een van de badkamers hing een nare geur.

reviews.author: Lord_zirious
reviews.title: It was a wonderful time in Madeira and the experience was intensified by this great apartament.
reviews.positive: Location was perfect, just 3 minutes from natural pools Doca do Cavacas, 5 minutes walk from shopping center Forum Madeira. Apartament was just perfect, very clean with all the necessary things. A great advantage is the large terrace, when we spent all evenings after visiting all day long trips on this beatiful island.
reviews.response:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the excellent location, close to the natural pools at Doca do Cavacas and the Forum Madeira shopping centre.
It’s great to know that you found the apartment comfortable, clean, and well equipped, and that you were able to relax and enjoy the large terrace in the evenings after your days exploring our beautiful island.

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.positive: O alojamento é moderno e apresenta uma decoração muito bonita. Por outro lado, encontra-se muito bem equipado com tudo aquilo que é necessário e está localizado numa excelente zona - perto de praias/piscinas e do Funchal.
reviews.negative: O único ponto menos positivo no alojamento é que não foram trocar as toalhas e limpar durante os 5 dias que lá estivemos mas de resto tudo espetacular.

reviews.author: Rutey
reviews.title: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and overcame any inconveniences we faced!
reviews.positive: The apartment was very nice and had a comfortable atmosphere. Its location was ideal, situated near open swimming pools and a supermarket. We really enjoyed the convenience of having these amenities close by.
reviews.negative: The apartment would be much more comfortable with air conditioning, especially during hot nights! Additionally, it would be helpful to add some hooks in the bathroom for convenience. Just a quick tip: be cautious with the bathroom door handles, as they can be tricky. There were times when we had to rescue each other because they didn't work properly. It might be better to have proper handles instead of knobs.

reviews.author: Illia
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.positive: Great furniture, stylish and modern, well-equipped kitchen, spacious terrace, underground parking, and excellent location
reviews.negative: Keys had to be collected far from the apartment

reviews.positive:
Все сподобалось, місце розташування просто супер? зручно що є парковка, квартира простора, красива, гарна тераса для посиденьок

reviews.negative: дуже важко було відкривати двері ключем

reviews.author: Céline
reviews.title: Séjour gâché car impossible de profiter du jardin et de la piscine!
reviews.positive: Belle maison avec une vue magnifique sur la côte et l'océan.
reviews.negative:
Malheureusement nous n'avons pas pu profiter de l'extérieur car un immeuble était en construction sur le terrain mitoyen avec une grue à quelques mètres de la piscine. Les travaux démarraient à 8h et finissaient à 20h. Le bruit et parfois les odeurs de solvant ne nous permettaient pas d'aller à l'extérieur. L'agence nous a répondu qu'ils nous avaient prévenus mais ils ne l'ont fait que 3 semaines avant le départ, ce qui ne nous a pas permis de trouver une autre location. Les travaux étaient bien avancés et avaient déja démarré il y a 6 mois au moment de notre réservation. De plus, ils nous ont informés de "travaux" sans préciser leur importance (grue, tronçonnage, bips incessants...)
Autre désagrément à signaler : des odeurs d'égout remontent de différentes canalisations.
Nous avons posé une réclamation car pour 4300 euros la semaine, nous aurions aimé pouvoir aller dehors et ouvrir les fenêtres !!!

reviews.author: Jean-yves
reviews.positive: Villa confortable et équipement complet.
reviews.negative:
La construction d'un immeuble dans la parcelle voisine.
Travaux bruyants de 8h à 18h

reviews.author: Aleksandra
reviews.positive:
Świetne miejsce na wypoczynek i zwiedzanie! Obiekt położony jest pośrodku wyspy, co czyni go idealną bazą wypadową do odkrywania wszystkich jej zakątków. Okolica przepiękna i spokojna, zdecydowanie mniej turystyczna co akurat dla mnie jest ogromnym plusem natomiast trzeba mieć na uwadze, że dom oddalony jest od większych sklepów a miejscowy sklepik jest słabo wyposażony i drogi. 
Jeśli chodzi o sam dom to zamieszczone zdjęcia zgadzają się z jego stanem faktycznym a przed przyjazdem dostaliśmy film z dokładnymi instrukcjami zameldowania. W czasie naszego pobytu tuż obok trwała budowa natomiast nie była ona zbyt nieznośna i nie przeszkadzała w wypoczynku. Polecam apartament.
reviews.response: Dear Aleksandra. Thank you for your thoughtful review! We're happy the apartment met your expectations and that the check-in instructions were helpful. We also appreciate your understanding about the local shop and the nearby construction, it’s great to know it didn’t affect your stay too much. Thank you for recommending the apartment, and we hope to welcome you again in the future! Kind wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Byron
reviews.title: Dramat
reviews.positive: Dom piękny ale otoczenie to plac budowy a firma zarządzająca nastawiona na zysk bez żadnych skrupułów
reviews.negative: Dom wybrany dwa miesiące wcześniej. Ten wymarzony. Kilka dni przed wyjazdem informacja, że trzeba dopłacić 500 Euro za ogrzewanie basenu. Wcześniej takiej informacji na stronie nie było i pojawiła się  w dniu poinformowania mnie o takowym fakcie. Po przyjeździe na miejsce dom wspaniały wszystko czego potrzeba, ale za płotem prace ziemne ciężkim sprzętem od bladego świtu do późnej nocy. Firma Atlantic Holiday twierdziła, źe nic o tym nie wiedziała, mimo że prace widać, że trwały już kilka tygodni. Po złożeniu skargi zaproponowano nam dom w zamian albo zwrot kosztów w najbliższym czasie i decyzję mieliśmy podjąć w ciagu godziny.  Na Maderze znaleźć dom z 4 sypialniami w ciągu godziny jest bardzo ciężko. Mając na względzie to że było z Nami dziecko i dwoje osób powyżej 75 roku życia zgodziliśmy się na dom zastępczy. W zamian za  dom z basenem otrzymaliśmy dom z małym Jacuzzi. Zamiast domu na wsi dom w Funchal. 4 Sypialnie w tym jedna w piwnicy bez dostępu światła a druga przy hałaśliwej pompie ciepła  bez możliwości zmróżenia oka w nocy. Brak podstawowych elementów wyposażenia jak kubły na śmieci nawet w kuchni. Zepsute wanny  w łazienkach, brak korków do wanien i niedziałające jacuzzi. Nieczynny sprzęt kuchenny. Dodatkowo obsługa, która wchodziła do domu bez zapowiedzi np. ogrodnik  podczas brania kąpieli w ogrodzie. Dramat za 2900 Euro zamiast wymarzonych wakacji koszmar bez rozmowy o jakiejkolwiek rekompensacie. Uważajcie na firmę Atlantic Holiday mają wiele domów na wynajem ale traktują klienta  w sposób karygodny. Nie polecam firmy  i ostrzegam przed wydanymi niepotrzebnie pieniędzmi i zmarnowanymi wakacjami. Wszystko co tu napisałem jest udokumentowane więc jeśli są jakieś wątpliwości to proszę o kontakt  i chętnie podzielę się szczegółami.
reviews.response:
Dear Byron.

We are writing to address the concerns you raised regarding your recent stay. It is important to provide clarity and state the facts surrounding your experience.

Construction Nearby
As mentioned, construction was taking place near the initial property. This activity had been ongoing for several months, yet no prior guests reported any disturbance, as evidenced by positive reviews on Booking.com and other platforms during this time.

Alternative Options Provided
When you raised concerns, we promptly offered two clear solutions:

A full refund.
Relocation to a house in Funchal, located in a calm and relaxed area.
You were shown the alternate property and given time to decide. At no point were you forced to stay at this property or rushed into making a decision. The choice to stay at the replacement property was entirely yours.

Condition of the Replacement Property
The issues you listed regarding the alternate property, such as equipment functionality and noise, do not align with our observations or feedback from subsequent guests. The property has hosted multiple bookings since your stay without any similar complaints.

Actions Taken by Our Team
We worked efficiently to provide immediate solutions to your concerns. Additionally, other properties were available for booking at the time, which could have been secured independently had you chosen to pursue a refund.

Our company is committed to maintaining a high standard of service, as evidenced by the overwhelming positive reviews from other guests. While we understand you may have been disappointed, it is crucial that feedback remains factual and constructive.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday team

reviews.author: Ola
reviews.positive: Veldig fint hus og utrolig fin beliggenhet. Fint uteområde og bra for store middager.
reviews.negative: At det bare var 8senger ettersom vi syntes sofesofaen oppe var ganske ekkel.

reviews.author: Maciej

reviews.negative: Duży minus, niezależny od gospodarza - w ostatnią noc naszego pobytu na ulicach odbywał się rajd samochodowy. Straszne wycie silników, pisk opon, masakra, nie można się było od tego odizolować. Niestety wyścig zakończył się grubo po północy. Więc jak ktoś nie przepada za takimi atrakcjami, to przed rezerwacją polecam sprawdzać stronę gminy.

reviews.positive: Výborná poloha, nádherný a dobře vybavený dům.

reviews.author: Sophie
reviews.title: Great apartment but could be better
reviews.positive:
Very clean and nicely-decorated apartment, which was perfect for our week's stay. Great location - within a 10-15 walk of the main city centre & restaurants etc. Having a parking space was really handy for our hire car (although parking space was a tight squeeze- need to be a good at parking!) and a well-stocked kitchen so we can prep all our food for hikes etc. The water pressure for the showers was nice and powerful.
The hosts sent through really clear instructional videos about how to pick up the keys, how to get to the apartment and tour of the apartment which was SUPER helpful.
reviews.negative: We misread the booking.com description and assumed the apartment had aircon (when they don't mention aircon under the 'Facilities section' on booking.com - believe them!) We were very surprised when the apartment DID have aircon facilities however the host told us that these were not enabled so no aircon :((. In September it was still hot & very stuffy in the apartment so can't imagine what it must be like in June/ July with no aircon. We also battled daily with opening the windows as whenever we opened the windows/ balcony doors, 1. we got SO many mosquitos coming in and a really unpleasant amount of bites :(( and 2. Plus the buildings surrounding the condo are pretty noisy so even louder with windows open. In conclusion, wish the hosts could please just enable the aircon in the flat!
reviews.response:
Dear Guest.

Thank you for sharing your review.

Positive feedback is always encouraging and we are pleased to hear that the cleanliness, décor, location, parking, kitchen amenities, water pressure, and instructional videos met your expectations.

Regarding the air conditioning, we want to clarify that it is currently awaiting repairs, which is why it has not been listed under the description or amenities on our listing. We value transparency with our guests, hence why it was never mentioned. It's essential for future bookings to be based on the amenities that are listed to avoid any unexpected surprises.

It's also worth noting that mosquitoes are unfortunately common in Madeira around September. We recommend guests to always be prepared, especially during this time of year.

We value your feedback and thank you for choosing to stay at our apartment. We hope the overall experience was positive and that you enjoyed your time in Madeira. 

Kind regards.
Lucas Abreu

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: The building was in a good location and was clean.
reviews.positive: I liked the location and that it was spacious and had balconies to enjoy the evenings.   The bowl of fruit, Madeira cake, cookies, candy, juice and a bottle of water was a nice touch. I like that there was a kettle and a coffee maker.
reviews.negative: I did not like that instructions on how to plug washing machine was not provided and how to use it, no instructions on how to turn on the gas to use the stove, didn't enjoy a sewer smell coming from the sink at times and that there weren't enough supplies in the apartment at arrival.  In the description, it said that toilet paper was supplied. Only left over items from other guests were supplied. Also, it would have been nice if the pool was open for guests like other properties.
reviews.response:
Dear Maria.

Thank you for your review and for highlighting the location, the spacious apartment, the balconies, and the welcome items provided on arrival. We are pleased that these details contributed positively to your stay.

Regarding the washing machine, coffee equipment and gas hob, we are always available to assist guests with any questions during their stay. However, no request for help or clarification was made to us at the time. If we are not informed that a guest needs assistance, we cannot know that there is an issue or provide guidance during the stay.

Concerning supplies, toilet paper is provided for the beginning of the stay, as is standard in self-catering accommodation. It is not intended to be an unlimited supply for the full duration of the booking.

As for the pool, it is not currently in operation and is not advertised as part of the listing. Therefore, it is not included as an available facility for this property.

We appreciate your feedback and are glad that you enjoyed the apartment’s location, space and outdoor areas.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.title: Great location and space, but communication needs improvement
reviews.positive:
The apartment is spacious and gets plenty of natural light, which makes it feel very nice during the day. It’s well equipped and overall comfortable for a longer stay.

The beds were comfortable and everything was clean when we arrived, which we appreciated. The layout of the apartment is also good and the space feels pleasant to spend time in.

The location is another strong point, with plenty of restaurants, bars, and coffee places nearby, which made it very convenient to go out and explore the area.
reviews.negative:
Communication with the host was a bit frustrating. It took more than 24 hours to get a reply about the hot water, and by then we had already figured it out ourselves. Overall, it wasn’t very easy to get in touch during the stay.

Several appliances didn’t work when we arrived, including the heater, toaster, and hair dryer. Once we finally reached the host, they replaced everything within a couple of hours, which we appreciated. Still, the main issue was how long it took to get a response in the first place.

I think the apartment is probably better in peak summer. We stayed in March and it was quite cold inside, even when it was sunny outside.

The host was also not flexible with check-out. We asked for just one extra hour (11:00 instead of 10:00, which already feels quite early compared to the usual 12:00), but it was not possible.

I also found the check-in process a bit overcomplicated. There were three PDFs to read before arrival, which felt like a lot. Personally, I prefer something more simple and intuitive, especially when starting a holiday.

Lastly, I don’t like hidden costs. There is a €120 fee listed as “taxes and other costs,” but it’s basically a cleaning fee, since taxes are charged separately. It makes the place look cheaper than it actually is, which didn’t sit well with me.
reviews.response:
Dear Carolina.

Thank you for your detailed feedback and for highlighting the positive aspects of the apartment, including its space, natural light, comfort, and location. We are pleased to know you enjoyed your stay overall.

Regarding your comments, we would like to clarify a few points. All fees are clearly included in the total price shown at the time of booking, they may simply be collected under different categories, but there are no hidden costs.

In terms of communication, we always aim to respond as quickly as possible and, in your case, we did not take more than 1–2 hours to reply. As you mentioned, once we were informed about the appliances, we attended promptly and ensured everything was working correctly. Prior to this, we had not been made aware of any issues.

Concerning the temperature, the apartment is equipped with a heater, as stated in your comment. There is no mention of air conditioning, as this is not a feature of the property.

Regarding the check-out time, this is clearly stated before booking, allowing guests to make an informed decision. Any request for a later check-out is always subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed, although we do our best to accommodate such requests whenever possible.

Thank you once again for your feedback, which helps us continue to improve our service.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.negative: Hi ha un local una mica sorollós al mateix carrer, però només ens va molestar un dia. No té aire acondiciobat, però nosaltres no vam passar calor al setembre.  Si que te ventiladors disponibles.

reviews.author: Jacekzet
reviews.title: Dobry lokal, wymaga drobnych usprawnień
reviews.positive: Duża powierzchnia i i wielkość pomieszczeń.
reviews.negative: Pralka i zmywaraka raz działały raz nie

reviews.author: José
reviews.title: Vale a pena voltar.
reviews.positive: O espaço tem dimensão excelente, é moderno e está muito bem localizado e equipado. É uma escolha pare repetir em próxima oportunidade. Está próximo de tudo quanto é serviços necessários.
reviews.negative: Para tirar o melhor partido da experiência é mesmo recomendável alugar carro.

reviews.author: Anastasiia
reviews.title: Very good, met our expectations
reviews.positive: Large comfortable apartment. Good cosmetics in the bathrooms. Great area, everything nearby: supermarket, shopping center, gym, restaurants. If you don't want to cook at home, there is a cafe with good breakfasts on the first floor.
reviews.negative: The apartment is a bit "tired": the doors to the balcony open/close with difficulty (but this is not a big problem), the doors in one of the toilets do not close - only with a key, but it gets stuck, the child could not do it. It would be great if at least 1 bottle of water met us (we checked in around midnight, the shops were closed). The elevator does not work, it is good that we are with my husband, who brought all the suitcases. But this is not the landlord's fault, the elevator will work later (it has been disconnected since March for 3 months, judging by the ad).

reviews.author: Regina
reviews.positive: Super, wygodne mieszkanie. 3 sypialnie w każdej  pomieszczą się spokojnie po 2 osoby. W głównej sypialni bardzo duże łóżko. Dwie łazienki. Dodatkowo kuchnia i salon. Super komfortowo. Plus za bezpłatne miejsce parkingowe.
reviews.negative: - zmywarka nie domywa naczyń
reviews.response: Dear Regina. Thank you for your feedback! We are happy to hear that you found the apartment spacious, comfortable, and well-equipped, and that the free parking was a plus. Regarding the dishwasher, had you reached out to us, we would have been happy to assist and check it during your stay. We have now looked into it and everything is working properly. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Elisha
reviews.title: Great location with parking! Short ride to Old Town and other attractions.
reviews.positive: The apartment was very spacious and clean. The neighborhood was festive and welcoming. There are a ton of restaurants around the area and the majority of the places were walkable. If we didn’t want to walk there was a taxi stand a few blocks away and the prices were decent. The staff were wonderful and super helpful. I would highly recommend.
reviews.negative: No issues!

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.positive: Przestronne, czyste mieszkanie zlokalizowane na końcu ślepej ulicy przy ogrodzie. Garaż w budynku. Blisko do centrum handlowego a zarazem spokojnie. W okolicy jest kilka restauracji.
reviews.negative: Mieszkanie nie posiada klimatyzacji ale nie jest ona niezbędna.

reviews.author: Tadeusz
reviews.title: 9 dni na Maderze to za mało aby wszystko zobaczyć i odpocząć w tym apartamencie
reviews.positive:
Bardzo blisko dużego centrum Handlowego, co najmniej dwie knajpki na dole w budynku
świetna baza wypadowa do zwiedzania, dobra komunikacja do centrum autobusem, świetny parking na dole z bezpośrednim dostępem windą
W tym apartamencie naprawdę niczego nie brakuje 5-6 osób ma doskonałe warunki noclegowe z własną kuchnią i dwoma łazienkami
reviews.negative: Byliśmy w okresie maj/czerwiec i basen widoczny na zdjęciach był nieczynny na co się szykowaliśmy przed śniadaniem. Bardzo nam tego brakowało

reviews.author: Anikó
reviews.title: Tágas, jól felszerelt apartman, segítőkész szállásadók
reviews.positive: Tágas, kényelmes, jól felszerelt apartman, plusz pont a garázshely. A szállásadókkal személyesen nem találkoztunk, de online kommunikálva is mindent elintéztek nekünk, kedvesek, segítőkészek voltak. Pár perc sétára bevásárlóközpont, boltok, kávézók.
reviews.negative: Egyedüli negatívum, hogy az apartmannal szemben van egy kávézó/bár, ahol kb éjfélig-hajnal 1-ig mindig hangosan beszélgettek és az nagyon behallatszódott a hálószobákba (bár ez a portugál nyílászáróknak is köszönhető).

reviews.author: Nemanja
reviews.positive:
Cisto, uredno i prostrano, uz odlicnu lokaciju. 

Uzivali smo!
reviews.negative: Nakon odjavljivanja nismo imali mogucnost da bespaltno ostavimo prtljag do vremena polaska na aerodrom.

reviews.author: Ligia
reviews.title: Definitely not professional
reviews.positive: The location and the big kitchen and living area
reviews.negative:
The bedding was yellow(stained) .The bedding was old.there was rust in bathroom.
We had to wait hours for anyone to open up for us.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.positive: La ubicación excelente el apartamento bueno
reviews.negative: La entrega de las llaves me parece muy engorroso rayando lo desagradable ya qué hay que retirarlas a varios kilómetros del apartamento

reviews.author: Lisbeth
reviews.positive:
Me gustó todas sus instalaciones y comodidades. 
El apartamento es muy grande. 
Cerca de los sítios mas principales.
reviews.negative:
No tiene aire acondicionado, tuve un poco de calor. 
Deberían facilitar el acesso a las llaves 🔑, para personas que no tenemos auto es difícil ir a buscar las llaves y después con las maletas ir al apartamento.

reviews.author: Mara
reviews.title: Alguns aspetos a melhorar
reviews.positive: Localização e área do apartamento.
reviews.negative: As baratas que aparecem, o papel higiênico que era pouco para 7 pessoas em 7 dias, a comunicação ser maioritariamente feita em inglês.

reviews.author: Bernardo
reviews.title: Great accomodation in the Lido area, perfect for a family or group of friends.
reviews.positive: Great accomodation in the Lido area, perfect for a family or group of friends. The house has everything you need.
reviews.negative: You need to collect the key in the Funchal area which is not great if you don't have a car.

reviews.author: Borges26
reviews.positive:
Boa localização.
Limpo e espaçoso.
reviews.negative: Nada a apontar

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Fabuloso
reviews.positive: Es un piso muy grande y cómodo para ir en familia, éramos 7 y nos adaptamos muy bien en todas las habitaciones
reviews.negative: Algún cubre colchón de cama es de plástico y no deja transpirar y se suda mucho, a la segunda noche lo quitamos.

reviews.author: Rui
reviews.title: Boa.
reviews.negative: A entrega das chaves fica muito longe do apartamento.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Otima localização!
reviews.positive: A localização e otima! Tem tudo perto, e as camas sao confortáveis 😄 O terraco e enorme para criancas brincarem com segurança. Perfeito!
reviews.negative: Deveria ter mantas mais quentes, extra, almofadas extra, tapetes para ambas as casas de banho e nos quartos tambem torna o apartamento mais aconchegante. Ar condicionado para manter o apartamento mais quente em alturas frias é essencial e necessário! Maquina de secar roupa seria ideial, em especial para familias numerosas!!!

reviews.author: Catana
reviews.title: APARTAMENT SUPERB INTR-UN ORAS FORMIDABIL
reviews.positive: Apartament frumos si spatios aflat la etajul 1 al unui imobil aflat intr-o zona plina de magazine, cafenele, restaurante si alte atractii . Foarte important  - la 200 de metri de locatie este un MALL excelent , cu tot ce iti doresti in materie de cadouri. Apartament foarte curat, cu 3 dormitoare si 2 bai , cu un living somptuos si terasa spre bulevard . Bucatarie mare, bine echipata , cu masina de spalat vase si expresor de cafea . Din bucatarie se iese pe o terasa enorma dotata printre altele cu 2 sezlonguri unde poti sa faci plaja . Cu gazda am vorbit doar prin SMS pe telefon, dar ne-au ajutat cu tot ce am avut nevoie . Chiar ne-au lasat 2 randuri de chei ca sa ne fie usor la cele 2 familii sa nu depindem unii de altii .
reviews.negative: Am avut o problema cand am ajuns din cauza faptului ca cheile trebuiau ridicate de la biroul firmei ce inchiriaza apartamentul si care se afla la 4,5 km distanta de locatie . Este adevarat ca gazda a trimis in ziua precedenta informatii despre acest lucru, dar nu mi s-a intimplat nicaieri sa iau cheile de la 5 Km distanta .

reviews.author: Jean-luc
reviews.negative: réclamation très,  ou trop tardive de la taxe de séjour,  ..; nous étions en parcours et cette opération facile à résoudre en amont,  est plus compliquée lors de notre déplacement;

reviews.author: Noemí
reviews.positive: Limpieza
reviews.negative:
El alojamiento estaba muy limpio y contaba con todo lo necesario. El único punto negativo es que la
casa es más antigua / vieja de lo que aparenta en las fotos

reviews.author: Dariusz
reviews.title: Polecam to miejsce zwłaszcza dla dużej rodziny
reviews.positive: Duża powierzchnia apartamentu i w pełni wyposażony, duży taras na zewnątrz, bliskość sklepów, restauracji i środków komunikacji miejskiej

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.positive: L'emplacement.. la terrasse .. Le centre commercial très proche.. Le taxi pratique est pas cher pour aller dans Funchal Car nous étions 5 .Merci Au bureau qui gère les locations -- Ils sont vraiment très réactifs - Merci..MERCI
reviews.negative: Appartement dans lequel il manquait vraiment peu de chose...ciseaux et essoreuse à salade
reviews.response: Dear Patricia. Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear that you enjoyed the location, the terrace, and the proximity to the shopping center. We also appreciate your kind words about our team and are happy to have been responsive to your needs. Thank you for mentioning the missing scissors and salad spinner; we will take note of this for future improvements. We hope to welcome you again soon. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.positive: Spacious, comfortable, clean, and fully equipped apartment. Nice host who fully explained all procedures to us and quickly answered all the questions we had. A good starting point to visit Funchal.
reviews.response: Dear Jan. Thank you for your feedback! We are happy to hear that you found the apartment spacious, comfortable, clean, and fully equipped. We're glad that we could assist with all the procedures and answer your questions quickly. We hope to welcome you again soon. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Maryna
reviews.title: Перебування було комфотним, тому рекомендую.
reviews.positive: Перебування було комфортним , квартира повністю обладнана всім необхідним , є простора тераса , де ми провели багато дружніх, теплих вечорів. Поряд є супермаркет і багато кафе, також поряд є платна парковка, тому з машиною ми не мали клопоту.
reviews.negative: Було трошки мурашок, але я так розумію що це по всьому острові через клімат і можливо поверх.
reviews.response: Dear Maryna. Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear that your stay was comfortable and that the apartment was well-equipped with everything you needed. It's great that you enjoyed the spacious terrace and had many pleasant evenings there. We are also pleased that the nearby paid parking made your stay more convenient. Regarding the ants, it is important to note that their presence is quite common in Madeira due to the local climate, and they can sometimes appear despite regular cleaning and maintenance. We appreciate your understanding and hope to welcome you again in the future. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Lorena
reviews.positive: La casa era molto carina aveva tutto occorrente molto accessoriata .bella la posizione peccato che nel complesso non ci fosse la piscina.
reviews.response: Dear Lorena. Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear that you liked the house, found it well-equipped, and enjoyed the location. We are sorry that the absence of a pool impacted your experience. We hope to welcome you again in the future. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Lara
reviews.title: Espetacular
reviews.positive:
A localização era ótima! Fácil acesso! Bastante confortável! 
Ideal para famílias numerosas!
Próxima do centro! Com todos os equipamentos necessários para estarmos durante estes 4 dias!
reviews.negative: O ponto menos positivo sem dúvida foi o facto de existirem bastantes formigas! Apesar de não haver comida! Na zona do terraço e cozinha tinha bastantes!
reviews.response: Cara Lara. Obrigada pelo seu feedback! Ficamos felizes que tenha gostado da localização, do conforto e da conveniência para famílias numerosas, assim como da proximidade ao centro e dos equipamentos disponíveis durante a sua estadia. É importante notar que na Madeira a presença de formigas é bastante comum, pois fazem parte do ambiente natural local e, apesar da limpeza e manutenção regulares, podem às vezes entrar nas casas. Agradecemos a sua compreensão e vamos continuar a trabalhar para minimizar esse tipo de situação. Com os melhores votos, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Maciej
reviews.title: Good place, good location, good price
reviews.positive: Big rooms, 2 bathrooms, shops nearby, cafes, restaurants, near the beach, and busses.
reviews.response: Dear Maciej. Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear you enjoyed the good location, value, and spacious rooms with two bathrooms. It's great to know that the nearby shops, cafés, restaurants, beach, and bus connections made your stay more convenient. We hope to welcome you again soon. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Manuel
reviews.title: Vale a pena
reviews.positive: Excelente localização perto de shopping center, padaria e restaurantes. Apto super cômodo e completo, além de uma atenção muito rápida e eficiente do Lucas, o nosso contato com a Lido.
reviews.negative: Localização e conforto
reviews.response: Caro Manuel. Obrigado pelo seu feedback! Ficamos felizes em saber que a localização foi conveniente, perto de um shopping center, padaria e restaurantes, e que o apartamento foi confortável e bem equipado. Agradecemos também o seu reconhecimento pela atenção rápida e eficiente do Lucas. Com os melhores votos, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Adela
reviews.title: Very comfortable and beautiful villa with the most amazing sunset view
reviews.positive:
We absolutely loved this villa. It is located about half an hour from Funchal in a very quiet area, and it has all the comfort you could possibly require. The kitchen has everything you need if you should want to cook some meals, and the bedrooms are all super comfy. Even the fourth bedroom that has two twin beds is very comfortable. I actually liked that entire last floor more than the rest of the house. I got to have a small living room and an entire terrace all for myself while my friends occupied two bedrooms on the floor below. When I arrived at the villa on a Friday night, the entire first floor was without electricity, I suspect it was because there is a house under construction next door that was taking electricity from this villa as there was a cable plugged in in an outlet on one of the terraces. The rental company sent an electrician at 7 pm who fixed the problem. So they did not say, oh, it’s Friday night, we cannot find an electrician tonight, you have to wait till tomorrow. No. They did send someone that night. That’s outstanding.  
We spent 7 nights at the villa and I am already planning to return, this time I will bring my two grown up sons with their girlfriends. 
Madeira is an absolute wonder of this world and all the people we encountered are extremely friendly and willing to help.
reviews.negative:
There was nothing I didn’t like about the villa. 
Except perhaps the tiny ants invasion in the kitchen, but if you don’t leave any food out, they do not show up. Maybe they could try and do something about the ants though.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.positive: Todo estuvo genial, alojamiento a la altura de las expectativas. Muy cómodo y bien equipado

reviews.author: Wiktor
reviews.positive:
Nice willa by the seashore. 4 bedrooms: 3 bedrooms with double beds on the 1st floor and 2 bathrooms, 1 bedroom with twin beds on the 2nd floor and 1 bathroom.
Everything as descripted. Nice stay. Thank You

reviews.author: Eveline
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: O apartamento é amplo, bem dividido e nos acomodou muito bem. É exatamente o que consta nas fotos. A comunicação com o anfitrião foi muito boa.
reviews.response: Thank you, Eveline! I’m delighted our condominium met your expectations and that our communication made your stay smooth. We’d love to welcome you back anytime you’re in Porto.

reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Yoav's accommodation was perfectly located, making it easy to explore the area. The communication between Yoav and his team was exceptional, ensuring everything went smoothly. Staying there really made us feel comfortable and at home.
reviews.response: Thank you, Neemz — I’m glad our condominium’s location and our team’s communication helped you feel at home. We hope to welcome you back on your next visit to Porto.

reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.positive: El sitio era increíble, estaba totalmente equipado, lo que hace que te sientas como en casa. Las vistas y poder desayunar o tomar algo en la terraza mirando al Atlántico es simplemente un lujo

reviews.response:
Dear Carlos.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the fully equipped apartment, the terrace, and the incredible Atlantic views, it’s wonderful to know it made you feel at home.

Regarding the mattress and pillows, we understand that comfort can be a matter of personal preference, and we appreciate your comments, as will take them into consideration.

We’re thrilled by your recommendation and would be happy to welcome you back anytime.

Kind regards,

reviews.comment:

Die Ausstattung ist gut; ein Staubsauger wäre noch hilfreich. Wegen der hohen Luftfeuchtigkeit steht ein Entfeuchter im Zimmer, den wir immer laufen ließen, wenn wir unterwegs waren.
Die Abgeschiedenheit hat uns gefallen, man ist jedoch auf ein Auto angewiesen – der nächste Supermarkt ist rund 15 Minuten entfernt. Die vom Besitzer empfohlenen „Parkplätze“ sind lediglich ein Grünstreifen, auf dem man zur Hälfte auf der Straße steht, direkt nach einer Kurve. Außerdem ist das Haus etwas hellhörig, daher hängt es von den Nachbarn ab, wie ruhig es ist.
Insgesamt ein sehr erholsamer Aufenthalt in wunderschöner Umgebung.

reviews.comment:
Le logement était conforme à sa présentation: clair, très propre, bien aménagé, avec une vue magnifique sur l'océan.
Quelques éléments expliquent que les notes ne sont pas maximales :
- l'accueil reste impersonnel (clefs dans un boîtier, aucune visite en 8 jours)
- quelques manques dans l'équipement : des ustensiles mériteraient d'être remplacés (poêles) ou complétés (faitouts) et rien pour le nettoyage du sol (problème sur une semaine complète);
- aucune place de parking (le restaurant  à 100 m le monopolise bien qu'il y ait des places libres)
- pas de commerces aux alentours.
Sous ces réserves le logement est de qualité.
JPC
reviews.response:
Dear Jean-Pïerre.
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We’re glad to know that you found the apartment bright, clean, well equipped, and enjoyed the magnificent ocean view.
Regarding the check-in process, the key box system is designed to provide flexibility for our guests, especially those with late arrivals or who prefer to explore the island before heading to the apartment. We’re always available to assist whenever needed and would have been happy to help during your stay.
We also appreciate your suggestions about kitchen equipment and cleaning supplies. We regularly review our inventory and will take your observations into consideration to ensure the apartment is as comfortable and practical as possible for future guests.
Regarding parking, while the nearby restaurant occupies the dedicated spots close to the property, there are free spaces along the road nearby, and we always provide guests with clear information on how to use them safely and conveniently.
The property is in a peaceful more rural area, so shops are a short drive away.
We value all guest feedback and are happy to know that, despite these points, you found the accommodation to be of good quality. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Layna
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment:
On arrival we found caked-on food on dishes and utensils, soap dribbles on the counter, and a fishy, decomposing smell the provided Airwick struggled to mask.
On night three we met our first cockroach in the kitchen, which the host assured us was “not a problem” and “not a sanitation issue.” Apparently, roaches here are roommates, not pests. By the last night, we were so unsettled we left at 2:30AM.
Amenities were as creative as the cleaning: “fully functioning washer/dryer” with no detergent, and “hand soap” that doubled as 2-in-1 shampoo.
The 4-key access system meant if one of us stepped out, the other was literally locked in as doors and gates must be locked with key from inside and out. Parking added its own thrill: a roadside spot on a downhill mountain stretch, perfect for late-night arrivals.
The balcony view was beautiful, but beauty only goes so far when you’re sharing space with cockroaches and a lingering stench. Check-in at 4PM and checkout at 10AM sealed the
reviews.response:
Dear Layna.
Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feedback. We really appreciate receiving feedback from our guests, as it helps us maintain and improve the quality of our property.
Regarding cleanliness, the property is professionally cleaned, and we take great care to ensure high standards are consistently met. We also want to clarify that the property does not have any odors, and the only issue you mentioned was a single cockroach, which we appreciate you bringing to our attention. Madeira’s natural environment, particularly in rural areas, can occasionally lead to the presence of small insects despite our regular cleaning and preventive measures. After you informed us, we promptly visited the property to apply additional treatments.
As a self-catering property, the amenities provided are listed in our description. If there is ever any doubt, we always recommend reaching out beforehand so we can clarify. For example, we provide a washing machine, but laundry detergent is not included. We do provide dishwashing detergent, hand soap, and a one-in-two shampoo for your convenience.
Regarding the keys, each apartment comes with a complete set of keys to access the property and the laundry area.Check-in and check-out times are also displayed at the time of booking.
We value open and honest communication with our guests and always do our best to resolve any concerns fairly. On this occasion, we were disappointed to receive a request for financial compensation in exchange for not posting a negative review.
Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Patrycja
reviews.title: We had a great time ☺️
reviews.positive: The accommodation is located in a great spot, with amazing views outside the windows. It has private garden, balcony and a jacuzzi. It was equipped with everything needed for the stay, including coffee machine, hair dryers etc.
reviews.negative: The only thing that surprised us was the gate entrance ramp as it was not possible to park low suspension car in front of the house, and that there was air conditioning but no central heating.
reviews.response:
Dear Patrycja. 
Thank you for your feedback it is highly appreciated. We are glad to know everything was up to your standards and that you enjoyed your stay. 
Unfortunately it is not common to use central heating on the househoulds of Madeira Island because of our tropical weather, hence the use of the air conditioning only.
Please know it was an absolute pleasure hosting you on Mystic Mountain by Atlantic Holiday and you are welcome back anytime. 
Best regards, 
Atlantic Holiday Front Desk

reviews.author: Martine
reviews.title: Over het algemeen tevreden
reviews.positive: Het appartement is vrij ruim en de terrassen aan de voor-en achterzijde zijn aangenaam . Mooi uitzicht op zee. De bedden zijn comfortabel en het appartement, lakens en handdoeken zijn proper . Bijna alles van keukengerief is aanwezig. Ook de ondergrondse gratis parking is een pluspunt. De wifi en TV  functioneren zeer goed
reviews.negative: Geen echt onthaal ( sleutel in box) en ook moeilijk om aanspreekmensen te vinden. Een kleine verwelkoming in de vorm van wat water en enkele koffiepads had aangenaam geweest . Meestal is het warm in Madeira , maar indien dit niet het geval is is de huidige verwarming onvoldoende. Een wagen is echt noodzakelijk gezien de steile wegen , tenzij men een getraind stapper is
reviews.response:
Dear Martine.

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed the generous space, the terraces, and the beautiful sea view. It’s also great to know that you found the beds comfortable and that the cleanliness, parking, and connectivity met your expectations.

We would like to clarify that, although this was a self check-in, we always make contact shortly after arrival and remain fully available throughout the stay. No queries were left unanswered, and we are always ready to assist and clarify any matter whenever needed.

We also appreciate your suggestions regarding welcome amenities and will take them into consideration for future improvements.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Jarosław

reviews.negative: Problemy z internetem (losowe rozłacznie)

Goede communicatie met de verhuurder.

Some pleasant bonuses like yoga mat and board games are also there! 🥰 The hosts were super responsive to our requests. We really appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you again in the future! Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Luis
reviews.title: Boa localização e confortável

reviews.author: Leonardo

reviews.positive: Muy bien ubicado en el centro de todo, y es un piso muy tranquilo realmente estuvimos una semana y ninguna noche se escuchó nada para estar en medio de todo, muy bien.
reviews.negative: La zona es muy céntrica, si te mueves con coche como hacemos la gran mayoría, es complicado encontrar aparcamiento cerca porque o es de pago azul o está reservado a residentes, pero no es de la casa en sí, sino de la zona, todo lo bueno que esté cerca complica un poco frente a si fuera una casa un poco en las afueras, solo si se va con coche de alquiler.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.positive: L'emplacement est idéal, en plein cœur de la ville, commerces et restaurants en bas de la rue. Place de parking à proximité tous les soirs sans difficultés. Très grande superficie d'appartement !
reviews.negative: Malheureusement, la douche était capricieuse et le lit n'est pas le plus confortable...

reviews.author: Beate
reviews.title: Es war ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt in diesem Apartment. Kann es weiterempfehlen für 2 Personen .
reviews.positive:
Die Ausstattung des Zimmers war sehr gut und es stand eine Waschmaschine zur Verfügung und dafür ebenso einiges an Zubehör. In der Küche war alles ausreichend vorhanden, genauso wie im Badezimmer 
Wir bekamen ein Video vorab mit allen wichtigen Informationen über den Aufenthalt. Der Parkplatz für unser Mietauto war gratis dabei. 
Der gesamte Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm, man brauchte nur etwas 10 Minuten zu Fuß ins Zentrum.
reviews.negative: Das Zimmer war kleiner als auf den Fotos gewirkt, aber trotzdem ausreichend Platz für 2 Personen. Für mehr Personen würde ich es sehr klein finden. Der Parkplatz war sehr eng und man musste einige Male hin- und herschieben um Einparken und Ausparken zu können. Leider hatten wir einmal eine tote Kakerlake in unserem Badezimmer, wir wissen aber nicht woher diese kam. Ebenso konnte man die Nachbarn gut hören, aber es war meistens ab 10 Uhr abends Ruhe im ganzen Haus.

reviews.author: Ionel
reviews.positive: Apartamentul este bine utilat și este situat destul de aproape de piscinele naturale.Magazinele și restaurantele sunt la 3-4 minute de mers pe jos.Nu este foarte luxos, dar oferă un raport bun preț-calitate, ținând cont de zonă.Loc de parcare subteran inclus.Comunicare foarte bună cu proprietarul și self check-in foarte ușor, însoțit de tutorial video.
reviews.negative: Într-adevăr, este o problemă cu clădirea, zgomotele transmițându-se foarte ușor prin pereți, dar aici este, mai degrabă, o problemă a nesimțiților cazați lângă tine, care nu conștientizează că nu sunt singuri în bloc.

reviews.author: Silvia
reviews.title: Decepcionante apartamento en Porto Moniz
reviews.positive: La distancia hasta las piscinas naturales
reviews.negative:
La limpieza pelos, telarañas, el cepillo de barrer tenía más pelos que yo en la cabeza, …
No había las toallas correspondientes para una pareja faltaba la del baño. Tuve que insistir y demostrar con fotos que no estaba. Nuestra estancia era de 5 noches y nos dijeron que las de lavabo eran las de ducha. Al final nos trajeron más toallas. Nos fuimos a duchar y no funcionaba el agua caliente. Nadie nos cogió el móvil no tampoco a treces del whatsapp. Gracias a un vecino que nos ayudó pudimos tener agua caliente. No recomiendo el alojamiento  calidad precio

reviews.negative: Mieszkanie dość ciemne, zapach wilgoci.
reviews.response: Hello Katarzyna. Thank you for your feedback! We are pleased to hear that you found the apartment spacious, comfortable, and well-equipped, and that the location was to your liking. Regarding the humidity smell, it is a common occurrence in Madeira due to the island's warm and humid climate, but we do our best to maintain the property. We appreciate your understanding and will continue to ensure the best possible experience for future guests. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.response: Dear Matteo. Thank you for your feedback! We are glad to hear you enjoyed the cleanliness, comfort, and location of the apartment. Regarding the presence of the cockroach, it is important to note that Madeira's warm climate and natural habitat can sometimes lead to occasional encounters with local wildlife, despite our regular cleaning and maintenance. We always recommend keeping food securely stored to minimize this. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.
