reviews.negative: Das Bett ist sehr schmal für zwei Personen und die Matratze sehr weich.

reviews.author: Loïc
reviews.title: bien mais pas à la hauteur pour le prix
reviews.positive:
- décoration
- accueil
- explications 
- disponibilité
reviews.negative:
- matériel pas forcément complet (torchon) 
- différence de 6h entre l'heure de départ et l'heure d'arrivée
- lors d'une demande d'un jeux de serviette supplémentaire on nous répond "nous ne sommes pas dans un hôtel" dommage pour un service si simple
- malheureusement pas de leur fait mais les chiens qui font trop de bruit
reviews.response:
Dear Loic.

Thank you for taking the time to write a review!

We’re pleased to hear that you enjoyed the decoration of the property and found the explanations helpful.

We would like to clarify that our check-in and check-out times are on booking prior to your reservation. These times allow us to ensure that the property is thoroughly prepared for each new guest.

Regarding the towels, as a house rental service, we provide a set of towels for each guest as part of the accommodation. While we understand your request for an extra set of towels for each day, this is not possible. However, we did make an effort to offer you one additional set during your stay, even though our policy is to provide only one set per guest for short stays.

As for the noise from nearby dogs, we understand that this can be disruptive. Unfortunately, we have reached out to the condominium to help us with this situation, but, unfortunately, it is also beyond their control.

We appreciate your feedback, Thank you!

Kind Regards,
Atlantic holiday.

Atlantic Holiday Front Desk

reviews.author: Marlen
reviews.title: Nur für taube Ohren!!
reviews.positive:
Das Apartment entspricht komplett den Bildern. 
Man merkt, dass die Vermietung erst seit kurzem läuft. Alles ist sauber und sehr gut in Schuss.
ABER.....
reviews.negative:
Sehr wichtig zu wissen ist, dass sich die FeWo in einem ganz normalen Mehrfamilien-Wohnhaus befindet, deren Wände extrem dünn sind!!! Zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit hört man Klospülungen, laufendes Wasser, zufallende Türen, Schritte und sogar wortwörtlich die Gespräche aus den Nachbarwohnungen! Wochenends ist es durch langanhaltende Parties besonders laut.
Direkt unter der Wohnung befindet sich dazu die hauseigene Tiefgarage - inkl. aller Lärmquellen, die von Autos eben so ausgehen....
Als wir das alles beim Vermieter angezeigt haben, wurde uns gesagt, dass wir wohl eher die sensiblen Gäste seien und doch die Polizei holen könnten.....
Weil es wirklich nervenaufreibend war, haben wir uns dann entschieden, eher auszuziehen und haben von booking.com eine Erstattung erhalten.....

Also Vorsicht!
Geschmackvolle Einrichtung, gute Lage, aber grässliches Wohnumfeld!!

reviews.author: Nocas
reviews.title: Não recomendo
reviews.positive: Gostamos da varanda. Cozinha equipada com utensílios mais que suficientes e máquina de lavar com capsúlas disponíveis. Localização ok.
reviews.negative:
Tanto posso dizer aqui. A limpeza deixou a desejar: havia teias de aranhas em alguns cantos, inclusive em uma das casas de banho onde tive aranhas que desceram onde deixei as toalhas de banho. Alguns utensílios da cozinha estavam sujos, principalmente frigideiras com um liquído escuro estranho - passei a lavar tudo antes de utilizar. Perdemos um anel no quarto, o que nos levou a procurar bem no chão e debaixo da cama estava uma camada de pó que parecia não ser aspirada há meses. Por um alojamento que se paga pela taxa de limpeza, achei inadmissível todas estas condições.
E também, um cão de um vizinho ladra durante a noite ao mínimo som da rua o que não nos permitia descansar como suposto. No geral, foi uma decepção e não recomendo este alojamento. E para além das indicações de estacionamento, todos os dias estava absolutamente cheio e tive sempre de deixar o carro mais longe.

reviews.author: Ariel
reviews.title: Bardzo przyjemny apartament, w super lokalizacji i z parkingiem. Drobne mankamenty.
reviews.positive: Głównym atutem tego miejsca jest lokalizacja. Mieszkacie bardzo blisko starego miasta, zaraz przy porcie, obok mnóstwo sklepów, piękny park i dosłownie kilka kroków by znaleźć się w centrum wydarzeń. Jednocześnie mieszkanie jest na tyle wysoko, że da się otworzyć okno i nie spać w hałasie. Bardzo duży plus z parking podziemny. Parkowanie auta w tej lokalizacji, bez parkingu, to absolutny koszmar. Apartament dobrze wyposażony, w kuchni znajdziecie wszystko czego potrzeba, jest pralka, duża lodówka, mikrofala, piekarnik, toster, zastawa, garniki, naczynia, nawet suszarka na pranie. Da się komfortowo mieszkać i przez 6 nocy nic nam nie brakowało. Łóżko bardzo wygodne, w sypialni jest klimatyzacja. Balkon jest okej, z jego części widać port. Budynek jest bezpieczny, wszystko otwieracie kluczem/dołączonym tokenem.
reviews.negative: Minusem jest odbiór kluczy z całkowicie innej lokalizacji niż apartament. Jeżeli macie auto, to okej, ale w przypadku, gdy go nie macie, to Bolt lub dłuższy spacer. W tej cenie oczekiwałbym trochę więcej. Drugi mankament to hydraulika. Umywalka w łazience zatykała się chwilę po odkręceniu wody i czasami woda nie schodziła godzinami. Nie korzystaliśmy z niej. Może to przypadek po poprzednich lokatorach. Pod prysznicem trudno wyregulować wodę, ciśnienie jest słabe i chwilę zajmuje, zanim ustawicie oczekiwaną temperaturę. Za to w kuchni jak macie źle ustawiony kran i odkręcicie wodę, leci praktycznie wrzątek i z dwa razy nam się to przytrafiło. To wymaga poprawy. Inaczej dałbym maksymalną ocenę.

reviews.negative: Keine Zwischenreinigung. Knarz Geräusche nachts vom Boden. Teilweise echt erschreckend.

reviews.author: Gerbrich
reviews.positive: Fijne plek op een goede locatie, alles in de buurt. Goed uitgeruste keuken en prima communicatie met de host.
reviews.negative: De stoelen in de serre zijn aan vervanging toe, die zitten niet heel prettig

reviews.author: Therese
reviews.positive:
The location was fantastic.. just a few steps away from all the action.
Great for morning walks along the sea side..the view from the balcony was awesome.

reviews.positive:
Las vistas desde la terraza 
La terraza

reviews.positive: نظافه المكان شراحته جمال الاطلاله سهوله الدخول والخروج
reviews.negative: عدم وجود مكيفات

reviews.author: Nadine
reviews.positive: Die Aussicht und die Größe der Terrasse waren super. Die Wohnung war ausreichend groß für 6 Personen. Es war sehr sauber und ordentlich. Die Lage war toll, wenn auch ein steiler Anstieg von Funchal aus. Parkmöglichkeit vor der Wohnung an der Straße.
reviews.negative: Die Ausstattung der Wohnung war etwas ungemütlich und wirkte im Wohnzimmer etwas zusammengewürfelt.

reviews.author: Christa
reviews.positive: Der Ausblick von der Terrasse, die Außenanlage sehr gepflegt , die Einrichtung der Küche, das Mobiliar passend zur Insel
reviews.negative: Die Einrichtung vom Wohnzimmer müsste man erneuern

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Top Lage zu einem guten Preisleistungsverhältnis - würden es wieder buchen
reviews.positive:
Hatte alles was wir benötigt haben. Sehr ruhige Lage und bequeme Betten. 
Es hat uns sehr gefallen und fühlten uns dort sehr wohl, fast wie zu Hause.
reviews.negative:
Leider hatte es viele Mücken, ein Mückengitter würde abhilfe schaffen ;) 
Im Schrank unter dem Waschbecken  in der Küche roch es sehr stark. Evtl. ist das Abflussrohr undicht.

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.positive: La amplitud, las camas eran muy cómodas, la cocina tenía de todo, muy buenas vistas, aparato de aire acondicionado muy útil para dormir
reviews.negative: Hay que valorar que la s una ciudad con unas cuestas impresionantes y para llegar al centro hay que coger coche o usar Uber, que por 4€ te llevan al centro

reviews.author: Garnung
reviews.positive: Casa limpia, grande y ordenada. El jacuzzi funciona perfectamente. El vecindario muy tranquilo.
reviews.negative: Falta algo de equipamiento de cocina (trapos, azucar, especias, alguna papelera más, pastillas de lavavajillas...).

reviews.author: Luca
reviews.positive:
Posizione eccellente, staff molto disponibile per risolvere tempestivamente alcuni problemi all'arrivo, casa estremamente spaziosa, vista come da foto. Letti comodi e biancheria pulitissima. Servizi per i bagni completi, scarichi e acqua calda perfettamente funzionanti.
Zona tranquillissima, parcheggio comodissimo, a un passo dal centro e dalla strada statale. Piscina riscaldata vista mare.
reviews.negative: Alcuni servizi non corrispondenti alla descrizione (stendibiancheria, servizi per la cucina, etc) su cui lo staff si è attivato prontamente per migliorare la situazione (e rimborsando, con grande professionalità e cortesia, i costi della lavanderia). Pavimento e cucina non pulitissimi all'arrivo ma niente di problematico. Complessivamente esperienza positiva.

reviews.author: Eveline
reviews.title: Een fijn appartement met schitterend uitzicht.
reviews.positive: Royale appartement voor 2 pers met alles erbij.
reviews.negative:
Op het laatst wilden we de wasmachine gebruiken maar het bakje kwam niet naar voren en leek de wasmachine wat verroest.
Durfde de kleding er niet in te doen.

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Schönes Apartment (das leider etwas hellhörig ist) mit guter Lage
reviews.positive: Die Lage war sehr angenehm, ein bisschen außerhalb vom Schuss und somit auch nicht direkt im Touristentrubel. Gut ist auch der Parkplatz der zur Wohnung gehört, da man sonst eventuell schon Schwierigkeiten mit dem Parken bekommen könnte - ein Thema weniger um das man sich Sorgen machen muss.
reviews.negative: Die Kommunikation mit Atlantic Holiday ist leider nur mäßig, bei der Nachfrage ob man ein bisschen früher in die Wohnung könnte kam gerade mal 4 Minuten vor der normalen Bezugszeit die Nachricht man könne früher rein.. da kommt man sich veräppelt vor. Ansonsten wurde nur kurz wegen der Taxe noch kommuniziert, aber das wars.

reviews.author: Venkateshwara
reviews.title: Very convenient stay on all other aspects.
reviews.positive: Location was excellent. Breakfast was not a part of the stay.
reviews.negative: A neighboring residence had a dog that barked constantly all night long that caused sleep deprivation.

reviews.author: Philippe
reviews.positive: Orientation et parking
reviews.negative: Canapé lit inconfortable

reviews.author: Morgane
reviews.title: Un appartement que je recommande avec une belle vue mer même s'il mériterait un double vitrage!
reviews.positive:
Le séjour fut très agréable, l'appartement est semblable aux photos avec une belle vue sur la mer.
Il est vaste, tout équipé, très propre, bien décoré et nous avons trouvé que la literie était confortable! 
Les clés étaient facilement récupérables et nous avons eu une communication facile avec les hôtes.
Quand nous sommes arrivés, il y avait une dosette de café, du papier toilette, du sopalin et de quoi faire la vaisselle, c'était franchement pratique :)
reviews.negative:
L'appartement est clairement bruyant et très mal isolé.. on entendait les conversation des voisins, le bruit des travaux, des voitures dehors mais aussi des chiens errants (propres à l'île, je crois que cela est partout malheuresement)
Le petit moins aussi > les photos ne montrent pas que le balcon donne sur d'autres terrasses (elles étaient souvents vides nous n'avons croisé personne à part un chien qui aboyait pas mal mais très mignon)

reviews.author: Izabela
reviews.title: było fantastycznie :)
reviews.positive: Przestrzenne mieszkania, piękny widok z tarasu, funkcjonalne urządzenia, czysto. Blisko do komunikacji publicznej i sklepów.

reviews.author: Elfrida
reviews.title: Отличная квартира, хорошо оборудованная кухня, есть парковка, большой уютный балкон. Все понравилось)
reviews.positive: Все необходимое было в квартире. Подробная инструкция была выслана заранее. Шикарный балкон с видом на океан.

reviews.author: Daniele
reviews.title: Posto perfetto per una vacanza fantastica
reviews.positive: Casa davvero comoda, spaziosa, perfetta per due persone. Tanti spazi all'interno, organizzata bene. Letti discretamente comodi, divani da rivedere, cucina attrezzata, lavatrice e lavastoviglie che rendono la vita facile a chi alloggia una settimana. La vista dal balconcino fantastica (si vedeva l'alba, mese Gennaio), per delle bellissime colazioni. A 15 minuti scarsi di auto da Funchal, il centro di Canico era a 2-3 minuti di auto. Posizione ottima per girare l'isola.
reviews.negative: Essendo una casa, preferirei trovare piccole cose (olio, carta igienica) per non doverle comprare e poi lasciare li intatte.

reviews.author: Perfectcoffee
reviews.positive: Die Ferienwohnung liegt inmitten eines Wohngebietes, also außerhalb von "Touristenburgen" und war immer gut erreichbar. Reservierter Parkplatz vor der Tür. Meerblick wie versprochen von einem schönen kleinen Südbalkon.
reviews.negative: Die Ausstattung entspricht nicht mehr den Bildern. Alles ist etwas abgegriffen, fleckig und ungepflegt.

reviews.author: Sylvia
reviews.positive: Nice,clean apartment with beatiful view. Quiet neighborhood. Apartment is well equipped.

reviews.author: Wouter
reviews.title: Gezellige accommodatie met prachtig uitzicht waar alles aanwezig was
reviews.positive: Mooie en gezellige accommodatie. Alles was er aanwezig, zelfs handdoeken om naar het strand mee te nemen. Het was er heel comfortabel. Het uitzicht vanop de terras was heel mooi: je keek uit op de Ilhas Desertas. De accommodatie was goed gelegen om het eiland te verkennen. Er was een eigen parking bij het appartement.
reviews.negative: Het bed was niet echt ideaal. Verder hadden wij wat last van lawaai van zowel de buren (omdat de muren niet goed geïsoleerd waren en alles doorgaven, niet omdat ze veel lawaai maakten) als het verkeer rondom, waardoor we niet zo goed geslapen hebben. Je hoort het stadslawaai dus heel goed. Vermoedelijk zal dit voor mensen die van de stad komen geen probleem zijn.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Estadia de cerca de uma semana
reviews.comment:
Bel endroit avec vue magnifique.
Très jolie terrasse.
Le check in pourrait être amélioré.

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: Great

reviews.author: Veronika
reviews.title: Great location right by the ocean, a beautiful warm pool, and a clean, comfortable apartment with ev
reviews.positive:
The location of the apartment is absolutely fantastic — you simply take the elevator down and you’re right by the ocean. There are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby, which makes everything very convenient.

The pool area is beautiful, with warm water, and the entire property is very well maintained. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing.

The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well looked after, with everything we needed for our stay. There were four of us, and we all felt very comfortable.

We really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place.
reviews.negative: The security staff at the entrance were a little rude, and we had to wait longer for check-in than the stated time, even though we had asked if it would be possible to check in a bit earlier.

reviews.author: Viktoria
reviews.title: The appartment and the pool was great. The agency communication before arrival was poor
reviews.positive: when I arrived and how to transfer tourist fee which  I could not via mobile, but the agency could take it from my account.
reviews.negative:
It was very difficult to find out how to collect keys I had no information on this at all even I asked several times. When I arrived to Madeira I called the agency, luckily I saved their numbers.
I received all the videos what to do what not when I arrived and how to transfer tourist fee which  I could not via mobile, but the agency could take it from my account.
1 key using the elevator to beach for a family of 4 is not enough
Gym was okish, not the best

reviews.author: Asr4
reviews.positive: Do conforto do colchão. Da localização. Da acessibilidade.
reviews.negative: Do ruído causado pelo ar condicionado do apartamento ao lado (o condensador dobapartamento G encontra-se na varanda do apartamento F), impedindo o uso da varanda.
reviews.response:
Caro hóspede.

Muito obrigado por escolher a Atlantic Holiday e por dedicar o seu tempo a partilhar a sua experiência connosco!
Ficamos muito contentes por saber que desfrutou do conforto do colchão, da nossa excelente localização e da acessibilidade do espaço.
Agradecemos também a sua observação detalhada relativamente ao ruído do condensador do ar condicionado na varanda. Valorizamos sempre quando os hóspedes destacam estes aspetos físicos e estruturais, pois ajuda a nossa equipa a monitorizar a disposição dos nossos espaços e a avaliar formas de otimizar o conforto nas áreas exteriores.

Foi um prazer tê-lo como nosso hóspede e a nossa equipa adoraria ter a oportunidade de o voltar a receber na Madeira no futuro.

Com os melhores cumprimentos,
A Equipa Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Niamh
reviews.title: Incredible - will 100% be back to this apartment
reviews.positive: The pool was amazing and it was only a short stroll down to the beach using the lift where there were lovely walks and little beach clubs to enjoy a drink and sunset! There was a supermarket directly across the road for convenience and 10 min stroll to the shopping centre and lovely restaurants
reviews.negative: It was our own fault but we didn’t read the check in instructions correctly - the lock box was actually at a different location to the apartment so having to get a round taxi trip at 3am to collect the key AFTER arriving at the accommodation was not on the bingo cards but it was luckily a short 10 min drive away. Just read the instructions carefully!
reviews.response:
Dear Niamh.

Thank you so much for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to leave such an incredible review!

We are thrilled to hear that you plan to return and that you loved the amazing pool, the convenient access to the beach and local beach clubs, as well as having the supermarket and restaurants right on your doorstep.

We also truly appreciate your honest and lighthearted note regarding the key collection! Navigating check-in details at 3 AM after a long flight is certainly a challenge, and we commend your fantastic attitude in handling that unexpected late-night taxi mission.

It was an absolute pleasure hosting you, and our team cannot wait to welcome you back to Madeira for another unforgettable 100% perfect stay!

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.positive:
Bonne communication, explication claires et détaillées 
L’emplacement 
Les équipements à disposition
reviews.negative:
Bruyant
Le logement n’était pas propre : poils et cheveux sur la cuvette + le canapé. Poêles grasses (mal lavées) 
L’ascenseur pour accéder à la plage ne fonctionne pas
reviews.response:
Dear Laura.

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the communication, the clear explanations provided, as well as the location and available equipment.

We regret to know about the cleanliness concerns mentioned, and this will be reviewed with our housekeeping team to ensure standards are consistently maintained. We would also like to note that this was not reported during your stay; had we been informed, we would have immediately sent the cleaning team to resolve the situation.

Regarding the lift with access to the beach, it was not operating due to adverse weather conditions and for safety reasons. Please note that this is managed by the condominium and is outside of our control.

Thank you once again for your comments, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Sergio
reviews.title: Bien situado y con jardines y piscina top.
reviews.positive:
La situación y los exteriores: jardines y piscina.
También que todo estaba nuevo y funcionando correctamente.
reviews.negative: El sofá cama era poco cómodo y pequeño para dos personas. Que no haya cambio de toallas ni toallas para la piscina durante la estancia.
reviews.response:
Dear Sergio.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to share your feedback with us!

We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our prime location, the beautiful gardens, and the pool, and that you found everything in the apartment to be brand new and in perfect working order.

Thank you also for your honest observations regarding the sofa bed. We appreciate when guests highlight these details, as it helps us monitor the physical layout and comfort of our spaces. Regarding your comment on the towels, please note that we do not provide mid-stay towel changes for stays of 6 nights. However, for our guests' convenience, there is a washing machine available in the apartment should you wish to wash them during your holiday.

It was a pleasure having you as our guest, and our team would love the opportunity to welcome you back to Madeira in the future.

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.response:
Dear Maykonn.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to leave such a fantastic review!

We are absolutely thrilled to hear that your experience was wonderful and spectacular. It is the greatest compliment to know that you highly recommend us and are already planning to return.

The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Liliane
reviews.title: Exceptionnel et magnifique
reviews.positive: C’était exceptionnel. Très calme, reposant, super vue, intime. Une villa moderne décorée avec goût. Toute la famille a adoré le séjour. On est à 3 minutes en voiture du centre. Le seul regret c’est le court séjour. Nous reviendrons. Enregistrement en autonomie très facile grâce aux informations et à la vidéo envoyée en amont. Communication très facile et efficace avec le personnel. Nous n’avons manqué de rien.
reviews.negative: Rien

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.positive: Einfach perfekt
reviews.negative: Nichts

reviews.author: Aleksandra
reviews.title: Niesamowicie przyjemny czas, mogę tylko napisać ehhhh szkoda że się skończył ;(
reviews.positive:
Wspaniałe miejsce, super nowoczesny i piękny dom, w pełni wyposażony, widok zapiera dech w piersi, sypialnia główna robi ogromne wrażenie przez swój genialny widok, basen z pięknym widokiem ( rekomenduję podgrzewanie ), wszystko w najlepszym porządku.  Klimatyzacja, super wyposażona kuchnia, kontakt w razie pomocy  i pytań natychmiastowy i bardzo przyjemny, miejsce niesamowite i co ważne bardzo prywatne, nikt nie zagląda, nie patrzy i się nie narzuca, spokojna okolica. Bardzo szybkie i proste zameldowanie, dobrym pomysłem jest krótki filmik instruktażowy który się otrzymuje przed przyjazdem. Sklep i restauracje w pobliżu, jedna uwaga - za taki widok trzeba niestety zapłacić - konieczne jest auto bo dom stoi na wzgórzu, ewentualne piesze wycieczki do restauracji lub sklepu czy na plażę dla bardzo wytrawnych graczy :)
Dom wart polecenia, jest genialny!
reviews.negative: brak

reviews.author: Eimutis
reviews.positive: Everything high quality anything you needed was inside
reviews.negative: Outside furniture could be better for the price you are paying for stay

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.positive: Appartamento in zona strategica e di dimensioni generose per un'ottima condivisione degli spazi comuni

reviews.author: F
reviews.positive:
Perfect appartement als aanwezig wat je nodig heeft.
1 keer per week schoongemaakt en nieuwe bedlinnen en badlinnen.
Perfecte locatie
reviews.negative: Niets

reviews.author: Gago
reviews.positive:
Piso muy amplio, bien ubicado (al lado del Forum y cerca de la playa), buenas salidas a la vía rápida. 
Con todos los equipamientos necesarios.
reviews.negative: No se proporciona prácticamente ningún "consumible" (café, azúcar,  alguna pastilla para el lavavajillas, o en su defecto jabón para fregar). No tienen obligación de proporcionarlo, pero es muy habitual en otros alojamientos y viene muy bien. Nosotros llegamos un viernes de madrugada y para desayunar el sábado lo hubiéramos agradecido.
reviews.response:
Dear Gago.

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the spaciousness of the apartment, its convenient location, and the available equipment.
As the accommodation operates on a self-catering basis, we provide only the basic items to start the stay, which does not include consumable products.
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Erika
reviews.positive:
Nagyon jó helyen lévő apartman, a Forum Madeira bevásárlóközpont mellett. 
Jól felszerelt konyha, tágas nappali étkezővel. 3 szoba 6 fő részére kényelmesen megfelel. 
A szálláshoz tartozik 2 db parkoló.

reviews.author: Junija
reviews.positive:
The apartment was spacious all the necessary furniture for a comfortable stay. A guaranteed parking space in the underground garage was provided, which was very convenient. The apartment also offered pleasant ocean and sunset views.
The location is very good, situated above a shopping center and with a wide selection of stores, restaurants, and bars around it. It is located not far from the city center, and there is a bus stop nearby with direct connections to the city center.
Even though the main windows faced a busy street, the apartment was quite quiet.
reviews.negative:
The apartment was not very clean upon arrival, and several items required repair, including broken bathroom vanities and some furniture that appeared worn. As we stayed for more than two weeks, it was inconvenient that there was no vacuum cleaner provided, as well as no washing or dishwashing tablets. Only a few rolls of toilet paper were supplied, so we had to purchase all additional supplies ourselves.
Each guest was provided with only one set of towels, which made it uncomfortable to manage washing and drying throughout the stay. After raising these concerns, one light cleaning was carried out in the middle of the stay.
The bathrooms and kitchen were quite dark, and additional task lighting would significantly improve comfort. Key collection was also inconvenient, as it required driving several kilometers to the agency’s office. In addition, only one set of keys was provided, which is impractical for groups of up to six people with different daily schedules.
reviews.response:
Dear Junija.

Thank you for your detailed feedback. The apartment is thoroughly cleaned before every arrival, and we did not receive any comments regarding cleanliness or maintenance issues upon your check-in, which prevented us from addressing them at the time.

We would like to clarify that as a self-catering property, only the initial basic supplies are provided, and guests are expected to purchase any additional items they require. Aditionally, during your stay, a midterm cleaning was carried out complimentary, free of charge for you, including the replacement of all bed linen and towels. A second set of keys was not requested during your stay.

Regarding key collection, the key box is located at our office, which is conveniently on the route to the property. This information was communicated to you several days in advance and provides a flexible self-check-in option, as the building itself does not allow a key box.

We appreciate your comments and thank you for taking the time to share your experience.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Luis
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.positive: O próprio apartamento a localização
reviews.negative: A limpeza, especialmente da cozinha e a água quente não dava para as 5 pessoas que habitaram a casa.

reviews.author: Artur
reviews.positive: Duży, wygodny apartament. Dwa pokoje usytuowane od podwórka ciche, pokój od ulicy dość głośny, słuchać ruch uliczny(nam to nie przeszkadzało, rezerwując apartament wiedzieliśmy czego się spodziewać, ponieważ w ubiegłym roku byliśmy w tym samym budynku, ale innym apartamencie). Spokojnie pomieści 6 osób. Kuchnia dobrze wyposażona, choć przydałyby się większe kubki na kawę czy herbatę. Po klucze do apartamentu, należy podjechać po drodze z lotniska do biura zajmującego się wynajmem- kontakt szybki i bezproblemowy.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: A casa era lindíssima, a localização tem uma vista maravilhosa. Apesar de não termos a melhor sorte com as condições meteorológicas, os jacuzzis e os jogos disponíveis na casa permitiram-nos uns dias plenos de entretenimento pela casa.
reviews.response: Obrigado Pedro, ficamos contentes por também gostarem! É a nossa casa de montanha da família, muitas boas memórias, e adoramos partilhar o que a região tem para oferecer. Até uma próxima.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: María ha estado desde el principio muy atenta a todo lo que le preguntábamos, muy rápida en contestar y a la casa no le falta detalle tiene de todo para pasar unos días maravillosos, muy recomendable

reviews.author: F
reviews.positive: De ruimte in het appartement beviel ons erg goed. Alles was netjes en er waren erg veel voorzieningen.
reviews.negative: De schommelstoel was erg confortabel maar laat roest achter op de tegels. Dat kijkt wat slordig. Daarnaast als de airconditioning binnen aan staat dan zit je buiten op het bankje in de warme lucht van de buitenunit.
reviews.response:
Dear guest.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to share your feedback with us!
We are so glad to hear that you enjoyed the spaciousness of the apartment, found everything well-organized, and appreciated the amenities provided during your stay.

Thank you also for your detailed observations regarding the rocking chair and the external air conditioning unit on the terrace. We always appreciate it when guests highlight these specific physical details, as it helps our maintenance team keep an eye on things and allows us to continually review the setup of our spaces.

It was a pleasure having you as our guest, and our team would love the opportunity to welcome you back to Madeira in the future.

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Severine
reviews.title: Bien placé, tout confort
reviews.positive: Localisation super, piscine magnifique et chaude, près de la plage et facile pour les courses   Seul hic fut la piscine non accessible pendant 2 jours
reviews.negative: Le manque de réponse de l hote pour la demande de la 2 eme cles
reviews.response:
Dear Severine.

Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We are glad to know that you appreciated the surroundings, the pool facilities and the convenience of having the coastline, local services and shopping options within easy reach.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused by the temporary closure of the pool. Unfortunately, this was not something we were informed of in advance, and the situation was beyond our direct control. We fully understand, however, that this may have affected your stay and are happy that you still got to enjoy the pool.

Regarding the additional key, we sincerely regret any misunderstanding. Unfortunately, our team did not receive a message requesting another key during your visit. Had we been made aware of this request, we would have been pleased to assist and check what arrangements could be made.

Thank you once again for choosing to stay with us and for taking the time to leave your comments.

reviews.author: Vickers
reviews.title: Fabulous accomodation made our holiday
reviews.positive: Amazing location, convenient for trips. Lovely pool, and cleanliness of facilities. Even allowed a late check out no extra cost.
reviews.negative: Everything. Facilities were fab.
reviews.response:
Dear Vickers.

Thank you so much for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to share such a wonderful review!
We are thrilled to hear that the accommodation helped make your vacation unforgettable. It is fantastic to know that you enjoyed the convenient location, the lovely pool, and the cleanliness of our facilities. We are also very glad that we were able to accommodate your late check-out to make your departure a bit more relaxed.

It was a true pleasure having you as our guest, and our team would absolutely love to welcome you back to Madeira in the future.

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Dina
reviews.title: Good location unpleasant security
reviews.positive: Clean and spacious. Good location.
reviews.negative: Security was rude and they wouldn't let us in arguing that the rental company should be there to meet us, that these are peoples homes and they can't allow just anyone in. Called the rental company multiple times and after 20mins or so finally got through. A rather frustrating and unpleasant experience especially given the price you pay. The rental company should be there for meet guests to avoid such
reviews.response:
Dear Dina.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad to know that you found the apartment clean, spacious, and well located.

We hope to have the possibility of hosting you again in the future.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

Valorizamos muito este apontamento, pois ajuda-nos a avaliar como podemos adaptar e melhorar a nossa comunicação para garantir que o processo seja totalmente claro e acessível a todos os nossos hóspedes de língua portuguesa.

Com os melhores cumprimentos,
A Equipa Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Murad
reviews.title: Fijne en nette accomodatie.
reviews.positive:
Nette appartement en mooi verdeeld. Locatie is dicht bij Funchal en je hebt een supermarkt tegenover. Ook zijn er verschillende restaurants en de bus station is dichtbij. 

De personeel was er altijd bereikbaar via whatsapp en dat voelde prettig. Bij het inchecken zijn ze naar de appartementencomplex gekomen, omdat we moe waren na een lange reisdag.
reviews.negative:
We hebben schone beddengoed voor 2 personen en er lag een extra deken zonder dekbedovertrek. 

Ook het uitchecken was om 10:00 uur ochtend, terwijl onze vlucht pas om 18:40 was. Wat logish is, maar we konden ook geen extra handdoeken gebruiken om te kunnen zwemmen. Of een pasje voor die dag om naar de strand te kunnen gaan door middel van de lift (welke alleen met de pasje te gebruiken is). De laatste dag voelde niet echt dat er flexibiliteit is met wat we wellicht nodig hebben om ons verblijf af te sluiten.
reviews.response:
Dear Murad.

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that you found the apartment well laid out and enjoyed the convenient location, nearby amenities, and our availability throughout your stay. We are also glad we could assist you in person at check-in after your long journey.

Regarding the bedding, we appreciate your comment and will review this to ensure everything is fully prepared and aligned with expectations.

Concerning the check-in and check-out times, these are clearly indicated at the time of booking so guests can plan their stay accordingly. The check-out time is set at 10:00 to allow sufficient time for thorough cleaning and preparation of the apartment for incoming guests, especially during busy periods. To support guests with later departures, we provide a nearby luggage storage option, and we also offer a discount code for this service. Additionally, guests are welcome to enjoy the pool area after check-out; however, access to apartment items such as towels or other amenities is no longer possible, as they need to be prepared for the next guests.

Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Tomlus
reviews.positive: Apartment is located in an new and modern complex. It is very quite and the view from the balcony is very nice. Also 4 people can sit outside. The kitchen is well equipped. It has a 2 parking lots in a garage. You have to handle several remotes controls to enter the property. To open the final exit gate, just position the car very very close to gate and it will open automatically.
reviews.negative:
It has two bedrooms. One bedroom and bath is fine, but the other has a very small bed <140cm, which is only for children, and a small bathroom. The apartment is comfortable for 2 adults and 2 children, but not for 4 adults. 
The apartment is handled by an agency which support about 400 apartments. You never meet the host. They check if you arrive by car and send the position of the key lock, which is appr. 10min away by car. They send you some videos with instruction how to operate the various remote controls, keys and login codes. It is working but unpersonal.
reviews.response:
Dear Thomas.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the peaceful surroundings, the balcony view, the well-equipped kitchen, the outdoor area and the two private parking spaces.

Regarding the bedrooms, the beds are accurately advertised as queen-size, with widths generally ranging from approximately 140 cm to 160 cm. We understand, however, that individual expectations regarding bed size and comfort may vary, and our team is always happy to clarify any details before a reservation is made.

Our check-in procedure is designed to provide guests with greater flexibility and independence, particularly for late arrivals. Many guests appreciate being able to access the accommodation without having to coordinate an exact meeting time. 

We appreciate your comments, as they help us continue improving the information and support provided to future guests. Thank you again for staying with us.

reviews.author: Josef
reviews.positive:
Tolle Lage, Tiefgarage vorhanden, atemberaubende Aussicht, bequeme Betten, WiFi war gut, Küche war ordentlich ausgestattet. Schöne Gartenanlage mit Pool. 
Der Vermieter hat uns über WhatsApp aufgeklärt wie wir in die Wohnung kommen, sogar mit Videos. Schlüssel für die Wohnung war von eine andere Adresse abzuholen.
Gegenüber gibt es verschiedene Restaurants und eine Supermarkt.
Bei der Fernbedienung von Garagentoröffner war die Batterie leer, in eine halbe Stunde später ist jemand gekommen um zu erneuern.
Autobushaltestelle direkt vor dem Haus. 
Security bewacht das Haus.
reviews.negative:
Wir hatten eine ziemlich windige Zeit während unsere Urlaub. Alle Fenster sind logischer weise Richtung Atlantik ausgerichtet. Die Fenster sind undicht, der Wind hat permanent reingepfiffen, im mittleren Zimmer hat der Wind sogar die Fenster reingedrückt. Da dürfte der Beschlag kaputt sein. Die Vorhänge haben sich bewegt. Wir mussten improvisieren, und mit zusammengerollte Küchenpapier irgendwie eine bessere dichtheit zu schaffen. Hat nicht viel geholfen. Vielleicht hat der Vermieter inzwischen das Fenster reparieren lassen, trotzdem bei starke Wind ist es sehr störend der Windgeräusch. 
Unangenehm ist nach dem Ankunft irgendwie zu dem Agentur zu kommen um den Schlüssel zu holen. Ist nur mit ein Taxi oder mit ein Mietwagen möglich. Wenn man mit ein Bus anreist, muss man danach von Resort zu Agentur zu kommen und retour. Vielleicht für die Zukunft gibt es eine Safe für die Schlüssel direkt vor Ort. 
Sonst ist es nichts zu bemängeln!
reviews.response:
Dear Josef.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for sharing your feedback with us. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the great location, the underground parking, the stunning views, the comfortable beds, good WiFi, well-equipped kitchen, and the nice garden with the pool. We are also glad our team could quickly assist you with the garage remote battery!

Regarding your notes, we apply appreciation over apology for structural or physical elements such as the window design and wind sounds facing the Atlantic. As for key collection, it is conveniently arranged on the way to the property, but we would have been happy to meet you in person if you had informed us that this was an issue.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and the entire team would love to welcome you back to Madeira again soon!

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team
