reviews.positive: Parken vor der Tür. Vermietung hilfsbereit und jederzeit erreichbar, super.
reviews.negative: Das Bad war ohne jegliche Ablagen oder Schränke. Das Appartement hat zwar 4(5) Schlafplätze, aber insgesamt recht eng für 4 Personen. Der Geldautomat ggü. hat Nachts manchmal für Unruhe gesorgt. Die Klimaanlage mit Abluft war nicht leistungsfähig.

reviews.author: Vladyslava
reviews.negative: Наличие огромных тараканов в апартаментах.

reviews.author: Olivia
reviews.positive: Le logement était parfait.

reviews.author: Macedo
reviews.title: City Madeira 2026
reviews.positive: It was clean and close to everything I needed. I could walk to the shops and into Funchal no need for a car.  I love the set up of the house..
reviews.negative: I had a problem to open the front door, the key always jammed, I had to keep trying.

reviews.author: Bernadett
reviews.title: Kiváló helyen kiváló áron
reviews.positive: Tisztaság elhelyezkedés felszereltség

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.positive:
Great location, excellent communication from host.Beautiful bright apartment huge outside patio.
Fully equipped with everything, absolutely beautiful.
reviews.negative: Nothing.

reviews.author: Mariia
reviews.positive: Большая терраса, оборудованная кухня. Чисто.
reviews.negative: Не было корректной информации по поводу выноса мусора. Прислали три локации и ни одна не соответствовала.

reviews.author: Miklós
reviews.title: Kifogástalan állapotú, tiszta, jó helyen található szállás.
reviews.positive: A lakás tiszta, jól megközelíthető, jól felszerelt (kivéve klíma), teljesen felújított, kifogástalan állapotú, a belváros nyugati végén található. A környéken rengeteg étterem, reggeliző hely, közelben minden beszerezhető. Bankkártyás 0-24 parkolóház 5 percre a belvárosba levezető főúton. A kommunikáció udvarias, segítőkész. A kulcs átvételt és az első bejutás fennakadását leszámítva tökéletes.
reviews.negative: A kulcs átvétel nem a helyszínen történik, ez kicsit körülményes. Nincs messze a szállástól, de meg kell mászni érte egy keményen emelkedő utcát, ha az ember előbb teszi le a bérautót. A szállás egy társasház egyik lakása, de az épület bejáratánál semmi sem utal arra, hogy jó helyen járunk, és hogy hányadik emeleten, melyik lakás a szálláshely. A kulcs az épület kapuját nehezen nyitja, ezért elsőre elbizonytalanodik az ember, hogy jó helyen jár-e.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.positive:
Casa recentemente ristrutturata in modo moderno e funzionale, pulita e ben attrezzata. Grande terrazzo!
Posizione eccellente, in zona tranquilla ma vicino a ristoranti, market e un centro commerciale.
reviews.negative: Per 4 persone molto piccola anche se con 2 bagni.

reviews.author: Aðalbjörg
reviews.title: Góð dvöl.
reviews.positive: Ég bjó sjálf til morgunverð... staðsetning var góð.
reviews.negative: Rúmið var hart.

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.title: Un po caro, comoda la posizione
reviews.positive:
Posizione strategica vicino al centro (10 minuti) e a 20 minuti dal porto.
Cucina ampia e terrazzo grandissimo sul cortile interno.
Lavatrice. Possibilità di stendere i panni.
reviews.negative:
Camera piccolissima: letto chiamato matrimoniale ma è un letto a una piazza e mezza, piccolo per più notti due persone.
Divano con macchie non meglio definite.
Problemi con le serrature al portoncino di ingresso e anche con quello della camera.
Nessun "kit viaggiatore" tipo sapone, shampoo, spazzolino, cuffia.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.title: Perfecto para visitar Funchal
reviews.positive: Situado en un barrio céntrico para ir andando al centro, todo renovado y en perfecto estado.
reviews.negative: Detalles pequeños como que fallaba un poco la llave del portal

reviews.author: Inês
reviews.title: Estadia muito agradável num apartamento acolhedor localizado no centro do Funchal
reviews.positive: O apartamento era muito agradável, moderno e acolhedor.  Estava muito bem equipado com tudo o que precisávamos. Contém um espaço exterior também bastante agradável, ótimo para refeições. Para para além disso, está perto de todos os serviços necessários (supermercados, farmácias, etc).
reviews.negative: A localização era ótima pois era bastante central. No entanto, como é normal, foi complicado encontrar estacionamento (que era pago).

reviews.author: Johan
reviews.title: Gunstig gelegen, met een nieuwe keuken
reviews.positive: Alles was nieuw! Gunstig gelegen!
reviews.negative: De kast aan het voeteinde is overbodig, en redelijk breed. Dit gaat ten koste van het looppad. Maar misschien is dat een tijdelijke kast.

reviews.author: Suhatz
reviews.title: Ubicación excelente
reviews.positive:
La ubicación, muy céntrico.
Terraza gigante sin vistas.
2 baños aunque no se podía duchar a la vez.
reviews.negative: Tuvimos suerte para aparcar, siempre aparcabamos en frente del piso en los 5 sitios de OTA sin tener que pagar parking.
reviews.response:
Dear guest. 
Thank you for your feedback, it truly means a lot to us, as it helps us continue to improve. We're happy to know that you enjoyed the location and found it convenient during your stay.
Please note that, like many central apartments in Funchal city center, the property has traditional plumbing due to the age of the building. That said, we fully understand your concern and will certainly take your comments into consideration.
We’re also glad you were able to find free parking nearby. That's great news, and we’ll be sure to share that tip with future guests!
Wishing you all the best, and we hope to have the pleasure of hosting you again in the future.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Ralph
reviews.positive: El alojamiento está ubicado muy bien, cerca de un centro comercial, supermercado, restaurantes, la verda todo nuevo y impecable
reviews.negative: Lamentablemente no tuvieron ningún tipo de amabilidad cuando llegue al piso, entiendo que hay políticas de entrada pero no darme las llaves hasta las 4 pm me pareció algo de mal gusto sin tener nadie ese día, llame un par de veces y me indicaron que la entrada era a las 4 pm así que no me quedó otra que esperar 4 horas en una panadería abajo a que me trajeran la llave ya que la llave está a 1 km de la propiedad , también el apartamento no tiene aire acondicionado lo que hace imposible dormir bien, mi recomendación es que pongan ventiladores ya que el calor es fatal junto a los mosquitos   es difícil dormir bien
reviews.response:
Dear Ralph.
Thank you for your feedback. We're glad to know that the property's location was convenient for you.
We are sorry to hear about any confusion regarding the key collection. The details for our standard self-check-in process were sent to you three days prior to your arrival. We were happy to make an exception to personally deliver the keys; however, as this was a last-minute request, we arranged it for 4:00 PM, which is our standard check-in time.
Regarding the air conditioning, our property listing correctly states that the unit is not equipped with AC. We always want our guests to be comfortable, and had we known of your discomfort, we would have been delighted to provide a fan to make your stay more pleasant.
Once again, we appreciate your comments. We wish you all the best and hope to welcome you back in the future.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Modrzejewska
reviews.positive: Bardzo fajne miejsce. Cisza i spokój za oknem. Całe wyposażenie jest nowe. Personel bardzo pomocny. Polecam
reviews.response:
Dear Modrzejewska,

Thank you for your kind feedback, it truly means a lot to us. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed your stay. Our team works hard to ensure every guest has a comfortable and pleasant experience, and your words are a wonderful reward for our efforts. We will be sure to share your comments with the team.
Wishing you all the best, and we look forward to welcoming you again in the near future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Erika
reviews.positive: Skvělá poloha a vybavení apartmánu. Vybavení je nové, vše čisté a perfektní.
reviews.response: Dear Erika. Thank you for your great review! We’re glad to hear you enjoyed the excellent location and the apartment’s new, clean, and perfect amenities. It was a pleasure to host you, and we hope to welcome you back soon! Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Alles in allem ein wunderbares Apartment in einer traumhaften Lage
reviews.positive: Toller Ausblick, gute Ausstattung alles war einfach wunderbar.

reviews.author: Justyna
reviews.title: Highly recommend this apartment! We had a wonderful, peaceful stay and would happily come back again.
reviews.positive: The location of the apartment is absolutely wonderful. It’s in a peaceful and quiet area, which made our stay very relaxing. The apartment is beautifully and comfortably furnished, and everything was very clean. We especially enjoyed the lovely swimming pool. Having underground parking was also a great convenience. Overall, we had a fantastic stay and would definitely recommend this apartment!
reviews.negative: There was nothing we didn’t like about our stay. We did, however, have one small issue upon arrival: the keys to the apartment had not been left in the key box by the previous guests. Fortunately, we were able to get in touch with the apartment management, who arrived promptly and resolved the problem. Everything was handled very efficiently, so it didn’t have a significant impact on our stay. As a small suggestion for the future, it might be worth checking that the keys are always returned to the key box after each guest’s departure.

reviews.author: Ramona
reviews.title: Olimme viikon ko. majoituksessa ja se tarjosi meille kaiken mitä toivoimme.
reviews.positive: Loistava sijainti, rauhallinen, siisti ja asunnosta löytyi kaikki tarvittava. Mieletön näköala ja erittäin ystävällinen palvelu!

reviews.author: Sabine
reviews.positive: Perfekt, toll eingerichtet, alles da, was man braucht!
reviews.negative: Nichts

reviews.author: Renato
reviews.title: Es war für uns einfach Traumhaft schön.
reviews.positive: Die Ausstattung war sehr gut und es ist sehr  gemütlich im Apartment, unbezahlbar ist die Aussicht mit Sonnenuntergang 😎
reviews.negative: Wir mussten viel zu früh wieder abreisen

reviews.author: Heiko
reviews.title: Alles toll
reviews.positive: Lage traumhaft, Camara de Lobos-schöner Ort. Ruhige Lage

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Très belle expérience, splendide!
reviews.positive: Vue magnifique, très propre et tranquille. Sécuritaire bien localisé
reviews.negative: Rien, tout était parfait

reviews.author: Gabriele
reviews.title: Geräumiges Apartment mit tollem Meerblick
reviews.positive:
Das Apartment ist sehr geräumig mit einer tollen Aussicht direkt aufs Meer. Große Fenster, alles ist sehr hell und lichtdurchflutet. Die offene Küche ist schön und biete Meerblick beim Kochen. Küchengeräte prima, ebenso wie Waschmaschine.
Im apartment sind jede Menge Einbauschränke, mehr als genug Platz und Kleiderbügel um alles prima zu verstauen.
Tiefgarage ist ein plus obwohl auch vor dem Apartmentgebäude Parkplätze verfügbar sind.
Man ist zu Fuß (entlang der Straße) in wenigen Minuten an zahlreichen Cafés und Restaurants. Die Anlage ist noch recht neu und sehr gepflegt.
reviews.negative:
Bei fast 4 Wochen Aufenthalt keine Reinigung trotz Anfrage. Es gab keinen 2ten Satz Bettwäsche, wir haben die Bettwäsche und Handtücher selbst gewaschen und mussten darauf hoffen das alles nach ein paar Stunden trocken ist. Bei Ankunft keine Kaffeekapsel und weder Mülltüten noch WC Papier in Reserve. Es gab ein Spültuch, ein Schwamm und Spülmittel in der Küche, Tücher und Reinigungsmittel für Bad, Küchenreiniger, Waschmittel, etc haben wir selbst gekauft.  Kein Föhn vorhanden, laut Beschreibung sollte es einen geben. Trotz mehrfacher Nachfrage wurde keiner gebracht., wir waren schon froh dass wenigstens die Pfannen in der Küche nach mehrfacher Nachfrage getauscht wurden, die vorhandenen waren beim besten Willen nicht mehr zu brauchen. Wegen des Föns und der Reinigung haben wir irgendwann aufgegeben und uns selbst organisiert. Sehr schade dass anscheinend kein großer Wert auf die Pflege des Apartments und die Zufriedenheit der Gäste gelegt wird.
Leider passen Preis und Leistung hier nicht zusammen.
reviews.response:
Dear Gabriele.

Thank you for your detailed review and for taking the time to describe your stay. We’re very pleased to know that you enjoyed the spaciousness of the apartment, the sea views, the natural light, the well-equipped kitchen, the storage space, and the convenient location. It’s also great to know that you appreciated the underground parking and the overall condition of the building.

We would like to clarify that this is a self-catering property. As such, items such as additional cleaning services during the stay, replacement bed linen, extra towels, coffee capsules, garbage bags, cleaning products, and laundry detergent are not included unless specifically stated in the listing. Guests are expected to manage these aspects themselves, which is standard for self-catering accommodations.

Concerning the hairdryer, we can confirm that there is a hairdryer in the apartment, and this was personally checked while you were staying at the property.

We also addressed the issue with the pans as soon as possible and replaced them accordingly.
We’re sorry that the stay did not fully meet your expectations, but we believe the apartment was accurately described and provided according to the self-catering standard. We do appreciate your feedback and are glad that, despite these points, you were able to enjoy many aspects of the apartment during your stay.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Tereza
reviews.title: Úžasné prostredie oen služby by mohli byť o niečo lepšie
reviews.positive: Výhľad bol úžasný, krásný nový byt. Veľké pozitívum aj privátne parkovanie. Určie by sme sa radi vrátili. Bol to úžasný zážitok.
reviews.negative:
Vylepšila by som vybavenie, veľa vecí sme si museli dokupovať. Napríklad mi prišlo extrémne málo 2 toaletné papiere pre 2 osoby na 8 dní, žiadne náhradné sáčky do koša koré sme museli dokupovať. Taktiež by potešilo keby sú ku kávovaru a práčke aspoň 2 kapsule aby človek hned po príchode nemusel riešiť nákupy. 
Najviac ma sklamal priplatený darčekový kôš, korého skutočná hodnota bola maximalne 20€ ( videli sme ceny v obchodoch).

reviews.author: Herbert
reviews.title: Super Irlaub mit super Appartement!
reviews.positive: Räume waren super. Die Ausstattung sehr modern, neuwertig und praktisch. Balkone und Mobiliar super!!! Ausblick toll. Sehr ruhig rundherum. Eine top Unterkunft ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Joan
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: Excelente

reviews.author: Jazzmine
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: We had a lovely time staying here. Amazing view and lots of space. The washer was awesome to have. Just a bit noisy on the street next to us and a little farther away from the downtown area of Funchal. Parking space was hard to fit the car in there. Otherwise we had a very nice time!

reviews.author: Laurence
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment: Amazing view from the balcony! The apartment was clean and well located, about a 15-minute walk from restaurants and the main attractions. The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Even though there’s no air conditioning, we were perfectly comfortable during the hot weather with the windows open. We really enjoyed our stay!

reviews.author: Ina
reviews.positive:
Mooi appartement, schoon en ruim van opzet. Alles perfect geregeld. 
Alleen heel erg jammer dat er voor het complex een nieuw appartementencomplex wordt gebouwd. 6 dagen van de week in het lawaai van het te bouwen complex gezeten. Jammer dat het niet is vermeld

reviews.author: Fernando
reviews.title: Très beau séjour sur cette magnifique île de Madère
reviews.positive:
Bel appartement, bien ensoleillé et une belle vue sur la mer.
Petite suggestion : une bouteille d’eau ou autre de bienvenue serait idéal à notre arrivée de l’aéroport.
reviews.negative: Petit bémol, travaux sur immeuble juste en face générants des réveils dès 8 h00 du matin

reviews.author: Vladimir
reviews.negative: The front of our balcony was a new building under construction, which was noisy the whole day.

reviews.author: Olesia
reviews.negative: Very disappointing experience. Our booking was cancelled on the day of arrival, and nobody informed us in advance. We only found out when we arrived, which completely ruined our plans. Very poor communication and unprofessional management — would not recommend. Furthermore we need to call to booking by ourselves to cancel this accommodation in order to return money

reviews.author: Grete
reviews.title: Fantastisk opphold!
reviews.positive: Nydelig utsikt, og veldig flott leilighet! Den sto virkelig til forventningene.
reviews.negative: Litt forsinket beskjed om at nøklene skulle hentes på et annet sted. Men de var veldig behjelpelig å kom med nøklene til oss! Litt langt til nermeste dagligvare når vi ikke hadde bil.
reviews.response:
Dear Guest.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.
We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment and that it met your expectations. We always send the check-in information a few days before our guests’ arrival, as we did in your case, to allow time to prepare for check-in. Since you have not taken note of this information, we were more than happy, since we were available, to personally bring you the keys and ensure a smooth arrival.

The property is located in a residential area, and while renting a car is not mandatory, we usually recommend it to give our guests more freedom to explore the surroundings comfortably.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be delighted to welcome you again in the future.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Mihael
reviews.positive: We loved the apartment, great view, very beautifully furnished, we had everything we needed, we cooked every day and had all the esential dishes, even oil, salt and pepper, we even got shower gel in each bathroom. It was nice that we just had to collect the keys at their HQ and didn't need to strictly follow the hour we said we would arrive and when we left, we just left it on the table. We received video instructions how to get there one day in advance, which was amazing. It's nice to have own garage and parking spot, because parking can be a bit difficult on steep roads if you're not used to it. If you have a car like we had, it's a perfect location, because everything is near, we drove the whole island while having this location as base and never had to drive for more than 1 hour to get to the sights. We would definetly return and stay here longer.
reviews.negative: Next to the apartments some constructions are in progress, so it can get loud during the day, but the workers didn't start until 8h and usually finished before we retured (before 18h). You need to watch out for the neighbours bellow; we acidentally droped some small parts of mud when cleaning pants, that somehow landed on their balcony and in return they swept them and then threw them at our doorstep along with some soil they collected from the construction site and threw them on our car. The road to the apartments is steep, so if you're not comfortable with steep terrain, you could experience some problems, but we didn't have any problems with that.

reviews.author: Viktoria
reviews.title: Ohne die Baustelle wäre es eine perfekte Unterkunft.
reviews.positive: Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Besonders der Blick vom Balkon hat uns gefallen.
reviews.negative:
Etwas umständlich war der Check-in: Bei unserer Ankunft um 18 Uhr war die Reinigung noch nicht abgeschlossen, sodass wir etwa eine Stunde warten mussten. Auch die Schlüsselabholung im Büro war für uns etwas unpraktisch, da wir das Auto erst am nächsten Tag gemietet haben.
Während unseres Aufenthalts gab es zudem tagsüber (ca. 8–19 Uhr) Bauarbeiten direkt vor dem Haus. Dadurch war es recht laut, sodass man nicht ausschlafen konnte und das Frühstück auf dem Balkon manchmal schwer zu genießen war.

reviews.author: Beata
reviews.positive: Beautiful apartment. Spacious, airy, with a lovely view from the balcony. It immediately felt like home. My partner and I loved staying there. Well-made instructions for check-in and check-out. Everything was great. Thank you.
reviews.negative: If I were really to find something, it would be the placement of the towel hangers in the bathroom — they are not in the most convenient spot, as it’s easy for the towels to get wet while showering.

reviews.author: Nora
reviews.positive: A szállás szebb, mint a képeken. A tisztaság és a felszereltség is kitűnő. A legnagyobb + pont a saját parkoló, garázsban.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Beautiful accommodation even better than in the pictures. Would stay here again without a doubt. Responsive hosts who helped with minor issues. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Adnan
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
It was a great place to stay 7 days, everything needs were available and clean, 
Sure i will reserve it again.

reviews.author: Andreas
reviews.positive: Die Aussicht war ok und auch die Bushaltestellen vor der Tür für eine Fahrt nach Funchal war sehr praktisch. In der Nähe gab es fußläufig einen "Strand" und mehrere Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
reviews.negative:
Das Haus bzw. und vor allem der Balkon lagen an einer durchaus stark befahren Straße.
Viele Nachbarn hatten lautbellende Hunde auf den Balkonen. Eine Dusche war undicht... Wasser lief in das Badezimmer und im anderem Bad ließ sich die Duschbrause nicht fixieren.

reviews.author: Viktorija
reviews.title: Nuostabu!
reviews.positive: Vaizdas pro langą - nuostabus.
reviews.negative: Šiek tiek nepatogi lova.

reviews.author: Sylwia
reviews.title: Nie na 4 gwiazdki
reviews.positive:
Dobra lokalizacja do dalszych wycieczek i zwiedzania wyspy 
Bliskość różnych restauracji
Widok i dostęp do oceanu 
Własne miejsce parkingowe w garażu podziemnym 
Dobry kontakt z obsługą
Samodzielne zameldowanie i wymeldowanie 
Dobrze wyposażoną kuchnia
reviews.negative:
Łazienki - standard znaczenie odbiega od 4 gwiazdek.
Brudne fugi, niedoczyszczone płytki w kątach
Woda przecieka przez przestrzeń między brodzikiem a ścianką i ląduje na podłodze pod umywalką 
Sama ścianka ma ubytki w fudze i jest porośnięta żółtym brudem, kamieniem 
Odpływ się zatyka
Zasłonka prysznicowa nieświeża, brudna na dole
W kuchni aby otworzyć lodówkę należy zamknąć drzwi
reviews.response:
Dear Sylwia.

Thank you for your detailed feedback and for highlighting the apartment’s location, amenities, and overall convenience. We are pleased to know you enjoyed these aspects of your stay.

Regarding your concerns, we would like to clarify that this is a self-catering property and not a hotel, and therefore it does not follow hotel specifications, even though we do have high standards. That said, the apartment is thoroughly cleaned and inspected between each stay to ensure it is prepared for incoming guests.

We would also like to note that no issues were reported to us upon your arrival or during your stay. Had we been informed at the time, we would have been more than happy to promptly check the apartment and address or adjust anything necessary to ensure your comfort.

Thank you once again for your feedback, which helps us to continuously improve.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Natascha
reviews.title: Tolles appartement
reviews.positive: Tolle Lage mit Blick aufs Meer. Parkplatz in der Tiefgarage - die ist etwas eng aber es gibt auch viele kostenfreie Plätze an der Straße. Bushaltestelle vor der tür. Redtaurants und kleiner supermarkz fussläufig erreichbar. Wohnung ist super ausgestattet, mit allem was man im Urlaub brauchen kann. Kommunikation mit dem Besitzer war sehr unkompliziert und freundlich. Schlüssel wird über einen Schlüsselkasten an der Tür bereitgestellt. Grosse Zimmer, bequeme betten.

reviews.author: Waldemar
reviews.title: Very spacious apartment with an amazing view, great base for exploring
reviews.positive:
An incredible ocean view from the balcony. Watching the sunrises was a real pleasure.
​The apartment was very spacious, clean, and well-equipped. The kitchen had everything we needed to prepare meals.
​Great location – a quiet neighborhood, yet close (about a 1 km walk) to the beach, grocery stores, and several good restaurants.
​An excellent base for exploring Funchal and the entire eastern part of Madeira.
​A big plus for the detailed instructional video regarding check-in, which we received before arrival. It made the self-check-in process very easy.
reviews.negative:
We noticed the presence of clothes moths in the apartment, which was the only serious downside of our stay.
The mattresses were very hard. It didn't bother us too much in the end, but it did slightly reduce the sleep comfort.
In the evenings, it was sometimes loud due to dogs barking on neighboring balconies.
We did not receive instructions on how to use the underground parking. Fortunately, there was external parking available in front of the building, so it wasn't a major problem.
It's worth knowing that the apartment is located on a hill, so returning from the promenade or the store always involves an uphill walk (although it's not very demanding).

reviews.author: Simone
reviews.title: Trascorso un ottimo soggiorno, in generale consigliato.
reviews.positive: Appartamento molto grande e accogliente, fornito e disposto molto bene. Servizi eccellenti. Dispone di Due bagni comodi. Posizione buona che permette di raggiungere i vari punti più importanti dell’isola in non troppo tempo. La vista sulla terrazza incantevole
reviews.negative: Materassi dei letti un po’ troppo duri. Il pavimento scricchiolava in alcuni punti dando un leggero fastidio di notte.

reviews.author: Blanka
reviews.positive: Dobra lokacija za ogled otoka z avtom. Prostoren in čist apartma. Parkiranje v garaži. Blizu plaže, vendar je to Madera, kar pomeni da je apartma na hribu.

reviews.author: Cristina
reviews.title: 100% Recommending it
reviews.positive:
Booked this accommodation last minute and loved it since the beginning! The company managing it are all very nice and friendly. They answered all my questions and helped me surprise my partner upon arrival! They even send me a video showing me how to access and get the keys of the flat and parking, very well explained and really appreciated! The apartment has all someone needs, it is large and you can feel like home with no time!
We would definitely stay again if we were going back to Madeira :) thanks so much for all your help, you really helped us make our experience in the island be a 10/10
reviews.negative: The location was good, but could not really walk to many places.

reviews.author: Constantinos
reviews.title: Great place, suggest renting a car (because it has a garage)
reviews.positive: Great place for the price as well, It had everything you could ever need even a washing machine. Also the kitchen had everything which we used .

reviews.author: Maciek
reviews.title: Jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni. Będziemy to miejsce polecać znajomym.
reviews.positive: Apartament był bardzo wygodny, przestronny. Wyposażenie kuchni spełniało wszystkie wymagania. Posiada bardzo dobre położenie z pięknym widokiem na Ocean. Miło było pić kawę poranna z takim widokiem. Drobne niedogodności, ale praktycznie od ręki załatwiane przez obsługę. Bardzo dobry kontakt.
reviews.negative: Mimo miejsca parkingowego w hali garażowej (dosyć wąskie miejsce), rzadko z niego korzystaliśmy, ale są bezpłatne parkingi przed budynkiem, więc nie ma problemu. Pieski u sąsiadów balkon niżej po przekątnej trochę szczekały, bo zazdrościły kolegom wyprowadzanym na spacer :)

reviews.author: Dylan
reviews.title: Solid, no complaints
reviews.positive: As it was a self check-in we didn't meet the hosts, but the communication through whatsapp was top notch. All the necessary information was provided in a timely and professional matter with very clear instructions of how to check in and out. All basic necessities were present in the apartment and the underground parking was very useful. The apartment was in a clean state and had a nice view of the ocean.

reviews.author: Akloul
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Great location and nice apartment, highly recommend

reviews.author: Haizea
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Un apartamento genial, muy limpio y ordenado. Sitio para repetir !

reviews.author: Myriam
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable.  Le logement est spacieux et propose une belle vue sur l océan.

reviews.author: Olga
reviews.title: Une végétation luxuriante des températures idéale ! Un très beau séjour !
reviews.positive:
Appartement calme, agréable propre et confortable.
Très bien situé, pas très loin du centre-ville et bien desservi avec les bus.
Centre commercial à 5mn à pieds. 
Piscine super sympa et très bien entretenu ! 
Serait-il possible de rajouter dés parasols !!
reviews.negative:
Indépendamment de l’établissement, Malheureusement impossible de faire une grasse matinée ! Sauf le dimanche. 
En effet un gros chantier à proximité avec ces 4 grues et ces tracto-pelles gâches la vue, et déclenche des nuisances sonores de 8h à 19h.
Il faut donc prévoir des activités dans la journée ! 
Attention pour la remise des clefs, il faut les récupérer en centre-ville avant. 
Nous avions déjà prévu le transport pour l’appartement avant d’avoir l’information, ce qui nous a fait faire un détour supplémentaire pour les récupérer !

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Amazing place, would definitely come back
reviews.positive: This was a fantastic place to stay. The pool was brilliant and very clean. It was close to the bus stop and the supermarket. 20 minutes walk away are the lido pools which we visited several times. It was amazing to be able to cook our own food and have lots of space
reviews.negative: The fan was not enough and I really struggled to sleep with the heat. Also we had to collect keys from far away in the middle of the night and we did not have a car, our taxi driver was not happy.

reviews.author: Bernadette
reviews.positive: Appartement très bien placé, bien équipé.☺️☺️
reviews.negative:
3 rues cernent l'immeuble droite, gauche, en dessous beaucoup de passages  voitures,  scooters, motos pollution et très bruyant😞 Et pas de chance un chantier construction d'immeubles tout près ce qui engendre encore beaucoup plus de  poussière qu'à la normale.
. Jamais pris un p'tit déj ou repas sur le super balcon , trop bruyant et poussiéreux dommage !! 
Bientôt il y aura plus vue mer les nouveaux immeubles cacheront ... 😔😔

reviews.author: Lydie
reviews.title: Séjour formidable.
reviews.positive: Les consignes d'accès étaient très claires et précises. Tout fonctionnait parfaitement. Appartement spacieux, très bien équipé et très propre. Tout était parfait.
reviews.negative:
Juste une petite odeur d'égout qui remontait par l'évier de la cuisine.
La piscine n'était pas chauffée, donc nous n'en avons pas profité.

reviews.author: Josi
reviews.title: Große Wohnung in Sao Martinho
reviews.positive: Schön große und saubere Wohnung, gut ausgestattet. Die Kommunikation mit dem Personal war schnell und einfach. Supermärkte, Restaurants und Strand sind schnell zu Fuß zu erreichen. Sehr genaue Anweisungen für den check-in erleichtern die Anreise.
reviews.negative: Die Toilettenspülung ging während des Aufenthalts zwei mal kaputt, was nervig war, aber schnell repariert wurde.

reviews.author: Silova
reviews.title: Iesaku,  blakus Fermosa pludmalei
reviews.positive:
Vieta laba, āri okeāns pamanāms skatoties pa diagonāli.
Patika īsi video ieraksti ar shēmu kā nokļūt apartamentos un pie baseina.
reviews.negative: Lai iekļūtu apartamentos, pēc atslēgām bija jābrauc pakaļ uz citu iestādi. Februāris, apartamentos vakaros un   naktīs auksts, bet bija papildus pledi, tie noderēja.

reviews.author: Madalina
reviews.title: Good overall but not having some basic things can impact your stay negatively
reviews.positive: Spatious, clean, cute view even if there are buildings in front
reviews.negative: No toiletries. No shower gel, only the soap to wash your hands. No detergent for the washing machine. Not even 1 capsule for the coffee machine, at least to be able to make your first coffee in the morning, before you get a chance to go to the supermarket. Uncomfortable pillows, very thin. Also, received a message on booking to allow people into the house to measure the bed?! That should be done AFTER the guests check out.
reviews.response:
Dear Madalina.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We appreciate your comments and are pleased to know that you found the apartment spacious, clean, and that you enjoyed the view.
Regarding the toiletries, we provide an all-in-one shower gel and shampoo, hand soap, and dishwashing detergent to help guests get started. As the apartment is a self-catering property, these items are provided in limited quantities at the beginning of the stay, while other consumables that are not mentioned in the listing are not included.

We understand that comfort is subjective, particularly when it comes to pillows and mattress firmness. Your comment regarding the pillows is noted, and if we receive similar feedback from other guests we will certainly review this and consider improving them.

Regarding the message about measuring the bed, we apologize if this caused any inconvenience. As we regularly have guests checking in and out, we try to organize maintenance and improvements as efficiently as possible. In this particular case, we were planning to improve the mattress and wanted to take the correct measurements in advance so that we could replace it as soon as possible. For that reason, we asked for your permission beforehand, as we would never enter the property without the guest’s consent.

Thank you again for your feedback.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Lucchi
reviews.title: Appartamento accogliente e confortevole con terrazzo vista mare
reviews.positive:
Posizione molto comoda in zona ben servita da autobus, bei supermercati nelle vicinanze, spiaggia raggiungibile anche a piedi.
Appartamento molto luminoso, accogliente, ben arredato, confortevole, cucina ben attrezzata. 
Al settimo piano ha uno splendido terrazzo vista mare su cui si può mangiare e prendere il sole.
reviews.negative:
Unico elemento negativo nel bagno è la tavoletta del water che è assolutamente da cambiare.
La zona è piuttosto trafficata, quindi si sente rumore, ma chiudendo le finestre si sta tranquilli.
Rumore durante i giorni lavorativi per i lavori di costruzione vicino a casa.
reviews.response:
Dear Lucchi.

Thank you for your detailed review. We are very pleased to know that you enjoyed the convenient setting, the nearby amenities, and the short walk to the beach. It’s also great to know that you appreciated the brightness, comfort, and overall features of the apartment, as well as the rooftop terrace and its sea view.

We would like to inform you that the bathroom issue mentioned has already been resolved, and the necessary replacement has been completed.

Regarding the surrounding noise, we appreciate your understanding, as this is related to external factors beyond our control. We also highlight that the nearby construction is mentioned in the property description, allowing guests to make an informed decision before booking.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: José
reviews.positive: Parfait
reviews.negative: Bruit des travaux

reviews.author: Susana
reviews.title: Senti-me em casa, perto de tudo!
reviews.positive: Gostamos da localização (perto de pastelaria, mini-mercado, farmácias, restaurantes, Fórum Funchal), vista do apartamento, piscina, poder usufruir de fogão, micro-ondas, máquina lavar roupa e loiça, etc.
reviews.negative:
Não gostei de ter de ir levantar as chaves do alojamento ao escritório (deslocação de cerca de 4,2km). Sugiro que as chaves sejam entregues pessoalmente no alojamento.
E o barulho das obras, perto do alojamento, apartir das 8h.

reviews.author: Tatiana
reviews.positive: nicely furnished apartment with fully equipped kitchen and allocated parking slot in the garage

reviews.author: Piekarska
reviews.positive: Lokalizacja, rozmiar mieszkania, udogodnienia
reviews.negative: Odbiór kluczy w zupełnie innej części miasta. Ze względu na prowadzone w pobliżu prace budowlane, w mieszkaniu było dość głośno.

reviews.author: Mieke
reviews.title: Verblijf was prima! Als je overdag veel in appartement bent dan kun je last van werkzaamheden in de buurt hebben.
reviews.positive:
Zwembad
Keuken, koelkast, wasmachine 
Slaapkamer
reviews.negative: We hadden het netter gevonden als we van te voren waren ingelicht over de werkzaamheden in de buurt.

reviews.author: Dace
reviews.positive: We loved our stay! Nice apartment, perfekt location, fantastic pool!

reviews.author: Rubén
reviews.title: Perfecto para familia con 2 hijos
reviews.positive: Todo en general. Se puede llegar a cualquier hora lo que da tranquilidad ante imprevistos en el viaje. Las estancias amplias y bien equipadas. La piscina grande y tranquila. Zona tranquila pero con restaurantes y supermercados cerca. Garaje incluido en el mismo edificio con fácil acceso y amplitud

reviews.author: Franck
reviews.positive: Les équipements sont au top. Parking sous-sol pour garer le véhicule. Je recommande cette location.
reviews.negative:
La boîte à clé pour le retrait du trousseau se trouve à environ 3 ou 4 kilomètres de la location.
C est pas trop pratique pour une arrve tardive

reviews.author: Alajmi
reviews.title: Bed bugs, bad smell from bathroom showers, no hot water in the showe, bad communication and management
reviews.positive: إحقاقا للحق، وصلنا الشقة كانت مرتبة و نظيفة و تقريبا فيها أشياء كثيره نحتاجها و تصميم نوعا ما جميل . اللوكيشن لا بأس فيه وفيه مسفط سياره . المكان عباره عن كومباوند و مأجرين فيه شقق. الدخول ذاتي تاخذ المفتاح من المكتب بلوكيشن مختلف و تروح الشقه
reviews.negative:
ولكن مافيه خدمة تنظيف غرف
اول ما وصلنا الحمام فيه رائحة سيئة جدا جدا و تواصلنا معاهم ارسلوا شخص يعالج المشكلة.
و الاهم من هذا كله السرير كان فيه حشرة بق الفراش bed bugs . و هذا الموضوع غير قابل للتفاوض او النقاش فيه طلبنا احد يشوف الموضوع و ارسلوا شخص كان بالبداية يكابر و يبين ان الموضوع عادي واحنا مكبرينه و طالبناهم يغيرون الفراش، و فعلا غيروه و لكن من الاساس المفروض ما يحصل هذا الموضوع مع شقة أخذناها بما يقارب 800 دينار كويتي !
و الشاور مافيه ماي حار ، اول يومين الماي كان نوعا ما مقبول و بعدها الماي صار جدا بارد و حاولنا نتواصل معاهم و ما عالجوا المشكلة و اهملوا  التواصل معانا .

طالبتهم بتعويض إقامتنا partial refund خصوصا ان نهائيا ما ارتحنا بالإقامة بسبب المشاكل هذي و تواصلت معاهم بالوتس اب ردوا علي ان راح نرسل طلبج للاداره و بعدها سوولي بلوك

تعامل سيء و أداره سيئة و في سكن ارخص من جذي و افضل.

‏From the very first night, there was a very bad smell coming from the bathroom. We contacted them immediately and asked them to send someone to deal with the problem.

‏More importantly, there were bed bugs in the bed. This is absolutely unacceptable and not something that can be negotiated. We asked them to send someone to inspect the situation, and they initially sent someone who told us that this was normal and that they would change the sheets and mattress. We did not accept this, because the basic solution should have been to replace the entire bed, rather than simply changing the sheets and mattress. This issue alone was unacceptable, especially considering that we paid approximately €800 for the apartment.

‏There was also no hot water in the shower. On the first two days, the water was only lukewarm, and afterwards it became completely cold. We tried contacting them several times, but they did not resolve the problem and eventually stopped responding to us.

‏We asked them for a partial refund, especially because we did not enjoy our stay due to these problems.

reviews.author: Isabelle
reviews.title: Parfait
reviews.positive:
Superbe appartement, tres bien équipé, très belle piscine sur la mer
Bien placé pour sillonner Madère

reviews.author: Anatoliy
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.positive:
The apartment is truly outstanding—spacious, beautifully renovated, and thoughtfully designed in a modern style. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
The owner is exceptionally attentive, welcoming, and helpful.
The beds are very comfortable, and the apartment is fully equipped with a washer-dryer, iron, kitchenware, and everything else you might need. Each room has its own wonderful terrace, which makes the stay even more enjoyable.
Private parking in the building is included in the price, which is extremely convenient.
The building itself is beautiful inside and out and is a pleasure to look at.
The location is excellent. There are countless restaurants within walking distance to suit every taste, the oceanfront is practically across the street, and the beach complex is just a short walk away.
Simply perfect!

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Polecam Maderę.
reviews.positive: Lokalizacja, układ pomieszczeń i wyposażenie.
reviews.negative: Brakowało podstawowych, drobnych elementów wyposażenia, tj. mydła w łazience, żelu pod prysznicem i płynu do mycia naczyń w kuchni. Dodatkowo express do kawy, super Nespresso tylko szkoda że na takie kapsułki których nie można kupić w markecie tylko w specjalistycznym sklepie. Poza tymi drobiazgami wszystko było na najwyższym poziomie.

reviews.author: Egri
reviews.title: We wish it was our home.
reviews.positive: Such an apartment is the best place anyone can ever rent. Without the doubt. I am almost sure that we will return to Madeira, but our schedule will depend on the apartment availability. Thats the only place we will agree to stay in next time, for it increases the overall  perfection of our memories.
reviews.negative: We didn't like that the time there run faster. 1 week in this apartment is like 1 day at home. And we really didn't like we have to leave.

reviews.author: Vera
reviews.title: Alles perfekt, absolut empfehlenswert.
reviews.positive:
Sehr netter Empfang und Schlüsselübergabe, gute
Kommunikation, alle sehr hilfsbereit. Sehr schönes und gut ausgestattetes sauberes Apartment mit schönem Meerblick aus allen Zimmern. Die Lage war perfekt, nahe am Meer und der Promenade, Bushaltestelle vor der Tür. Wir würden jeder Zeit dort nochmals einen Urlaub verbringen, alles war perfekt, vielen Dank, 
Vera

reviews.author: Alexander
reviews.positive: Everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Malgorzata
reviews.title: Cudowny
reviews.positive: Przepiękny, przestronny apartament, dokładnie taki, jak w opisie i na zdjęciach. Poziom można śmiało określić jako luksusowy.
reviews.negative: Nie było niczego takiego.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.positive: Da localização, da casa, da vista.
reviews.negative: É necessário investir em ar condicionado ou, no mínimo, ventoinhas nos quartos.

reviews.author: Ilse
reviews.positive: Mooi ruim vakantiehuis, alles prima in orde.  Goede ligging om uitstappen te doen, je hebt wel een auto nodig, maar die heb je sowieso nodig op Madeira.
reviews.negative: De matrassen waren niet fantastisch, mensen met rugproblemen moeten hier zeker rekening mee houden.

reviews.author: Maltseva
reviews.title: Ідеальне розташування для відпустки на Мадейрі, подорожей по острову.
reviews.positive: Ідеальне розташування для проживання на острові, подорожей. Приголомшливий захід сонця, вечірнє та нічне освітлення навколишніх гір до узбережжя океану. Кращого вигляду з вечора до ранку я не бачила. Будинок відповідає всім моїм можливим бажанням. Дякую господарям за створененя спокою, затишку, всім зручностям! Особлива подяка за джакузі! Наша орендована машина була постійно на подвір'ї, тобто без зайвих переживань. Дуже близько є супермаркет, в якому ми закуповували рибу, креветки, м'ясо, овочі, фрукти, алкогольні та безалкогольні напої. Це був незабутній відпочинок. Сподіваюсь ще раз зупинитися саме тут.
reviews.negative: Хотілося б трошки кращого інтернету. Але це не погіршило нашого настрою.

reviews.author: Pierre-olivier
reviews.positive: Bon emplacement + place de parking. Bonne communication. Logement très spacieux.
reviews.negative: Réservation début mars, il faisait un peu frais dans le logement. Un chauffage dans la salle de bain pourrait être un ajout bienvenu.
reviews.response:
Dear   Pierre-Olivier.

Thank you for your kind feedback. We are pleased to knowthat you appreciated the convenient location, parking availability, communication, and the spaciousness of the accommodation.

Regarding the temperature, we would like to clarify that the property is now equipped with heaters to provide additional comfort when needed, thank you very much for your feedback.

We appreciated your suggestion and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Gadi
reviews.positive:
Clean and new
Great location
reviews.negative:
No AC
Need to fix shower locker
More pillows for the bed please

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Szép,modern, tiszts szállás, panorámával, mélygarázzsal.
reviews.positive: Szép, modern, tiszta szállás, panorámával, mélygarázzsal.
reviews.negative: A szomszédban építkezés folyik, 8 órától dolgoznak, de ez bennünket nem zavart!

reviews.author: Posch
reviews.title: Unglaubliche Wohnung mit fantastischem Ausblick und Tiefgaragenparkplatz!
reviews.positive: Unglaubliche Wohnung mit fantastischem Ausblick und Tiefgaragenparkplatz!
reviews.negative: Es gab nur eine große Decke im Bett, die Pölster waren für uns nicht so bequem, es wäre praktisch gewesen, wenn es ein paar Kapseln für die Kaffeemaschine bereits in der Wohnung gewesen wären.

reviews.author: Dora
reviews.title: Spacious ocean haven
reviews.positive: The apartment is spacious and thanks to the lots of windows, quite bright. It has a huge terrace with a breathtaking panorama to the ocean. The pictures about it make absolutely justice. The location is perfect, close to the airport and even providing a parking space in the garage. The agency was available when needed, responsive and helpful. The check-in and check-out was smooth thanks to their creative guidance provided online and in advance.
reviews.negative: Lamentably, the construction next to it was still ongoing, hence we couldn't enjoy the terrace without spectators, furthermore using the curtains was also essential for the sake of our privacy. We were here in late April, the weather some days a bit chilly, but the central heating was already turned down. Compared to all the accommodations we stayed during our trip to Madeira and Sao Miguel, there's still some room to develop regarding amenities (eg. detergent provided for the washing machine, coffee capsules for all morning etc).

reviews.author: Gabriela
reviews.positive: Apartamentul este spațios și echipat cu tot ce este nevoie, are priveliște la ocean și parcare privată la subsol.
reviews.negative: În apartament a fost rece , ar trebuie să existe și o sursă de căldură în apartament ( noi am călătorit în Madeira la începutul lunii Martie când temperaturile au fost între 13-15 grade ).

reviews.author: Denis
reviews.title: Эту квартиру нужно привести в порядок
reviews.positive:
Квартира просторная, если почистить и нормально оборудовать то будет прекрасным вариантом.
Нам разрешили выехать на час позже, это приятно, поэтому ставлю 6 баллов вместо 5.
reviews.negative:
За квартирой совсем не следят.

Очень грязные полы, носки были черные после 1 минуты пребывания в квартире. Тапочек в квартире нет, пришлось сразу поехать покупать за свои деньги, тем более что в квартире большая трасса и для неё всё равно нужна отдельная обувь. Конечно сперва думали просто помыть полы, но когда нашли швабру эта идея сразу отпала, тут почему-то пользуются маленькой старой шваброй которой конечно невозможно ничего вымыть, советую управляющей компании вложиться во что-то типа Ultramax Complete Set box.

Посудомоечная машина сломана, посуда остаётся грязная.

Стиральная машина плохая, не смогла отстирать даже носки которые мы в этой же квартире испачкали.

Необоснованно жадное предоставление расходников. Мы вдвоем приехали на 2 недели, в квартире было 2 рулона туалетной бумаги (по 1 рулону на каждый туалет), для посудомойки было примерно 5 таблеток, для кофемашины не было ни одной капсулы.

В квартире есть огромная терраса, к сожалению конкретно в январе ей достаточно сложно пользоваться потому что солнце активно светит по всей площади террасы на протяжении всего дня. Возможно в другие времена года когда солнце не так низко находится на террасе комфортнее.
reviews.response:
Dear Denis,

Thank you for your feedback, we appreciate you taking the time to share your experience, as it helps us continue improving our service.
We are pleased to know that you enjoyed the spacious apartment and found the late check-out convenient. We always do our best to ensure our guests feel comfortable and well accommodated.
We understand your concerns. However, none of the issues mentioned were reported during your stay. Had we been informed, we would have been more than happy to assist you immediately. Regarding the washing machine and dishwasher, we have since inspected both and confirmed that they are functioning normally, as they were prior to your arrival. We would also have gladly explained how to use them if requested. Please note that an instruction manual is available in the property for guests’ convenience.
Concerning toilet paper, as this is a self-catering property, we provide an initial supply only. That said, had you let us know during your stay, we would have been happy to provide additional supplies. The same applies to dishwasher tablets, which are not included as part of the self-catering arrangement; any found in the property are typically left behind by previous guests.
We are also sorry to know that the sun on the terrace affected your enjoyment, and we regret that this impacted your experience.

Thank you once again for your feedback. We will take your comments into consideration as we continue to improve. We wish you all the very best.

reviews.author: Michał
reviews.title: Christmas holidays with family (12 days)
reviews.positive:
The property provided everything you would expect at this price point. Very comfortable and well-appointed. A huge plus is the underground parking space and the large balcony with an ocean view.

Even though we were there in the second half of December, there were no issues at all with humidity or low temperatures, which can sometimes happen in Madeira.
reviews.negative: The only downside is an unpleasant smell occasionally coming from the toilet, but this is clearly an issue with the building’s plumbing rather than the apartment itself.

reviews.author: Beatriz
reviews.title: Apartamento muito confortável, bem decorado e super limpo! Recomendamos, sem sombra de dúvida!
reviews.positive: Foi o melhor apartamento onde já ficámos! Muito bem decorado, tudo limpo e arrumado! Ótimo para uma estadia na Madeira! A vista para o mar é maravilhosa! Ter garagem deu-nos muito jeito, utilizámos sempre.
reviews.negative:
Não tínhamos panos de cozinha.
Poderiam colocar apenas mais toalhas à disposição 🙂

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Amazing view and very comfortable apartment
reviews.positive:
The apartment provide a amazing view on the sea
Very comfortable apartment and the garage place is very useful if you rent a car. What we did and you are about 10 minutes drive from FunchalDrive. We stayed a week and it was not a problem to visit the island from this place
reviews.negative: Need to know that they are building apartments close to our apartment. They start at 8 am in the morning and finish around 6 pm from Monday to Saturday. For us it was not a problem as we were moving all those days.

reviews.author: Maksym
reviews.positive: Modern, new apartment with everything you need.
reviews.negative: Construction building near by

reviews.author: Raul
reviews.positive: Totul la superlativ, recomand!

reviews.author: Coen
reviews.title: Prachtig huis op rustige locatie
reviews.positive: Een prachtig huis op een mooie locatie met uitzicht over de oceaan. Het huis is van alle gemakken voorzien (zelf elektrische gordijnen, wat enigszins over the top is). Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van een warmtepomp en zonnepanelen, wat in het begin betekende dat we even op warm water moesten wachten, maar dat was alleen de eerste dag. Het is ongeveer 50 minuten van Funchal en ruim een uur van het vliegveld. Lekker rustig, maar alles wel goed bereikbaar.
reviews.negative:
De communicatie vanuit de beheerders gaat via standaard mails en er is geen persoonlijke ontvangst. Zo kregen we drie of vier keer een geautomatiseerde mail met de vraag of we (à € 45,00 per dag) het zwembad wilden laten verwarmen, ook nadat we al gelijk geantwoord hadden dat dat niet nodig was. 

Ook simpele dingen als het regelen van de betaling van de toeristenbelasting wordt niet gedaan. Of voldoende vuilniszakken en iets om de boel een beetje schoon te houden (geen tussentijdse schoonmaak immers). Dat moet je dus nog zelf aftikken / regelen. Geen ramp, maar het zijn juist ook dit soort kleine dingen die het verschil maken tussen een goede en een topervaring.

reviews.author: Ulf
reviews.title: Fin utsikt och välskött hus. Dock är underhållet inte optimalt då allt inte fungerar.
reviews.positive: Fantastisk utsikt. Tyckte om huset och läget. Rent och välutrustat.
reviews.negative: En anledning till att vi valde huset var poolen och att det fanns poolvärme eftersom vi var där i slutet av januari. Den kostnaden betalde vi i förhand men då vi var på plats fungerade inte poolvärmen. Duschen i master sovrummet gick inte att använda då termostaten var sönder. Vi påtalade detta så fort det upptäcktes och man sa att man skulle titta på det. Vi fick ingen feedback och det gick inte att få kontakt med uthyrarna varken via telefon eller mail. Efter hjälp via Booking fick vi återbetalt kostnaden för poolvärmen.
reviews.response:
Dear Ulf.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad to know that you enjoyed the fantastic view, the house, its location, and that you found it clean and well-equipped.

Regarding the master bedroom shower, as soon as you reported the issue, we visited the property and resolved it while you were there.

For the heated pool, there was an unexpected problem with the water heating pump that unfortunately could not be fixed during your stay. We understand this was disappointing, and immediately, we refunded the full amount for this service. We truly appreciate your understanding and patience.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future under better circunstances.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Eveline
reviews.title: Heel fijn huis, lekker rustig gelegen. Alles netjes inorde. Contactloos inchecken ging heel handig
reviews.negative: Douches werken niet optimaal

reviews.author: Duffau
reviews.positive:
La cuisine bien equipee
La terrasse
Le jacuzzi
reviews.negative: La literie dure

reviews.author: Gildas
reviews.title: Presque parfait
reviews.positive:
Appartement grand, propre et bien placé.
On n'a pas utilisé le jacuzzi, donc pas d'avis dessus.
reviews.negative: On a eu des petites fourmis à venir dans la salle de bain et la chambre et on est vite à court d'eau chaude, peut-être lié au manque d'ensoleillement pendant notre séjour.

reviews.author: Karolina
reviews.title: Serdecznie polecam, piękne miejsce w dobrej lokalizacji
reviews.positive: Widok, lokalizacja, taras

reviews.author: Diego
reviews.positive: Buenas vistas, piso amplio y cocina bien amueblada. La terraza muy comoda para el desayuno.
reviews.negative:
No había ni una triste botella de agua de cortesía. El jacuzzi no funcionaba y olía muchisimo a cloro. 
El acceso no es especialmente comodo. Los videos que facilitan para llegar estan bien explicados pero estaría bien que estuviese. Publicados para ver como es el acceso antes de reservar. Por esto mismo no hay donde cargar coche eléctrico.

reviews.author: Nathalie
reviews.title: Pas pu profiter du spa
reviews.positive: La vue, la grande terrasse
reviews.negative:
J’avais choisi cet établissement pour le spa, mais il s’arrêtait tout le temps durant le jour, donc quand on revenait le soir, on devait le repartir. La température de l’eau n’était jamais assez chaude pour en profiter.
Le personnel demandait tout le temps qu’on envoie des vidéos pour qu’on explique le problème. On avait l’impression qu’ils étiraient le temps.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.title: Super point de chute pour explorer tous les charmes de Madère. Vue magnifique
reviews.positive: Vue magnifique sur la vallée et la nature, aussi beau de jour que de nuit et bonus sur le coucher du soleil. Pas trop éloigné centre et proche axes principaux. Facile de se garer. Un peu atypique avec plantations de bananiers et quelques marches d’escaliers à descendre pour rejoindre le logement. Bonus du jacuzzi pour se détendre en fin de journée
reviews.negative: Pas très bien équipé, niveau accessoires de cuisine, pas de lave vaisselle. Couchage 2 un peu léger (canapé lit pas très confort et léger en linge). Manque des bains de soleil pour profiter pleinement de la terrasse. Environnement u. Peu bruyant (chiens aux alentours qui aboient en permanence). Jacuzzi arrêté passé une certaine heure sans intervention de notre part

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.title: Recomendable
reviews.positive: El apartamento es súper amplio, tiene todo lo necesario para pasar varios días. Limpio y mucha luz. El que tenga plaza de parking facilita mucho el salir y entrar de la ciudad. Volvería a repetir sin dudarlo.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.positive: Limpieza, garaje
reviews.negative: Para estancias de 8 días debería haber alguna toalla adicional a una por persona

reviews.author: Szabina
reviews.title: A szállás a hirdetésben látottaknak teljesen megfelelt, közel van a városközpont, van parkoló a mély
reviews.positive:
A szállás a hirdetésben látottaknak teljesen megfelelt, közel van a városközpont, van parkoló a mélygarázsban, rugalmasan segít a szállásadó. Tiszta, igényes apartman, jól felszerelt konyhával. 
Mivel tovább kellett maradnunk 1 nappal a rossz idő miatt, így a szállásadó rugalmasan megoldotta a szállás hosszabbítást.
reviews.negative:
Sajnos este 21 óra után alig van melegvíz a fürdőszobákban, így nehéz egy 4 fős családnak késő este zuhanyozni meleg vízben. Ezt a problémát jeleztem a szállásadónak is, de nem igazán sikerült megoldani. Tehát korán este fürödj le! :)
A helyi adó 2x lett levonva a bankszámláról, de ezt a szállásadó később korrigálta.

reviews.author: Maciej
reviews.title: Wszystko OK, tylko denerwowało mnie ciągłe nękanie o jakąś opłatę którą ponoć nie została pobrana, a według booking miał
reviews.positive: Duża przestrzeń.

reviews.author: Ivana
reviews.title: Definitely recommended!
reviews.positive:
Spacious, bright, and very comfortable apartment. It has two large bedrooms with comfortable beds and two separate bathrooms. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you might need, including a large fridge, washing machine and dryer, dishwasher, microwave, coffee machine, air conditioning, and a flat-screen TV.
Excellent location – very close to the city center (6 minutes by car or 12 minutes by bus). The bus stop with two direct lines to the center is only 150 meters away. It is also conveniently located near the express road exit, making it ideal for day trips to other parts of the island.
Despite the great connectivity, the area is quiet and peaceful, with a lovely view of the city. A small grocery store is located right next to the building.
A big advantage is the private garage parking space in a spacious garage with easy access, which is quite rare in Funchal.
The hosts were very kind and professional. Shortly before our arrival, we received all the necessary information for an easy check-in, including detailed video instructions, which were very helpful. Margarida from Atlantic Holiday was very caring and supportive. 
On the day we were supposed to return our rental car, the garage door malfunctioned. We informed the rental agency and Margarida took over further communication and handling the situation with rent-a-car agency.
We would definitely stay here again when returning to Madeira as the accommodation has fully met our expectations.
reviews.negative:
Some of the instructions were sent as duplicate messages (not sure if this is due to Booking.com or the accommodation), which made it a bit harder to keep track of all the emails. 
It would be helpful if the video instructions were shared a few days earlier. We had already arranged airport transfer to the accommodation in advance, and only through the video instructions did we learn that the keys are to be collected at a different location. As a result, we needed to adjust our transfer arrangements shortly before arrival.

reviews.author: Yelyzaveta
reviews.positive: Mieszkanie jest najlepsze na całej wyspie, z całego serca polecam wynajem! Duże pokoje, duża przestrzeń. Wygodne łóżka, oddzielna kuchnia, dwie łazienki, dwie sypialnie, dodatkowo salon z dużym telewizorem, bardzo dobrze wyposażone we wszystkie potrzebne sprzęty. Mieszkanie jest zadbane, ładne. Wygodny parking w garażu na dole. Doskonała lokalizacja! Do miasta jest bardzo blisko. Dodatkowo dosłownie z okna widać sklep i kawiarnie, również blisko restauracje. Polecam serdecznie!

reviews.author: Michal
reviews.positive: Hostitelé byly komunikativní a dali nám včas vědět, včetně instruktážního videa, které bylo nápomocné. Ubytování mělo velkou lednici a další kvalitní spotřebiče - mikrovlnku, pračku, TV aj., což se hodí při cestování nalehko. Velmi fajn bylo i parkovácí garážové stání (v garáží jsou docela poklady :)) Relativně blízko je obchod, jakkoliv jako všechno na Madeiře je to dost do kopce. Klimatizace byla taky fajn.
reviews.negative: Občas jsme se setkali s chuchvalci prachu a cesta ke kanceláři hostitele pro vyzvednutí klíče, který byl v boxu na exteriéru budovy, mi přišla zbytečná (aspoň to bylo rychlé). Křižovatka u ubytování, kde dáváte přednost je dost strmá, což může být pro někoho komplikace (za nás ok). Ocenili bychom dvě peřiny v rámci manželské postele.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Great and relaxing!
reviews.positive:
Excellent apartment! Very clean and with everything you could need! We felt very at home. 
Also great location - not far from the city where most things are. Would stay again! Catarina and Ana (hosts from Atlantic Holiday) were great and professional.
reviews.negative: When we left the property, we placed the key on the dining table as instructed. However, one of the hosts messaged us insisting - rather confidently - that we’d left the key behind a door that was apparently blocking access. That wasn’t the case, which made the message a little frustrating. Thankfully, the other hosts handled the situation with more professionalism and the door was somehow opened in the end. Apart from this, it was an excellent stay.

reviews.author: Ranjeet
reviews.title: Beautiful villa but sleepless nights
reviews.positive: Fabulous location for a few days in Machico, 4m walk from beach & restaurants (Massa Mia has an amazing espeteda), 7m to supermarket. Stylishly kitted out villa with all mod cons - aside from aircon! - which we really missed. One fan was provided, we requested 2 more and the team sent someone the next day but sadly only one given (they said the shops had sold out which I could well believe). I also found the mattress too hard to sleep on so spent the remaining 2 trying to sleep on the very narrow sofa, despite there being 2 extra beds they were all rock hard (only one softer mattress our of 4 which my friend took). If there had been aircon and a second softer mattress the villa would have been a 10.
reviews.negative: 3 sleepless nights due to sweltering heat and rock hard mattress. There was also very loud music from a neighbouring property (or disco/club?) all 3 nights berween 1-4am. Such a shame as rest of the facilities - tv streaming, lovely sun terrace, garden seating, outdoor kitchen and hot tub were excellent.

reviews.author: Th
reviews.title: Heerlijk familie huis!
reviews.positive: De ruimte in en rond het huis
reviews.negative: Niks

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.title: Jederzeit gerne wieder!!
reviews.positive: Die Lage ist perfekt! Wir hatten noch nie so ein toll ausgestattetes Apartment, vor allem die Küche und der extra Bereich zum Grillen. Die Kommunikation mit den Vermietern war tadellos, schnell und sie waren sehr entgegenkommend. Der Ort Machico ist sehr nett mit guten Restaurants und Strand und nicht so touristisch wie die Orte im Westen der Insel. Perfekte homebase für Wandern, Tauchen, Whale-watching. Wenn Madeira, dann sicher wieder in dieses Apartment.
reviews.negative: Die Straße zum Apartment ist sehr steil und eng, ist man aber nach dem zweiten Mal fahren gewohnt :-)

reviews.author: Silva
reviews.title: The perfect stay: great views, sunshine and food
reviews.positive: What was there not to like? PERFECT location, close to all the shops and the beach. It was very spacious and modern, with a lovely barbecue area. There was nothing we were lacking as they thought of everything. The gated car park made us feel super safe and one of the neighbours had a cute parrot outside that made sitting outside extra special. The communication was amazing and they left us a thoughtful welcome present. The purpose of the trip was to spend a mini break with my elderly mother who has a disability and the house was very accessible - highly recommend!
reviews.negative: We didn't dislike anything but it would've been helpful to have more information on using certain appliances e.g. in the kitchen and around where to put the rubbish. Also, extra pillows in the bedrooms would've been greatly appreciated. Unfortunately we didn't end up using the jacuzzi as we found it too out in the open given the house is very close to the neighbours. If it closer to the kitchen or car park area, it would've been better.

reviews.author: Kristel
reviews.positive:
Ruim en praktisch huis, nieuwbouw, alle faciliteiten aanwezig.,Wij hebben ook enorm genoten van de jacuzzi!
Service perfect: wasruimte met de wasmachine was gesloten. Na een berichtje werd dit direct opgelost.
Rustige omgeving, het geluid en overvliegen van de vliegtuigen vonden wij vermakelijk, niet storend.'s Nachts vliegen ze niet. Dichtbij strand, restaurants en winkels.

reviews.author: Régis
reviews.title: Maison tres centrale et vraiment fonctionnelle.
reviews.positive: Maison vraiment très bien située avec  accès Levadas, plage et supermarchés à pied  depuis la maison. Calme et stationnement facile. Excellent choix géographique dans une petite  ville  agréable et  proche  des  principaux  sites d' interet de c e  coté d e  l' ile, notamment  la pointe Est  à moins  de 15mn....un vrai luxe. Et la véranda  tres  appréciable  par  temps  venteux  et le  soir quand les  temperatures  baissent.
reviews.negative: Arrosage  à 14h  de la pelouse et du coup de la  table exterieure, à reprogrammer  donc.
reviews.response:
Dear Régis.

Thank you for your kind feedback. We are very pleased to know that you enjoyed the location, the surroundings, and the comfort of the outdoor areas.

Regarding the irrigation, it is normally scheduled to run during the night to avoid any inconvenience. We apologise for this situation and will verify what happened to ensure it is corrected.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Jan
reviews.positive: Klidné prostředí, dobrá dostupnost blízko centra města a letišté
reviews.negative: Zklamání ze zápachu odpadů v kuchyni a koupelně. Nejde to vyvětrat, museli jsme si dokoupit airfres. Nejsou k dispozici tablety do myčky.

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.title: I loved the stay so much
reviews.positive: Very clean and modern, small garden, grillhouse, jacuzzi - everything is amazing. Host is very quick to reply and help if needed. Good view, quiet surroundings. Private parking is a huge plus in Madeira!
reviews.negative: In second bathroom there is a humid smell that only goes away when window is open.

reviews.author: Lochmelis
reviews.positive: It's a wonderful house. It's equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. We loved everything about it, including its location 400 meters from the beach, the jacuzzi, and the children's love for it. We especially enjoyed the barbecue area. I would love to have a similar one in my home. There are sun loungers for relaxing and sunbathing. The owners have thought of everything.

reviews.author: Pascal
reviews.title: Spacious house, but challenges with facilities and privacy
reviews.positive: Spacious house
reviews.negative: Issues with ants, jacuzzi took more than 8 hours to warm up. Construction workers in the front yard, unpleasant smell on the toilet and bathroom. Not all issues were resolved during stay.

reviews.author: Björn
reviews.title: Great calm and quite Place in mountains of the north! A hidden gem.
reviews.positive: Ausstattung, Aufteilung des Hauses, Lage und Ausblick

reviews.author: Windrich
reviews.positive:
Sehr schönes, geräumiges Haus mit allem was man braucht. Die Betten waren sehr bequem. Der Garten mit Jacuzzi lässt sich gut nutzen, auch wenn es immer mal wolkig war.
Lediglich an die krähenden Hähne am Morgen musste man sich gewöhnen:)
reviews.negative: Die Couch war etwas unbequem.

reviews.author: Lynn
reviews.title: Mooi huis op een prachtige plek. Met mooie tuin
reviews.positive: Prachtig ruim huis. Met elke dag een andere zonsondergang. Heel behulpzaam personeel.
reviews.negative: Alles leuk

reviews.author: Emmanuel
reviews.positive:
Les chambres, les salle de bains et toilettes , la 
Laverie , équipement de cuisine correcte
reviews.negative:
L’éclairage de la hotte ne marche pas et pour faire la cuisine le soir on n’y voit rien 
Le grille pain fait disjoncter le compteur électrique instantanément donc inutilisable 
Le Sauna est bien mais il a fait disjoncter le compteur principal à l’extérieur de la maison donc on a arrêter les chauffages pour pouvoir l’utiliser.

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.title: Heel aangenaam
reviews.positive: Modern en nieuw, zeer gerieflijk en goed uitgerust
reviews.negative: Geurhinder van de badkamers op de verdiepingen en blaffende hond van de buren
reviews.response:
Dear Nancy,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are very pleased to know that you found the property modern, comfortable and well equipped.

We are sorry that the neighbouring dog caused some inconvenience during your stay. As this is an external factor, it is unfortunately outside our direct control, but we appreciate you bringing it to our attention. Regarding the unpleasant odour in the bathroom, we were not made aware of this during your stay. Had we known, our team would have been very happy to visit the property and look into the situation straight away to ensure you were as comfortable as possible.

We truly appreciate your excellent ratings and are glad that, overall, you had a pleasant stay with us. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Piotr
reviews.positive: Wyposażenie apartamentu było  bogate, w zasadzie wszystko co niezbędne było dostępne.
reviews.negative: Bliskość ulicy i hałas z niej dochodzący. Okna szczególnie jednej sypialni wychodziły na ulicę,  która niestety była głośna, co utrudnia spanie. Poza tym apartament miał obok dobudowany drugi budynek z osobnym apartamentem ale uwaga - oba dzieliły tylko zwykle wewnętrzne drzwi, przez co niestety jakbyśmy byli w jednym apartamencie z sąsiadami. O tym nie było ani słowa  w opisie. Poza tym tylko jedna sypialnia miała łazienkę przy sypialni, pozostałe łazienki były albo na półpiętrze albo na dole, co przy korzystaniu w nocy było uciążliwe.  Dodatkow w łazienkach czuć z kanalizacji i niestety drzwi w jednej  z sypialni sie nie dotykały - wypadała klamka.
reviews.response:
Dear Piotr,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We are pleased to know that you found the apartment well equipped and that everything necessary for your stay was available.

Regarding the exterior noise, the area is generally quieter at night, as there are no bars nearby. During the day, however, there may occasionally be some additional traffic and activity, as the property is located close to Cristo Rei, one of Madeira’s well-known tourist attractions.

Regarding the bedroom door handle, this was not reported to us during your stay, so unfortunately we did not have the opportunity to assist you with it at the time. As for the bathroom odour, when our team visited the property after check-out, no unusual smell was noticed. Nevertheless, we appreciate you bringing these points to our attention and will keep them under review.

We hope that, despite these aspects, you were still able to enjoy your time in Madeira.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Puķīte-čepule
reviews.positive: Overall, we really liked the house. It was comfortable, tastefully designed, and in a great location for easily exploring all of Madeira on a daily basis. However… there were a few downsides.
reviews.negative:
The hot water takes some time to start running, and the water pressure in the main shower is not very strong.

Apparently, I hadn’t read all the details carefully enough regarding the pool heating. After the non-refundable date, I received a specific message stating that pool heating costs €45 per day. In our case, that would have meant an extra €450, which is a significant amount. Unfortunately, during our 10-day stay, there wasn’t even an option to heat the pool for, say, 5 consecutive days.

While the kitchen was very well equipped with everything needed for cooking, another disappointing point was the outdoor grill. Nothing was provided to actually use it – no charcoal, no fire starters, etc. Perhaps this is common practice in this country.
reviews.response:
Dear Puķīte-Čepule.

Thank you for your detailed feedback and for your kind words about the house, its comfort, decoration, and location. We are pleased to know you enjoyed your stay overall.

Regarding your comments, we would like to clarify a few points. This is a self-catering property, and therefore certain items such as charcoal or fire starters for the barbecue are not provided, allowing guests to purchase and use supplies according to their own needs.

Concerning the pool heating, this information is clearly stated in the listing as an optional extra service, not included in the base price. It is entirely up to the guest to decide whether to add this service, and it is not mandatory.

With regard to the hot water, you did not reach out during your stay, and the system was checked at the time of your check-out, with no issues identified, we would have been happy to assist you while you were here to ensure bigger comfort.

Thank you once again for your feedback, which is important for us to continue improving.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Emilia
reviews.positive: Mieliśmy cały dom dla siebie. W każdym pomieszczeniu klimatyzacja. Dużym plusem był basen oraz garaż . Świetnie wyposażona kuchnia . W domu mieliśmy wszystko co było nam potrzebne. Przydała się pralka i lodówka z kostkami lodu. Uzyskaliśmy również pomoc przy wynajmie auta. Mogliśmy sobie porównać  oferty z trzech wypożyczalni. Polecam. Super kontakt i pełen profesjonalizm.
reviews.response:
Dear Emilia,

Thank you very much for your lovely review and for sharing such positive feedback about your stay. We are very happy to know that you enjoyed the house and that the facilities, from the pool and garage to the kitchen and appliances, contributed to a comfortable experience.

It is also amazing to read that our assistance with the car rental options was useful during your visit. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to Madeira in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Kathrin
reviews.title: Madeira ist wunderschön, doch diese Unterkunft würde ich nicht noch einmal buchen.
reviews.positive: Es ist modern eingerichtet, verfügt über einen großen Fernseher und eine Klimaanlage + Herzfunktion, Die Lage hat mir auch gut gefallen.
reviews.negative:
Leider stellten wir am ersten Tag Schimmelspuren auf den Dekorationspolstern am Bett fest, welches wir auch umgehend dem Team gemeldet haben. Es wurde nichts dagegen unternommen und im nachhinein wurde uns vorgeworfen, dass uns angeboten wurde, dass dieser Schaden beseitigt wird, aber wir es abgelehnt haben. Was nicht der Wahrheit entspricht. Uns wurde jegliche gesagt das dies mit dem Reinigungsteam geklärt wird. 
Noch dazu hat es während unseres Aufenthaltes auf Madeira sehr viel geregnet, wo dann gut ersichtlich war, dass die Fenster nicht ganz dicht waren. Es fühlte sich dauerhaft alles leicht feucht an inkl. unserer Kleidung und dem Bett und die Handtücher die wir zum trocknen aufhingen blieben ebenfalls feucht. 
Noch dazu stellten wir am letzten Tag einen Schimmelbefall des Blumentopfes fest, was dazu führte das ebenfalls, zwei unserer T-Shirts Schimmelspuren enthielten. Ist denk ich mal den undichten Fenstern verschuldet.
Ich hab dies alles der Unterkunft gemeldet, noch am Tag unserer Abreise (inkl. Fotos). Ich habe nach einem Preisnachlass gefordert und Entschädigung für unser beschädigtes Gewand - beides vergeblich. 
Uns wurde nur gesagt das wir ja abgelehnt haben, dass der Schaden beseitigt wird und es sich hier nicht um essenzielle Gegenstände handeltet und man sie hald einfach hätte entfernen können. Und da der Blumentopf ja schon von Anfang an geschimmelt hat, uns das aber zu spät aufgefallen ist, war es quasi unsere Schuld und ebenfalls das die T-Shirts beschädigt wurden, weil wir sie ja daneben gelegt haben. Wäre mir das Aufgefallen hätte ich natürlich NICHT dieses Gewand dort hingelegt!
Fazit, ich hab der Unterkunft die Chance gegeben, den Schaden zu beheben, bin immer sachlich und korrekt geblieben und Schlussendlich haben sie die meisten Tatsachen verdreht - wirklich sehr schade.

This apartment is TOTALY IMPOSSIBLE TO LIVE in. There is no sound isolation at all. I'm not a sensitive sleeper, regular street or building sounds do not bother me. Windows and doors at this apartment had to be replaced years ago, it's a shame to rent it out to people in such condition. 

We spent 1 night out of 8 we paid, and left with apartment. Owners refused to refund a single night out of the week we paid. They offered me earplugs (!), which they could deliver only in 2 days due to holidays, and which actually NEVER CAME. And after all, they kept demanding the outstanding $28 of city tax to be sent to their revolut account. 

This is the worst experience I had with renting through booking.com in years. We had to move out on 31st of December, cover a week of another accommodation, and kept totally useless correspondence with the administration. 
If this is the way the owners run their business, it won’t last long.
