reviews.positive: Die Unterkunft ist wirklich groß und gut ausgestattet. Trotzdem meiden.
reviews.negative:
Aktuell versuche ich über booking.com wenigstens einen Teil des Geldes zurückzubekommen. Leider ist die Unterkunft ein ziemlicher Blender. Wir haben zwei Tage lang in der Unterkunft keinen Strom oder nur teilweise Strom gehabt. Grund dafür, ist ein nicht fertig gebautes Haus. Wenn es regnet, sammelt sich scheinbar das Wasser und tropft dann stark aus dem Lampe im Hobbyraum. Das führt dazu, dass die Hauptsicherung des Hauses rausfliegt. Kein Licht in den Bädern, keine Rollläden mehr benutzbar und kein Internet. Allgemein ist das Haus so natürlich nicht bewohnbar. Das beste an der Angelegenheit ist aber, dass es Anzeichen dafür gibt, dass die Eigentümer das Problem bereits kennen und trotzdem Urlauber anlocken, um denen das Geld aus der Tasche zu ziehen. Nachdem wir den Schaden gemeldet haben, passierte erstmal gar nichts. Am Ende wurden zwei Tage später einfach das Wasser weggewischt, die Tischtennisplatte, auf die das Wasser tropfte woanders hingestellt, und es tropfte immer noch aus der Lampe. Dafür war der Strom aber wieder aktiv. Ein wunderbares Gefühl, wenn man so schlafen geht und es sein kann, dass durch einen Kurzschluss vielleicht das Haus abfackelt. Zum Glück sind wir am nächsten abgereist. Da die Unterkunft einem auch nicht geschenkt wird, sind meine Ansprüche schon nicht gering, aber dass kein Wasser aus der Decke kommt und man den baulichen Mangel einfach verschweigt, um weiter Geld zu bekommen, ist ganz schwach... Die Anbieter denken sich wahrscheinlich: "Wenn es nicht regnet, kriegt auch keiner was mit! Ist ja sowieso nicht unser Urlaub!"

Unter diesen Umständen kann ich die Villa Zenha nicht empfehlen. Habe mich wirklich auf den Urlaub gefreut. Wer es nicht glaubt, ist alles auf Video :)

Über ein Teilstorno können wir gerne immer noch sprechen. Booking.com spielt übrigens auch den toten Mann. Wer glaubt, dass es irgendeinen Vorteil gibt in Sachen Ansprechpartner und Service, hat sich geschnitten.

reviews.author: Anastasiia
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment:
Overall, our stay was okay, but considering the price, we expected a bit more.
We especially liked the large terrace with a nice view. Having a washing machine and a dishwasher was also very convenient, and the host was responsive and answered our questions quickly.
However, the cleanliness was not at the level we would expect for this price. Some areas had clearly not been properly cleaned: the bathroom bin was dirty, and the terrace floor and table had crumbs and stains on them. There was also an old, dark dish sponge in the kitchen, which was quite unpleasant and should definitely have been replaced.
There was also some confusion regarding the tourist tax. We were asked to leave the tax in the apartment, but fortunately, I checked the invoice and noticed that it had already been paid.
Overall, the apartment was functional and had some nice features, but for the price, we expected better cleanliness and attention to detail.
reviews.response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re pleased to hear that you enjoyed the large terrace and view, found the apartment well equipped, and appreciated our quick communication.
We’re sorry that some aspects of the cleanliness did not meet your expectations. We have not previously received complaints regarding the cleanliness of the apartment, but we take your comments seriously and will discuss the points you mentioned with our cleaning lady to ensure greater attention to detail between stays.
Regarding the tourist tax, not all guests pay it directly through Airbnb, which is why we remind guests on arrival that, if it has not already been paid through the platform, it needs to be settled separately. We apologise if this caused any confusion.
Thank you again for your feedback. It helps us maintain and improve the standard we aim to provide for our guests.

Location is great, few minutes away there is beautiful beach with toiles, bar, showers, natural and normal pools. (you have to pay for entrance and umbrellas) very close huge shopping centre woth everything you might need, just beside the apartament great restaurants. Amazing coastal walk to beautiful fishermans village starts few steps away from apartament. You will
find everything you need in apartament as well.  Bus stop is just outside apartament as well.  Balcony views is just amazing.
reviews.negative:
There was unpleasant smell coming from one bathrooms. we kept it close, but you could still
get it a bit.

reviews.author: Constantin
reviews.positive: The only thing worth mentioning is the location.
reviews.negative: As soon as we arrive the whole apartment had an extremely bad odor. Something like a sewer backup smell, or even worse. I open all windows and doors, trying to create a draft, hopping the smell will go away, but it didn't help that much. I ended up buying air fresheners and toilet bowl cleaner. I try contacting the administrator, but didn't hear back for days, and even after that, no one showed up to check it out. Me and my daughter almost got sick with the smell and spent as little time possible in the apartment.
reviews.response:
Dear Constantin.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are sorry to know that you experienced an unpleasant odour during your stay. However, we would like to clarify that we did not receive any report regarding this matter while you were at the property. Our team remained available and responded to the communications received throughout the reservation.

During our inspection following your departure, we identified a localised source of the odour. The openings through which it was entering the apartment have since been properly sealed, and the issue has been fully resolved. At the time of inspection, the situation did not appear to be as extensive as described, although we understand that sensitivity to odours can vary from person to person.

We regret that this affected your overall experience and appreciate the opportunity to clarify the circumstances.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Slawomir
reviews.title: Mogę polecić to miejsce dla dwóch par lub pary z dwójką dzieci
reviews.positive: Bardzo dobrej jakości meble
reviews.negative: Czuć było kanalizację z jeden z łazienkę drugA Rec klucz do odbioru 4 km od obiektu

reviews.author: Yaroslav
reviews.title: Outstanding flat with a balcony and sea view
reviews.positive:
This is really superb apartment. It is fully equipped with proper oven, fridge, microwave, and washing machine. Most of the supplies are provided too (like salt, cooking oil, baking paper, and laundry detergent; they even provide additional rubbish bags - you don’t get that very often). If you stay for several days you can cook everything you want and enjoy eating on the balcony. Forum Madeira shopping centre is nearby - it's only 4 minutes walk to Pingo Doce. Apartment is clean and spacious, and host was kind enough to allow a bit earlier check-in

View is unbeatable: you do indeed get balcony overlooking sea and Funchal, so it's really nice to sit there in the evening drinking red medium bodied wine which was complimentary from the property

And on top of everything else, location is outstanding too: immediately outside of the apartment there is a bus stop with a VERY FREQUENT service 1,2,48 to Funchal centre (there is a bus every 5...10 minutes), so you don't need to use taxi at all. Promenade leading to Camara de Lobos is 10 mins away, and you can find several beaches along that way. Overall - would definitely stay there again!
reviews.negative:
You need to collect keys in the different part of the city. All the instructions are very clear - but still, you need to take this into account when planning the route

Also, there is a bit of weird smell which is a mix of damp (shower only) and insects treatment - but you don't want those insects in the apartment, right? I'm really scared of them - but luckily, this apartment was clean, so i can handle the smell
reviews.response:
Hello Yaroslav.

Thank you very much for your detailed review and for sharing your experience with future guests.

We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment, its spaciousness, equipment, cleanliness, location, and stunning views. It is particularly rewarding to know that you appreciated the nearby amenities, public transport connections, complimentary wine, and the overall comfort of the property. Knowing that you would happily stay with us again means a great deal to us.

Regarding the smell you mentioned, this was not brought to our attention during your stay. Had we been informed, we would have been more than happy to investigate it immediately. Madeira's climate is naturally quite humid, and we also carry out occasional preventative treatments to help keep insects away from the property, which may explain what you noticed during your visit.

Thank you once again for your kind words and valuable feedback. We truly appreciate it and look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Sylwester
reviews.positive: Duza przestrzeń ,idealna lokalizacja blisko plaża molo i centrum handlowe przy wejsciu do budynku lokalna restauracja. Miłe powitalny poczestunek z lokalnych produktów.

reviews.author: Наталья
reviews.positive: Очень хорошие и чистые апартаменты, красивый вид из окна, удобное месторасположение , есть все необходимое (от чая, кофе , приправ до детского кресла в авто), напротив дома автобусная остановка (2 евро), такси Bolt (центр 5-6 евро), при заселении был приветственный подарок (вино, фрукты, сладости), рекомендую!
reviews.negative: В одной из ванных комнат была маленькая душевая

reviews.author: Wiktoria
reviews.title: Super apartament jako baza wypadowa do zwiedzania wyspy
reviews.positive: Przytulny apartament, świetnie wyposażony. Bardzo dobry kontakt z właścicielem. Super lokalizacja, bardzo blisko lotnisko, ocean, restauracje i bary.
reviews.negative: Wjazd na parking podziemny słabo dostosowany pod większe samochody.

reviews.author: Stefanie
reviews.positive: Das Apartment ist super, gut ausgestattet und man fühlt sich wohl.
reviews.negative: Die Garage ist eine Challenge mit SUV

reviews.author: Erich
reviews.title: Piccolo ma moderno
reviews.positive: Camera funzionale, nel centro, pulita
reviews.negative: Un po piccola per 3 persone, sarebbe stato comodo un balcone per asciugare i teli.

reviews.author: Thibault
reviews.title: Estadia de mais de uma semana
reviews.comment:
Super hôte et appartement très agréable, le parking est top, la vue est top. 
L’aéroport est proche donc on entend les avions mais ce n’est pas dérangeant. 
Notre hôte a été très sympathique proactive et nous a a plusieurs reprises demandé si tout se passait bien. 
Merci pour ce séjour.

reviews.author: Marta
reviews.title: Estadia de algumas noites
reviews.comment:
A nossa estadia foi excelente! A casa estava impecavelmente limpa, muito confortável e exatamente como descrita. A anfitriã foi sempre extremamente simpática, atenciosa e disponível para ajudar em tudo o que precisámos, desde o primeiro contacto até ao final da estadia.
Sentimo-nos verdadeiramente bem recebidos e isso fez toda a diferença na nossa experiência na Madeira. Recomendo este alojamento sem qualquer hesitação e, sem dúvida, voltaria a ficar aqui numa próxima visita. Muito obrigada por toda a simpatia e hospitalidade!
reviews.response: Olá! Muito obrigado pelas suas palavras gentis! Ficamos muito felizes em saber que você teve uma estadia excelente e que a casa atendeu a todas as suas expectativas. A limpeza e o conforto são nossas principais prioridades, e é ótimo saber que você se sentiu em casa. Agradecemos também pelos elogios à hospitalidade do anfitrião. Ser atencioso e acolhedor é o que buscamos, e é maravilhoso saber que isso fez a diferença na sua experiência. Agradecemos por nos recomendar! Mal podemos esperar para recebê-lo novamente para mais uma estadia memorável em Madeira. Até a próxima! Abraços, Sua equipe Holidu

reviews.author: Igor
reviews.positive: Wyposażenie apartamentu 10/10, wszystko czego potrzebowaliśmy się tam znajduje. Apartament czysty, schludny i zadbany
reviews.negative: Brak balkonu na parterze

reviews.author: Helena
reviews.positive: La posizione.
reviews.negative:
Pessima pulizia, biancheria da letto e da doccia sporchi. 
Porta utensili da cucina sporco. 
La persona che abbiamo contattato non ha aiutato a trovare una soluzione, gli ultimi messaggi che abbiamo inviato non ha nemmeno risposto.
reviews.response:
Dear Helena.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the location of the property.

We are sorry to know that you were dissatisfied with certain aspects of the cleanliness. The property is prepared before every arrival by a professional cleaning team, following the high standards we require. Had any concern been reported to us during your stay, we would have promptly arranged for our team to return to the property and address the situation.

We would also like to clarify that, according to our communication records, we did not receive any messages from you during the stay reporting these issues or requesting assistance with them. For this reason, we unfortunately had no opportunity to intervene or provide and check the situation.

We take cleanliness seriously and always encourage our guests to contact us during their stay whenever something is not as expected, so that we can assist as quickly as possible.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Sequeira
reviews.title: L'appartement est superbe et idéalement situé, à deux pas de l'océan, le parking dur d'accès.
reviews.positive:
Le studio était super et correspondait parfaitement à la description. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié les petites attentions, comme le café ainsi que les dosettes pour le lave-vaisselle et le lave-linge.
Tout était vraiment très bien et localisation géniale.
Pour rendre l'expérience encore meilleure, il ne manquerait que des serviettes de plage, ce qui serait un vrai plus étant donné que le logement est situé à deux pas de la plage.
reviews.negative:
Le seul véritable point négatif concerne le parking. Les places attribuées à notre logement se trouvent au niveau -2 et l'accès est vraiment difficile. Il faut effectuer plusieurs manœuvres en pleine pente, ce qui rend le stationnement assez stressant. Mon mari a réussi à garer la voiture, mais pour ma part, je ne voulais plus m'y garer.

Nous avons d'ailleurs vu plusieurs touristes avec des voitures de location rayées à cause de cette configuration. C'est dommage, car le logement est excellent, mais un avertissement sur la difficulté d'accès au parking serait appréciable.

reviews.author: Clemence
reviews.title: Pour mon premier voyage seule, j’ai adoré ce logement où je m’y suis sentie vraiment à l’aise
reviews.positive: Le logement est super bien équipé. Il dispose d’un lave-vaisselle, machine à laver, cuisine équipée. On s’y sent vraiment comme chez soi. Il est très bien placé. L’arrivée est autonome et les propriétaires sont super accessibles par message.
reviews.negative: Pas beaucoup d’ouvertures pour aérer.

reviews.author: Iskhok
reviews.title: We checked out yesterday around 8am. None of our issues were resolved. I will leave a review
reviews.response:
Dear Iskhok.

Thank you for your feedback.

We are sorry to know that  your stay did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to clarify that throughout your stay, our team made every effort to address and resolve all concerns raised.

When you reported issues regarding the cleanliness of the apartment, we immediately arranged an additional cleaning service to ensure your comfort and satisfaction. We responded promptly to all communications and carefully considered every request and concern presented during your stay.

Several of the points raised related to features and characteristics that are clearly described in the property listing. Regarding the private parking space, it is a standard-sized parking spot that is provided free of charge as part of the accommodation and has been used by many guests without any reported issues.

Despite our continuous efforts to assist and provide solutions whenever possible, additional complaints continued to be raised, many of which related to aspects accurately represented in the property description.

We always value constructive feedback and use it to improve our service. Nevertheless, we believe this review does not fairly reflect the level of assistance, responsiveness, and support provided by our team throughout the stay.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Snsh
reviews.positive: Modern  , good location and very clean
reviews.negative: Car park is a bit tight
reviews.response:
Dear Snsh.

Thank you for your kind feedback. We are delighted to know that you appreciated the modern style, cleanliness, and convenient location.

Regarding the parking, we understand your comment. Unfortunately, in Madeira, parking spaces are often designed this way. However, we would like to highlight that there are also free parking options available in the surrounding area during the night.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Stanislav
reviews.positive: I guess we were one of the first visitors, because everything looked new. The owners really thought about any possible thing you might need. Also very close to the airport, just 20 minutes walking. We liked everything, thanks.
reviews.negative: Located on the street level, so if open the blinds there is no privacy at all.

reviews.author: Mainframezen
reviews.title: Use sempre o acesso pela Estrada dos Moínhos, as outras ruas são muito inclinadas.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.positive: La casa está muy bien ubicada y limpia. El jardín exterior también es muy agradable.
reviews.negative: Como puntos negativos destacaría la falta de más enchufes en la cocina y el sofá cama, que es muy muy incómodo. Estaría bien que proporcionaran un colchón, o una cama extra en la habitación de matrimonio de la segunda planta. También recomendaría proporcionar toallas limpias a lo largo de la estancia.

reviews.author: Melisa
reviews.title: Stunning views has everything you need
reviews.positive: The house is very beautiful and looks just like in the photos. The house is spacious, had a big size kitchen and the rooms are spacious too. yes in a great location close to the airport and Santa Cruz also a lovely town it’s very quite and had beautiful views. It was a great experience.
reviews.negative: There are two routes to get to the property. Both very steep but one route has space for two cars the other one car at the time ek!

reviews.author: Roxana
reviews.positive: La lumière rentrant dans la maison, la vue exceptionnelle sur l'océan lors du réveil soleil

reviews.author: Anton
reviews.positive: We had a truly wonderful stay at Casa da Horta by Atlantic Holiday. The property is beautifully maintained, with lush gardens and a tranquil atmosphere that made it feel like a hidden oasis. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and tastefully decorated—perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring.
reviews.negative: N/A

reviews.author: Judit
reviews.positive:
La casa és maquíssima, i té un jardí molt ben cuidat amb vistes al mar, un lloc idíl·lic! La casa és tal i com es veu a les fotos, molt bonica i ben decorada. Ens va agradar trobar-hi la cuina ben equipada amb tot el que cal per cuinar, i que a més també tingués fregall, drap, sabó de plats i estovalles. Els propietaris també van tenir el detall de deixar-nos alguns ous, galetes i uns pastissets típics, i càpsules de cafè, ens van salvar el primer esmorzar! A part, hi havia paper de vàter, llençols, tovalloles i sabó de mans i de dutxa. També vam agraïr la disponibilitat dels propietaris, amb qui vam poder contactar en tot moment i per qualsevol dubte, i van respondre ràpidament i amb amabilitat. 

IMPORTANT:
Finalment, si hi aneu, intenteu no fer gaire xivarri a les nits. La casa es troba en un barri residencial, i vam tenir la sort de poder conèixer unes veïnes, dues dones grans que viuen allà de tota la vida. Ens van explicar que de vegades s'han trobat amb turistes que posen la música forta tota la nit i que fan molt soroll, i que llavors no poden descansar. Segur que us ho agraïran!
reviews.negative:
Al principi ens va sobtar l'aparcament, ja que ens van dir que deixessim el cotxe al voral de la carretera just davant de casa, en una curva, i no les teniem totes... Però amb els dies ens vam adonar que a Madeira tothom aparca així, i no vam tenir cap problema en aquest sentit, perquè allà tothom condueix amb molt de compte. 
Un punt a millorar seria la neteja de la cuina: en general tenia un aspecte polit, però els utensilis de cuina, plats, coberts i gots no acabaven d'estar nets. Tot i així, ho vam netejar nosaltres amb el fregall que ens havien proporcionat, i cap problema!

reviews.author: Susana
reviews.title: Localização fácil mas sem limpeza adequada
reviews.positive: O local era muito bonito e fácil de encontrar.
reviews.negative: O local não estava limpo quando chegamos, foi extremamente desagradável. Havia pó e migalhas no chão , cabelos e manchas de comida nos quartos. Toalhas de banho não eram suficientes assim como papel higiénico… as camas tinham manchas de uso.
reviews.response:
Dear Susana,

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the property’s location and that the information provided helped you reach it easily.

We were sorry to know that certain aspects did not fully meet your expectations. During your stay, we did not receive any communication regarding cleanliness concerns. Had we been made aware and received some photos to better understand the situation, we would have gladly arranged for our cleaning team to visit the property and ensure everything was up to standard.

Please know that we work closely with a dedicated professional cleaning team who take great pride in maintaining the quality and comfort of our properties. Your satisfaction is very important to us, and we always aim to provide a welcoming and pleasant environment for every guest. We would have truly valued the opportunity to address any concern right away and ensure you had the most comfortable stay possible.Likewise, if you had required additional towels, we would have been happy to check availability and deliver them.Thank you once again for your comments and for taking the time to share your experience.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Stéphane
reviews.positive: La vue sur l'océan, le calme, le jardin, le barbecue.

reviews.author: Jerzy
reviews.title: Polecam
reviews.positive: Pięknie i z dbałością wyposażony dom we wszystko co potrzebne żeby komfortowo spędzić tu tydzień. Niezbędny oczywiście samochód.
reviews.negative: Przydałaby się porządnej jakości duża, stalowa patelnia i dobry korkociąg do wina😊

reviews.author: Lidia
reviews.title: Fantastisch huis met veel ruimte op een fijn locatie
reviews.positive: Prachtig huis, heel schoon, alles wat top. Fijne bedden, veel ruimte, prima om met een gezin te verblijven. De buitenruimte is ook heel fijn.
reviews.negative: Alles wat perfect, het enige wat nog beter was geweest, is als er een vaatwasser zou zijn.

reviews.author: Luca
reviews.positive: A szállás csendes volt, szuper elhelyezkedéssel, minden programot könnyen meg tudtunk közelíteni Parkolni a ház előtt lehetett, minig volt hely és nem volt nagy forgalom sem. A szállás tiszta és rendezett volt :) Tökéletes hosszabb tartózkodásra is, bármikor visszamennék.
reviews.negative: Nem volt ilyen :)

reviews.author: Krzysztof
reviews.title: Obiekt spełnił oczekiwania i jest godny polecenia.
reviews.positive: Urokliwy dom z klimatem, robiący ogromne wrażenie. Czysty, przestronny, z wygodnymi łóżkami. Czysta pościel. Właściciele zgodzili się na przedłużenie doby o godzinę, za co dodatkowy plus. Na przyjazd otrzymaliśmy drobny upominek, co też było miłe.
reviews.negative: Wyposażenie kuchni - stare sztućce i talerze. Brak zmywarki. Piec do pizzy w kuchni który był na zdjęciach - był zamknięty na kłódkę. W dzień przed przyjazdem dostaliśmy informację, że nie można z niego korzystać, a był jednym z argumentów przy wyborze tego lokum.

reviews.author: Nataliia
reviews.title: Красивий будинок з власним подвірʼям і чудовим видом з вікон
reviews.positive: Продуманий будинок зі всім необхідним, власне подвірʼя, гриль, всередині будинку є камін
reviews.negative: Немає місця для паркування, машину треба залишати біля дороги. Щодо чистоти є питання, трішки брудно

reviews.author: Grażyna
reviews.positive: Było bajecznie. Trzeba  tylko od początku ustawić sobie odpowiednio dłuższą trasę dojazdu do domu ponieważ te krótsze  są dla wytrawnych kierowców i ludzi o mocnych nerwach

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.positive: Gelungene Lage, sehr schöne Aussicht, Grill Möglichkeit, Gastgeber Geschenk, super Ausstattung und sehr für Familien geeignet. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
reviews.negative: Lärm der Nachbars Hunde, Bewegungsmelder für Badezimmer und Hausflur, fehlende Mosquito Netze an den Fenstern.

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing!
reviews.positive: We loved absolutely everything about this place! We prefer quiet and spacious places and this was the perfect choice for a family 2+2 (teens) but it can accommodate more people. Just be careful when choosing a road from airport - 2 are very slippery (very!). Choose the longest connection.
reviews.negative: Just one suggestion - dishwasher would be a nice addition.

reviews.author: Coen
reviews.title: Fijne vakantie villa in het oosten van Madeira
reviews.positive: Mooi ruim huis met een lekkere tuin
reviews.negative:
Niets.
Mocht ik nog iets te wensen mogen noemen zou dat een vaatwasser zijn (of iig een afdroog handdoekje voor de vaat). 
Ook zou een stofzuiger een prettige toevoeging zijn.

reviews.author: Janine
reviews.title: Entspannter Aufenthalt und idealer Ausgangspunkt für Wanderungen.
reviews.positive:
Die Unterkunft hat einen schönen Blick auf das Meer. Die überdachte Grillecke lädt zum Verweilen ein. Die Lage ist ideal für Wanderungen im Osten der Insel. 
Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön eingerichtet.
reviews.negative:
Der Ofen und der Toaster könnten ausgetauscht werden (leider sehr alt und nicht 100% funktionsfähig). Die Sauberkeit im Duschbereich könnte besser sein. 
Vor Ort gibt es viele bellende Hunde und auch leichten Fluglärm. Das sollte man bei der Lage beachten. Uns hat es keineswegs gestört.

reviews.author: Małgorzata
reviews.positive:
Great location, beautiful ocean view and peaceful surroundings. The house is spacious and cosy, equipped with everything that was needed during our stay. 
Great communication with hosts before arrival, everything was clearly explained and we had no issues at all. 
Much recommended! :)

reviews.author: Maaike
reviews.title: An idyllic house in an attractive setting
reviews.positive: An idyllic house, built in 1896 and recently completely refurbished. The ocean view is spectacular. The garden is beautiful. The outdoor bbq was used a lot. Situated in a neighborhood where the locals live. Very nice!
reviews.negative: The beds were a bit hard for us. Outside we missed some comfortable chairs. The lights downstairs were not so cosy.

reviews.author: Zofia
reviews.title: Idealne miejsce na wakacje z rodziną.
reviews.positive: Grill, widok, ogród
reviews.negative: Brak zmywarki

reviews.author: Rafal
reviews.positive:
A very comfortable house, undoubtedly a great place to stay in Madeira. Located away from tourist centers, yet only 5-10 minutes by car to the VR1 highway. We can choose either a very steep route with a slope of 30-40% in places, or a slightly longer, more comfortable route, although also steep in places.
Peaceful and quiet neighborhood. The house is located in the rural area of Santa Cruz. In the morning we were woken up by the crowing of roosters and the singing of canaries :) There we could experience how the local inhabitants live. The house is surrounded by cultivated terraces, there are narrow walkways between the houses and the crops, along which irrigation channels have been improved. On the other side of the road, slightly below, there is a levada, different from all levadas visited by tourists - here you can see how lavadas are used in practice to irrigate crops.
The house itself is very comfortable, with a well-equipped kitchen, living room and two bedrooms in the attic. There is a small garden and a barbecue area. Sea View. Beautiful sunrises. There are planes landing and taking off below, but their noise is barely audible.
Hosts from Atlantic Holiday were very helpful and we were able to get all necessary information via WhatsApp.
We strongly recommend Casa da Horta! (or no... don't go there and leave a slot for us to book again ;) )
We want to come back here again!

reviews.author: Anton
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.positive: A whole new house with barbecue place. We had a great stay there. Great service from managing company and the owner. Everything is new. Fire place in the house. Parking in front of the house along the street. 10 min from airport. It’s on the hill, driving up with a stick could be a challenge. Recommend renting a stronger automatic, would be useful for the whole island.

reviews.author: Martina
reviews.title: Pokud bychom se vrátili na Madeiru, určitě tohle místo znovu navštívíme.
reviews.positive: Výhled, přístup a pohostinnost majitele, klidná lokalita.

reviews.author: Hans
reviews.title: Schöne Auszeit vom trüben Winterwetter auf einer Insel mit wunderschöner Natur bei angenehmem Klima
reviews.positive: Abseits gelegen, ohne viele Touristen. Guter Ausgangspunkt für Erkundungsfahrten über die Insel, allerdings ohne ständig zur Verfügung stehendes Fahrzeug (wir hatten einen Mietwagen) schwer zu erreichen. Uns hat besonders gefallen, dass wir ein wenig am ursprünglichen Leben der freundlichen Dorfbewohner teilnehmen durften (Umzug zu Ehren der Nationalheiligen, Feierabend  in den örtlichen Tavernen). Wir hatten sehr nette Gastgeber, die uns mit Kostproben  von leckeren Früchten der Insel und von dem auf der Insel gebrauten Bier eine Freude machten.

reviews.author: Giuseppe
reviews.title: Fantastica Madeira

reviews.negative: Nulla

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.positive:
I would like to leave a review of Casa Gomez accommodation. My family and I were absolutely delighted with our stay and spent the last 14 days of December there. Although we travel quite often with our children and deliberately choose private accommodations, as hotels usually do not suit us well in these destinations, I was truly impressed by how well equipped both the kitchen and the bathroom were.

I cooked there twice a day and had absolutely everything I needed at my disposal – blenders, food containers for trips, a coffee machine, a toaster, excellent new non-stick pans, in fact a fully and newly equipped kitchen. There was also a washing machine and a hair dryer, which I particularly appreciated. On top of that, the hosts were incredibly kind – they brought us their own delicious fruit from the garden several times and always made sure we had everything we needed.

The place itself is beautiful, with a perfect location for exploring the island. Air conditioning that both cools and heats (very useful on cooler days), parking right next to the house, stunning views – simply absolute satisfaction. I can wholeheartedly recommend this accommodation. We haven’t experienced such a well-equipped and truly comfortable place in a long time. It genuinely felt like home :-)

Si può piacevolmente mangiare all'aperto in veranda . E' comunque necessario avere un mezzo proprio per muoversi nell'isola. La casa è grande e ben attrezzata.

reviews.positive: The host was welcoming and despite the language barrier was friendly and made us feel very welcome and comfortable. The accommodation itself is clean, simple, and spacious, with comfortable furnishings and all the appliances you would need, plus a sea view from the outside seating area. Would definitely look to come back here if we visit Madeira again.

reviews.response: Dear Bert. Thank you for your feedback! We're glad you enjoyed the beautiful location, perfect for exploring the levadas, and that you had a warm experience with us. The traffic on small roads is quite typical in Madeira, especially in more central areas. We appreciate your understanding and hope to welcome you again soon. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

Dear Józefina.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the proximity to the airport, the spaciousness of the property, the garage and the well-equipped kitchen.

We are sorry to know that your arrival did not go as expected. However, we would like to clarify that the complete check-in information and access instructions were sent correctly prior to your arrival. We also have no record of receiving a phone call from you that evening, so we were not aware that you were experiencing difficulties accessing the property and therefore had no opportunity to assist you at that moment.

Had the issues with the garage access or cleanliness been reported to us during your stay, our team would have been available to inspect the property and provide assistance wherever necessary.

We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that we were not given the opportunity to help resolve these matters while you were at the property.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

Location is very close to the airport which I found super convenient for my early departure (you see and hear the planes during the day). If you travel in cold season, plan ahead because the jacuzzi needs 3+ hours to heat up. In summer, I can imagine that the bedrooms may get stuffy (no A/C; too loud for open windows). Check for the cleaning fee before you confirm the booking.

reviews.author: Prentki
reviews.title: Piękny i wygodny apartament na stromym zboczu (z wszystkimi zaletami i wadami tego zestawienia ;D)
reviews.positive: Piękny apartament z wygodnym garażem (co jest rzadkością na wyspie). To bardzo duży komfort, jeśli wypożycza się samochód bo trudno tu o miejsca parkingowe, a jeśli już są to często są zlokalizowane na bardzo wąskich i stromych drogach. Apartament miał dwa poziomy, na górze garaż, sypialnie i łazienka, na dole część dzienna z kuchnią i dodatkowym WC. Piękny taras z fajnym widokiem, dużo światła, na tarasie jacuzzi, które naprawdę fajnie działa. Kuchnia świetnie wyposażona, łazienka spora i wygodna - samo miejsce również świetne jako punkt wypadowy do zwiedzania wyspy. Lotnisko jest blisko - w ciągu dnia słychać przelatujące samoloty (podchodzą do lądowania przed apartamentem) ale nie latają nocą więc nie jest to uciążliwe - dla nas bardziej fajna ciekawostka do oglądania z tarasu.
reviews.negative: Teoretycznie blisko centrum, ale ulica jest mega stroma, z dość agresywnym nawrotem na początku. Powrót z miasteczka na nogach kosztuje przez to sporo wysiłku, a jeśli ktoś nie radzi sobie z prowadzeniem samochodu to też może mieć mały problem z dotarciem do apartamentu (uliczka jest wąska i stroma, przy mijaniu się z autami z naprzeciwka trzeba dobrze pracować sprzęgłem i ręcznym żeby w ogóle ruszyć). Łóżka były dość twarde (ale to trochę kwestia gustu) + poza sezonem zapas ciepłej wody szybko się wyczerpuje (grzeją ją chyba tylko panele na dachu). Więcej wad nie odnotowałem :)

reviews.author: Mariia
reviews.positive: Організація була відмінна. Опис, відео, все саме необхідне та потрібне. Житло тихе і чисте нічого не заважало.
reviews.negative:
Брали це житло через вид з вікна. Але вікна були настільки брудні, що втрачався весь сенс цієї покупки. Бронювали на 5 днів тобто не просто на вихідні, тому вважаю, що мали вікна перед нами помити.
Були через місяць в круїзі посеред моря і там вікна і то чистіше були, хоча вода і сіль постійно також поруч. 
Туалетна бумага була тонша ніж в міському, безкоштовному туалеті.
Кави навіть 1 штуки для кавомашини не було, щоб ми могли такі самі наприклад купити. Мови ми португальської не знаємо, тому залишились без кави. Не було ні часу, ні бажання розбиратися з нею.
Так само ні води, ні привітальних смаколиків, нічого не було. Я вже від такого, якщо чесно відвикла. Давно такого не бачила. Завжди вода, кава, цукор, чай і пару цукерок в кожній країні світу зустрічають. А тут ми прилетіли пізно, вже нічого не працювало і залишилися без самого необхідного на ранок. Мусили одразу бігти в магазин. 
Таке враження, що ми саме дешеве житло орендували, без всіх привілей. Але ж це не так. Ціна не така і мала була. 
Тож якщо вам важливий вид з вікно, то беріть, якщо звикли хоч до мінімального комфорту, то окрім ремонту там більше нічого немає.

reviews.title: I enjoyed the stay very much, it was good choice for me.

Kitchen well equiped (with separate utility room with laundry); big and comfortable bed, big TV with Netflix option, blackout curtains in the bedroom and livingroom, USB socket embeded in sofa. Garage is in the same building, which was very important for me (however access to the garage is rather narrow - because of pillars - and requires very, very careful and slow entry/exit). Apartment located close to the big shopping mall and to bus stop (Funchal centre is located not so close, about 1 hour walk). Caring and responsive host. No problems with access as I had received detailed videos how to reach apartment and garage. I enjoyed the stay very much, it was good choice for me.

reviews.author: Lothar
reviews.positive:
Top Lage. Einkaufscenter, super Restaurants und Bademöglichkeiten in unmittelbarer Nähe. Trotzdem ruhige Lage.
Negativ und positiv: für 12 Nächte liegen leider nur 1 kleines und 1 großes Handtuch pro Person bereit. Auf Nachfrage wurden von der Hausverwaltung 2 weitere Sätze zur Verfügung gestellt.
reviews.negative:
Leider fanden im Haus Renovierungsarbeiten statt. Von 9:30 bis 17 Uhr war es wegen Bohr- und Stemmarbeiten sehr laut. Ist leider das Risiko, in einem Wohnkomplex zu wohnen. 
Die Küchenausstattung war sehr, sehr dürftig. Wenige Teller, 2 Tassen, 1 Eierbecher für 2 Personen ist definitiv zu wenig. Leider hat das die Hausverwaltung anders gesehen und nicht nachgebessert.
Negativ und positiv: für 12 Nächte liegen leider nur 1 kleines und 1 großes Handtuch pro Person bereit. Auf Nachfrage wurden von der Hausverwaltung 2 weitere Sätze zur Verfügung gestellt.
reviews.response:
Dear Lothar.

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We’re so glad to read that you enjoyed the location, with its close proximity to shops, restaurants, and swimming options.

Regarding the construction noise, we’d like to clarify that there is no ongoing work inside the property itself. We were not aware of any construction happening in the building but will certainly look into this matter to ensure there are no disturbances in the future.

As for the kitchen utensils, we always aim to provide the appropriate number of dishes to suit the capacity of the property. However, we appreciate your feedback and will review this to ensure the kitchen is fully equipped for our guests' needs.

Thank you again for your constructive comments, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.negative: Het matras. Eigenlijk vind ik het matras Het belangrijkste van een accommodatie. Een goede nachtrust is (voor ons) heel belangrijk. Het matras is te zacht en er is een slaapkuil aan de raamzijde. Door een kussen onder het matras te plaatsen kwam het matras omhoog. Wanneer je er dan op gaat liggen heb je minder last van de kuil in het matras. In de badkamer kon het soms naar riool stinken. Ik vermoed dat dat door het bidet komt. Deze kan je ook niet meer gebruiken.

reviews.author: Arij
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.positive:
Commentaire Booking

Points positifs : L’emplacement est très bien situé, avec  un accès facile aux principales attractions. Le quartier est également calme la nuit, ce qui est appréciable.
reviews.negative:
Points négatifs : Malheureusement, la propreté de l’appartement était insuffisante à notre arrivée, avec notamment une mauvaise odeur dans le logement et une odeur désagréable provenant du lave-linge.

Pour un séjour de 5 jours pour deux personnes, les fournitures mises à disposition étaient également insuffisantes : un rouleau d’essuie-tout presque terminé et seulement deux rouleaux de papier toilette. Aucun passage de ménage n’était prévu pendant le séjour et aucun produit n’avait été laissé à disposition pour pouvoir nettoyer les toilettes ou l’apparteme nt nous-mêmes. Lorsque j’ai contacté l’hôte à ce sujet, il m’a simplement conseillé d’acheter les produits au supermarché.

L’emplacement est donc un vrai point fort, mais la propreté et les équipements mis à disposition devraient être nettement améliorés.
reviews.response:
Dear Arij.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are pleased to know that you appreciated the property’s location and the peaceful surroundings during the evening.

Regarding the cleanliness and the unpleasant odours mentioned, we were sorry to read these comments, as no concerns regarding the cleanliness of the property or any odour were reported to our team during your stay. The property is professionally cleaned and prepared before each arrival. Had we been informed of any issue at the time, we would have been happy to send our team to the property to inspect the situation and assist accordingly.

As this is a self-catering accommodation, we provide an initial supply of essential items to help guests settle in, including three rolls of toilet paper. Additional supplies and cleaning products for the remainder of the stay can be purchased according to each guest’s individual needs. A daily cleaning service is also not included as part of a standard five-night stay.

We always encourage our guests to contact us during their stay whenever something is not as expected, as this gives us the opportunity to assess the situation and provide assistance as quickly as possible.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Andrada
reviews.title: I don t recommend
reviews.positive: The apartment s location is very close to the city centre.
reviews.negative: The stuff was very passive aggressive with us when we told them about some issues. Also, you have just 5-10 minutes per day of hot water. I understand that the island capacity is limited, but I had to book another property while I had shampoo in my head because my 5 minutes of hot water were done. I really don t recommend this property, we booked this location for 10 days but we only stayed there just 2. After a day full of hiking, the first thing you want to do is to take a shower, which for us it was impossible.
reviews.response:
Dear Andrada.

Thank you for your feedback.

We are sorry to read your comments,however, we must clarify a few important points. Throughout your stay, our team remained professional and respectful at all times. We do not tolerate or accept disrespectful communication towards our staff, and unfortunately, the tone used in your interactions with us was not appropriate.

Regarding the hot water, the system in the apartment works properly and without any limitations when used correctly. During your stay, the water heater was repeatedly unplugged from the power supply by you, which prevents it from heating water. This is the reason why you experienced a lack of hot water, as the system requires time to reheat once it has been disconnected.

We regret that your stay was cut short, but we stand by the fact that the apartment and its systems were fully functional, and our team acted professionally throughout.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Kaminski

reviews.response:
Dear Kaminski.

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are pleased to know that you appreciated the property's location and felt comfortable during your stay.
We would like to clarify that reaching out to our guests via WhatsApp is our standard procedure, as it allows us to share clear and concise self-check-in videos. These videos make it significantly easier to locate and access the property compared to written instructions. Additionally, this channel enables us to provide faster and more efficient support should any issues arise during the stay.

We attempted to contact you multiple times prior to your arrival, but unfortunately, you did not cooperate in receiving this information. Nonetheless, the video and necessary details were sent well in advance, providing sufficient time for you to review them before your flight. We encourage all guests to share accurate and fair reviews that reflect the reality of their experience.
Thank you once again for your feedback, we are continuously working to improve our services.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.title: Lovely Apartment in the Old Town
reviews.positive: This little apartment was in the old town, a perfect location. Lots of bars, restaurants and shops on the doorstep. We loved the park 2 mins away with a cafe bar, always open. Although the balcony has no view, we liked having an outside space. The location was very quiet. We didn't hear a thing at night. The apartment was clean, well equipped with a good size bathroom and plenty of hot water. Communication with Marta was excellent. She arranged a transfer for us on arrival, 40 euros and we got the aerobus back to the airport, 6 euros 40 each. We would happily book the apartment again.
reviews.negative: The kitchen needs more sockets. I unplugged the boiler in error to plug the kettle in and had no hot water. Marta responded straight away and I realised what I had done.
reviews.response: Dear Linda. Thank you for your wonderful review! We’re so happy to hear you enjoyed the apartment's location in the Old Town, and that you found the space clean, well-equipped, and quiet. We're also glad you appreciated the communication and transfer arrangement. Regarding the kitchen, we appreciate your feedback about the sockets and will certainly keep it in mind for future improvements. We’re also glad we could help when you needed assistance with the hot water. We’d be delighted to welcome you back anytime! Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.response: Cara Sílvia. Agradecemos pelo feedback! Ficamos felizes que tenha gostado da localização, do conforto e do espaço do apartamento, assim como do elevador e dos bons equipamentos. Em relação aos pontos que mencionou, vamos considerar sua sugestão sobre o número de panelas e panos, bem como o tamanho do frigorífico, para melhorias futuras. Com os melhores cumprimentos, Equipa Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.positive: Bardzo dobrze wyposażony apartament, w szafkach można było znaleźć wszystko co potrzebne. Byliśmy poza sezonem, może dzięki temu mimo lokalizacji w ścisłym centrum było cicho i spokojnie
reviews.negative: Trochę niewygodne łóżko

reviews.author: Jakub
reviews.title: brak klimatyzacji w czerwcu to spory problem, wygodne łóżko
reviews.positive: Bardzo wygodne łóżko, z którego jednak nie mogliśmy w pełni skorzystać ze względu na hałas. Przyzwoita lokalizacja, niedaleko ładnego parku, centrum w zakresie 15-20 minutowego spaceru. Duże, prywatne miejsce parkingowe w garażu. Self check-in z wykorzystaniem skrytki na klucze na plus.
reviews.negative: Brak klimatyzacji w czerwcu to spory problem, niestety od razu po wejściu do mieszkania przywitała nas fala gorącego powietrza. Nie udało nam się przewietrzyć mieszkania przez kolejne dni, przede wszystkim ze względu na to, że wszystkie okna są po jednej stronie budynku. Jedyną opcją jest spanie z działającym wentylatorem lub przy otwartych oknach, jednak wtedy dochodzą bardzo głośne odgłosy z ulicy. Niestety nie przespaliśmy dobrze ani jednej nocy w trakcie naszego pobytu. Zarządca nie wyraził zbyt dużej chęci pomocy w tym temacie, zasugerował radzenie sobie z wentylatorami, których stan techniczny mógłby być nieco lepszy. W jednej z łazienek panował nieprzyjemny zapach. Dodatkowo w ofercie była informacja o dostępności zestawu do parzenia kawy: kapsułek do ekspresu, a także sypanej kawy jednak brak. Brak detergentów do prania, a także tabletek do zmywarki, co w mojej ocenie powinno być zapewnione podczas tygodniowego pobytu. Wczesna godzina check-out (10:00), bez możliwości przedłużenia.
reviews.response:
Dear Jakub.

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased to know that you found the bed very comfortable, appreciated the location, the private parking space, and the convenience of the self check-in system.

Regarding the noise, the apartment is located in a residential/urban area, so some normal city noise may occasionally be heard. However, we do not consider it to be above what is reasonably expected for an apartment in this type of location.

Concerning the air conditioning, we would like to clarify that air conditioning is not advertised anywhere in the listing. Nevertheless, we appreciate your feedback and, for guests’ comfort, fans are provided in the apartment.

Regarding the smell mentioned in one of the bathrooms, we inspected the property and did not identify any unpleasant odour. Even so, we take this type of comment seriously and will continue to monitor it.

As for coffee, laundry detergent and dishwasher tablets, the property is self-catering. For this reason, these items are not provided as standard, as their use is left to each guest’s own preference during the stay.

Finally, the check-in and check-out times are clearly stated before the reservation is confirmed. We are always happy to offer flexibility whenever possible, but this depends on availability and the schedule of the property.

We are sorry that some aspects of your stay did not fully meet your expectations, and we thank you again for highlighting the positive points of the apartment.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

We got up at 4:00 and had a long and lost day… By the way, we left a clean flat and checked out at 8:00. Atlantic was informed one day before our departure of this schedule.
reviews.response:
Dear Tenten.

Thank you for your review and for noting that the apartment was clean and well equipped and delighted to know that you enjoyed the view.
Regarding the timings, we would like to clarify that both check-in and check-out times are clearly stated on the platform prior to booking, allowing guests to make an informed decision. Any requests for changes to these times are always subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed in advance.
That said, we always do our best to accommodate special requests and adjust timings whenever operationally possible. We are sorry that, on this occasion, we were unable to fully meet your expectations.

Thank you once again for your feedback, which is valuable in helping us improve our service.

reviews.author: Emiliya
reviews.title: Пълно разочарование
reviews.negative: Лоша комуникация с домакините, на телефонът, който беше даден за контакт никой не отговаряше, това е огромна фирма Атлантик холидей и нямат дежуре, В едната спаляня имаше счупен прозорец едната спалня, който не се затваряше плътно и спяхме все едно на улицата. Подадох сигнал и никой не дойде до края на престоя з 8 дни да се опита да го опрви  Ние бяхме четирима човека, а бойлерът малък. Абсурдно е да се изкъпем всички един след друг нормално. Дистанционно за гаражните врати правеше проблем и ту работеше, ту не. Една вечер някой беше спярл на нашето паркомясто и нямаше къде да оставим колата.....
reviews.response:
Dear Emiliya.

Thank you for your feedback.

We must strongly disagree with the way you have described the situation, as several points mentioned do not accurately reflect what happened or the communication we had with you during your stay.

Our team was always reachable and in contact with you. However, you sent messages without context and without identifying yourself, instead of contacting us through the booking platform where your reservation was registered. Even so, we assisted you and, regarding the garage remote control, it was replaced on the same day once you informed us that you were having difficulties with it.

Regarding the window and the hot water, these issues were never reported to us during your stay. We have also not received this type of feedback from other guests, so it is not correct to state that nothing was done when we were never informed about these matters at the time. Had you mentioned them during your stay, we would have checked them immediately.

Concerning the parking space, we acknowledge that there was one occasion where another car was parked incorrectly, and we understand this was inconvenient. However, this did not happen repeatedly and did not continue throughout the stay.

We always do our best to assist guests promptly, but we can only act on issues that are properly reported to us during the stay. For this reason, we consider this review to be inaccurate and not a fair reflection of the support provided.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.negative: De ramen laten nogal veel lawaai door van het verkeer. Als je daar gevoelig aan bent, is dat storend. Het heeft mij wat nachtrust gekost.

reviews.author: Mateusz
reviews.title: Bardzo polecam
reviews.positive: Apartament bardzo przestronny, w pełni wyposażony, czysty. Lokalizacja w dobrym miejscu, zejscie do Museum CR7 okolo 20min.
reviews.negative: Ciężki wjazd do miejsca parkingowego.

reviews.author: Marcio
reviews.title: Apartamento bem localizado mas a precisar de algumas melhorias.
reviews.positive: Boa localização, perto de serviços.
reviews.negative:
Péssimo isolamento acústico, mesmo no 6o andar, o barulho constante do trânsito, mesmo durante a noite, é insuportável. Estavamos a trabalhar remotamente a partir do apartamento e ficava difícil concentrar.
A janela da sala tem problemas e fica bastante difícil abrir e fechar.
A cozinha tem equipamento básico para cozinhar, mas faltam algumas coisas essenciais, podiam melhorar.
A roupa da minha cama, apesar de parecer lavada, tinha manchas. Para o valor pago, não é aceitável.

reviews.author: Katarzyna
reviews.title: Mega!
reviews.positive: Super lokalizacja, przestronnie, czysto, dostępne ręczniki, pralka, zmywarka (kapsułki do zmywania są), żele pod prysznic z szamponem, w apartamencie aż 3 balkony, piękny widok, całkiem wygodne łóżka. Nam się bardzo podobało.
reviews.negative: Bardzo ciasny parking - trzeba mieć skilla jeśli chodzi o parkowanie

reviews.author: David
reviews.positive: Appartement très bien aménagé et fonctionnel. Bien situé et avec une place de stationnement en sous-sol.
reviews.negative: Bien qu'au 6ème étage, le logement reste bruyant la nuit du fait de la circulation. C'est souvent le cas à Funchal mais il faut donc s'équiper en conséquence.

reviews.author: Tania
reviews.positive: Everything was amazing good size flat clean and comfortable nice area easy access to diferente places .
reviews.negative: Some unexpected visitors 🤣🤣🤣🤣 ants in the kitchen and in one of the bedrooms.

reviews.author: Dragan
reviews.title: Ne preporučam.
reviews.positive: Veličina app je lijepa, kreveti su udobni.
reviews.negative:
Zidovi su prljavi, WC skučen. Kuhinjska krpa je samo jedna i to neka jadna. Sve čaše su različite. Balkonska vrata blokiraju prilikom zatvaranja, a brava na njima je razbijena. Skladnost  opreme (slika, tepiha, namještaja,...) je nikakva.
Buka s ceste je takva da se ne može spavati.
Ulaz u garažu je noćna mora, ako imate veće auto tipa Nisan ulaz je skoro nemoguće.
Nema klimu već samo neki ventilator.
To što zovu plažom je kamenjar.

reviews.author: Boldizsár
reviews.positive: A videókkal megkönnyítették a bejutást a szállásra, nagyon hasznos volt:) Szuper szállás jó helyen, közel vannak az éttermek. Köszönjük klassz volt:)

Apartment is big enough to feel confortable.

reviews.author: Gabriel
reviews.title: Overall good, but with big discomfort because of the heat.
reviews.positive:
The apartment is really spacious, the rooms are great, fully equipped kitchen and the living room and balcony are great. 
Bathrooms are great and clean. Beds are very comfortable with 2 options for pillows :) There was a very pleasant smell and sense of cleanliness when we arrived. 
Host gave us detailed instructions on how to get the key and how to access the parking (which is a must in Funchal).
reviews.negative: There is no AC. This is a major downside. During my stay we had 28-31 degrees outside and a constant 25-27 in the apartment. This made sleeping very difficult, since opening the windows is not an option because of the close proximity to the main street. Outside noise is really a thing to consider since mopeds are quite used in Funchal and they are usually loud.

reviews.author: André
reviews.title: Highly recommended for travel groups! Much value for the price.
reviews.positive:
The hosts cared very much and explained everything via Whatsapp in a video that they sent before our stay. So we could see where to park the car and how to enter the flat even before our arrival.
The flat is very spacious. You have two balconies to sit at. The kitchen is well equipped and had everything we needed.
There's also a car park in the garage (but better to come with a small car).
reviews.negative:
Sometimes there was some kind of bad smell in one of the bathrooms. Maybe a defective toilet tube.
And both main sleeping rooms are pointed to the main street. Unfortunately, the noises from the street, especially some very loud cars or motorcycles at night, are some kind of reflected by the buildings on the other side. It was very loud and hard to sleep sometimes.

reviews.author: Tania
reviews.title: Do not recommend this place
reviews.positive: Nothing
reviews.negative: Two building site next to the apartment. Not being able to sleep during the day with our 4 year old. Bathroom needs major work. Paint coming off walls and showing mold.

reviews.author: Fourchette
reviews.title: Je déconseille
reviews.positive: Le point positif de ce logement est la proximité de la plage et du centre de Machico. Nous avons également apprécié l'entrée autonome avec la vidéo explicative ainsi que l'électroménager (cafetière, bouilloire, lave-linge, sèche-cheveux, etc). L'appartement est grand. Un bar très sympa est situé juste à côté.
reviews.negative:
Lors de notre arrivée, la poubelle débordante du précédent voyageur était toujours présente. 
Nous avons ensuite découvert des cafards et fourmis chaque matin dans la cuisine, parfaits compagnons pour un bon petit-déjeuner. 
Avec 120€ de frais de ménage, on s'attend à un minimum. 
La porte d'entrée des communs est difficile à ouvrir, il faut trouver le coup de main et même en regardant la vidéo explicative, ce n'est pas simple. 
La literie ne nous a pas convenue, matelas à mémoire de forme se creusant fortement, douleurs lombaires au réveil bien que nous soyons trentenaires. 
La douche a très peu de débit, rendant notamment le lavage de cheveux infini. 
Les murs sont très fins et vous entendez les voisins, la porte du garage en-dessous et la porte des communs. 
Trouver une place de parking peut s'avérer compliqué mais c'est le jeu à Madère. 
Je précise également que l'agence en charge de l'appartement n'a cessé de nous réclamer la taxe de séjour en demandant un virement bancaire (hors Booking) alors que ces frais sont inclus dans le prix de Booking et versés en différé.
En somme, je déconseille ce logement.
reviews.response:
Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience, as it's vital for our improvement.
We sincerely regret that you encountered issues with the garbage bin and pests. We pride ourselves on being responsive to our guests' needs, and we wish we had been made aware of these concerns earlier in your stay. For any future guests reading this, please know that we encourage you to contact us immediately if any problem arises so we can resolve it for you right away.
Regarding the pests, our property is professionally treated. Sometimes, seeing a poisoned cockroach can be a sign that the treatment is working as it forces them out into the open before they perish. We also advise guests to keep food sealed to prevent ants, which can be persistent in our climate.
In relation to the tourist tax, your understanding is correct. This is a local municipal tax that we are required to collect in person and pass on to the authorities. It is separate from the booking total charged by Booking.com.
We are very pleased to hear that you enjoyed the convenient location, the apartment's spaciousness, and the appliances we provide. We hope these positive aspects will encourage you to consider staying with us again.

reviews.response: Dear Hector. Thank you for your feedback. We are glad to hear you found the apartment clean, well-equipped, and the beds comfortable. As mentioned in the listing, parking is not available directly at the property, but we are happy to know you managed to find a spot to park the car. Best wishes, Atlantic Holiday Team.

reviews.author: José
reviews.title: apartamento amplio y muy equipado en localidad tranquila y con buena conexión en coche

El apartamento no cuenta con aparcamiento propio y para llegar a la zona donde puedes aparcar hay que subir una cuesta muy empinada (en Madeira casi todas son así)

reviews.author: Kamila
reviews.positive: Prostorný dům v klidné lokalitě, v době našeho pobytu probíhala stavba v blízkosti, ale provoz nerušil, práce probíhaly cca od 8 do 17 hod mimo víkend. Dům samotný je prostorný, se třemi koupelnami, velmi příjemným bonusem byl kulečníkový stůl v obývacím pokoji. Terasa má výhled na Funchal a na oceán, uvítali bychom ještě více zahradního nábytku k posezení. Do města lze chodit pěšky (30 minut tam – dolů a 50 minut zpět nahoru) nebo autobusem za pár minut, zastávky jsou 2-5 minut od domu. Parkovací místo pro středně velké auto nebo dvě malé, sedmimístné jsme parkovali velmi opatrně a natěsno. 3 minuty chůze od domu je malý supermarket a pekárna s kavárnou – Padaria se skvělou kávou a místním pečivem. Podle mapy je ubytování nedaleko od centra, ale je nutné počítat s prudkým kopcem, jako všude na Madeiře.

reviews.author: Sylvia
reviews.title: Extremely disappointed with the whole thing and have passed on the name of Atlantic Holidays to people we know not to us
reviews.positive: The size
reviews.negative:
It was not up to standard, we had a broken toilet seat in one bathroom ,a leaking shower door in the en suite,a broken light in kitchen. We reported this problems they came next day to fix did not work, a new toilet seat a new light eventually, shower door supposed to be fixed still leaked,the new toilet seat broke the next day was told I must have bad used it and would have to pay for a replacement at 80 years of age I do not know what they thought I was doing.the towels had a musty smell and when we arrived there was no assistance to get into our apartment because the instructions were sent in Portuguese a nice lady that worked in one of the offices on site took about an hour and bit to work out how to the door opened we ran out of toilet paper because it was so thin was told we would have to buy our own , we had no change of sheets for two weeks 
Every time I tried to get some information all they did was asked for booking reference and name.
The video they sent did not work but finally in the middle of week two they decided they could have sent it by what’s app which might have helped. They demanded that we left at 10am because the cleaners had to come in OK but if the cleaners had been in before we arrived surely they would at least have noticed the toilet seat and the light and swept the floors
My cousin opened the wardrobe door in her room and it was full of personal stuff, if anything had gone missing what would have happened . We did not like the attitude of whoever was in charge at Refugio Madeirense, in fact sometimes they were downright rude so not impressed I am also going to copy this letter to the person in charge of tourism in Madeira.

reviews.negative: Niestety w łazience widoczny grzyb na suficie. Klucz do drzwi zewnętrznych do budynku z trudem otwierał zamek, trzeba było dużo cierpliwości by otworzyć zamek. W mieszkaniu na przeciwko w tym czasie odbywał się remont, podczas którego wiercono wiertarką udarową i stukano młotkami od godz.8.00. Jednego dnia zamknięto zawór wody i nas o tym nie powiadomiono. Po powrocie do apartamentu musieliśmy szukać przez pół godziny gospodarza domu, który na szczęście  nam pomógł i odkręcił zawór do wody na klatce schodowej. Odbiór kluczy do apartamentu uciążliwy, około 20 minut drogi pieszo. Najlepiej iść bez bagażu, bo znaczna część drogi jest pod górę.

reviews.author: Aigerim
reviews.title: Good for the price.

The location is good. Very close to the city centre. Has parking lot. 

Flat has all the utensils for cooking. 
Clean.

Poor WiFi. We didn’t use much.
Mold in bathrooms. Especially is small one. The smell wasn’t nice from the mold. So we ended up using just a main bathroom.

reviews.response:
Dear Aigerim.

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback with us.
We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the property’s location, cleanliness, and amenities, including the parking facilities and cooking utensils. We hope you were able to make the most of them during your stay.

Regarding the issues you mentioned, we were not made aware of them at the time, and therefore were unable to address them during your visit. We have not received any previous complaints about the Wi-Fi connection, and it is currently functioning well. It is possible that there was a temporary service interruption; had we been informed, we would have gladly contacted the provider to resolve the issue promptly.

The property is cleaned by a professional cleaning team, and no mold was detected while preparing the apartment for your arrival. However, Madeira Island is known for its high humidity, especially during this season. We would have appreciated being informed so we could inspect and address any concerns immediately.

All of our properties, including this one, are equipped with a hairdryer. Occasionally, they may be stored in different locations, but we would have been happy to visit the property to locate it or provide a replacement if necessary.

Once again, thank you for your valuable review. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be delighted to welcome you again in the future. For any future stays, please do not hesitate to contact us directly, we are always happy to assist and ensure our guests have the best possible experience.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

Thank you for providing us with such detailed feedback. We’re pleased to hear that you liked the location and found the apartment spacious.

Regarding the presence of ants, it's important to note that Madeira is a tropical island, and some insects can be common. However, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. We encourage our guests to communicate with us during their stay, as we were unaware of this issue. Pas d'accueil de l'agence! C'est notre chauffeur de taxi très gentil qui s'est débrouillé pour les clés car l'avion avait du retard et il était 1 h du matin. De plus le trousseau de clés n'avait pas la bonne clé pour entrer dans la résidence. La clé ouvrait une autre entrée non mentionnée sur la vidéo. Heureusement que le portier est venu à notre secours et a compris que la clé était pour l'autre entrée.
 Pas une corbeille de fruits, pas de jus de fruit ni de bouteille d'eau, rien pour nous accueillir. TRES IMPERSONNEL.
De plus, lors de notre départ, quand nous avons récupéré nos bagages (que le portier avait gentiment gardé chez lui de 10h à 15h,) il a oublié de me remettre le sac avec mes chaussures de rando, je m'en suis aperçue à l'aéroport et j'ai aussitôt envoyé un mail  de l'aéroport à Lucas (ATLANTIC HOLIDAY) qui m'a dit qu'il ne gérait qu'un seul appart dans cette résidence et qu'il ne se déplacerait pas. 
Je pense que c'est pourtant son travail de rendre service à leur client. Ils manquent d'humanité dans cette agence.
 Je ne connais pas le nom ni le N° de tél du portier et je ne peux donc pas le joindre. 
Je suis dépitée devant ce manque de professionnalisme.
J'ai demandé qu'il me les expédie mais il n'en a cure. Donc déception devant une telle indifférence et ne pas vouloir rendre service à des clients qui leur font gagner leur vie!
Comment récupérer mes chaussures de randonnée ???????
reviews.response:
Dear guest.

Thank you for your feedback regarding your stay at our property. It's important to address certain misunderstandings about the nature of our services and the specifics of your experience.

Our property is located in a apartment complex, distinct from a hotel, which might explain the absence of a reception and doorman services. For key collection, detailed instructions are provided to all our guests to facilitate a smooth self-check-in process, especially useful for late arrivals.

Regarding your hiking shoes, we recommend that guests keep personal belongings secure at all times, as our staff cannot take responsibility for items left with individuals not affiliated with our company.

For future stays, we encourage direct communication with the host to clarify any procedures or address concerns, which may prevent similar issues from occurring.

We hope this clarifies our position. Thank you for choosing our property, and we wish you safer and smoother travels ahead.

Kind regards,
Lucas Abreu - Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Oksana
reviews.title: Все дуже сподобалось! Розташування, чистота, кухня; ліжка, балкони, джакузі. Безконтактне заселення
reviews.positive:
Чудові апартаменти! Поряд  пляж, парковка біля апартаментів. Дві окремі спальні, кухня- столова; двоярусний балкон- тераси, джакузі. Все компактне, зручне. Кухня облаштована повністю. Багато рушників, праска, дошка; досить потужний фен, сушарка для речей. На вулицю можна вийти як з вітальні так і з однієї зі спален. Пральна  машинка, швабра, пилосос, вікно у ванній кімнаті.  Великі шафи у кожній спальні. Безконтактне заселення з відео-інструкціями як потрапити до апартаментів. Заїзд, до речі з верхньої дороги- це важливо; тому що ми півгодини шукали як заїхати. Великий повноцінний холодильник, морозильна камера, повно склянок,, посуду, чашок, кухонна дошка. Все новеньке, чистеньке, дуже охайне. Машико- маленьке містечко- ми шукали саме такий відпочинок. Краєвиди з апартаментів- розкішні, велико панорамне вікно! Майте на увазі, що ми потрапили на Атлантичний фестиваль ( був 6-9 червня 2025). В ці дні напевно вся Мадейра зʼїхалася до Машико. Було галасно майже до 1-2 годин ночі. Різні  ярмарки, вулична їжа, салюти, костюмовані конкурси та інше. 
Несподівано поїли смачні суши в маленькому японському ресторанчику напроти кавʼярні GALA; хазяїн  Кавʼярні GALA українець. В GALA все смачне- багато чого куштували. Сам господар кавʼярні; дуже приємна людина. До речі, українець за походженням. Ще біля пляжу є рибний ресторан Peskador- завітайте обовʼязково! Раджу ці бездоганні апартаменти від душі!
Якщо будете шукати авто на прокат- зазделегідь звертайтесь до агенції  «triple 777 rent a car». Застави немає, зустрічають в аеропорту, відвозять до аеропорту. Доброзичливі жінки та чудовий власник. Знаходяться теж неподалік апартаментів. До аеропорту 5 хв на автівці з посадкою- висадкою.

reviews.author: Sónia
reviews.title: Uma desilusão... Não voltaria a ficar neste alojamento.
reviews.positive: A vista
reviews.negative:
O apartamento não estava limpo corretamente. O chão tinha sujidade e havia muito pó em móveis.
As toalhas de banho tinham manchas acastanhadas.
O isolamento acústico é péssimo. Ouve-se a tv do vizinho, o ressonar, pessoas a falar... tudo... não deu para dormir nenhum dia.
Tivemos sem água no apartamento desde a madrugada até meio da tarde, o que trouxe bastantes constrangimentos nesse dia.
Deixam um cão no terraço abaixo, que fica a ladrar sem parar desde as 7h da manhã. Não permite descansar mais.
Ficámos os 2 últimos dias sem elevador. O apartamento fica no andar -4. 
Não houve nenhuma atenção pela parte de quem gere o alojamento, face a tudo isto acima relatado.
reviews.response:
Dear Sónia.

Thank you for your feedback.

We would like to clarify a few of the points mentioned in your review. As this is an apartment located within a residential building, some level of noise from neighbouring apartments can reasonably be expected. Nevertheless, we are sorry to know that this affected your stay.

Regarding the cleanliness concerns, as soon as we were informed of the issue, our cleaning team attended the property to address the points raised and provide new bath towels. We place great importance on maintaining high cleanliness standards and always aim to resolve any concerns reported by our guests as quickly as possible.

With regard to the water outage, this occurred for only one morning due to an unexpected leak in the building. Unfortunately, this was completely outside of our control. Similarly, the lift became unavailable due to a technical fault within the building. While we understand the inconvenience this caused, particularly given the apartment's location on a lower floor, this was also an unforeseen issue beyond our control.

Although we appreciate that these events were frustrating, it is important to note that both the water interruption and the lift breakdown were building-related incidents that could not have been anticipated or prevented by our team.

We appreciate your feedback and remain committed to providing the best possible experience for our guests.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.
