reviews.negative: El host entró a la casa sin permiso de los huespedes aun cuando ya estabamos dentro. Había muchas CUCARACHAS GIGANTES en la cocina lo que dice que no hay higiene suficiente. Me cobraron 2, 3 y 4 veces el impuesto... este alojamiento es una ESTAFA! Dice un monto total al hacer la reserva y luego del check out me cargaron a la tarjeta 225$ más sin motivo alguno aun cuando por correo se indicó que el impuesto ya había sido cobrado. NO SE HOSPEDEN AQUI. EL HOST ES UN ESTAFADOR.
reviews.response:
Dear Blanco.

Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly value your comments and the opportunity to address your concerns.

We would like to kindly clarify that no one entered the property without permission. The owner personally greeted you upon arrival to offer a welcome gift and to extend a warm welcome, as is customary for many of our guests.

Regarding cleanliness, the property is maintained by a professional cleaning team, and we take great care to ensure high standards are consistently met. It is also important to note that Madeira’s natural environment, can sometimes lead to the presence of small insects despite regular cleaning and preventive measures. Had we been informed during your stay, we would have been glad to apply an appropriate product to ensure your comfort.

Concerning the payment, this was related to municipality tax that you refused to pay. As this is clearly stated in the property’s rules and booking conditions, the corresponding fee was applied accordingly after you chose not to make the payment directly.

We appreciate your understanding and the opportunity to clarify these points. Thank you once again for your feedback, and we wish you all the best in your future travels.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Andrzej
reviews.title: Awsome stay
reviews.positive: Large space, close to the beach and kinda everywhere, free parking space, very friedly owners living in next house, clean.
reviews.negative: Nothing :)

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.positive: La maison est spacieuse et bien agencée avec ses trois chambres et trois sdb. Elle est moderne et très bien équipée à seulement 14 min de la plage et du centre ville. Un centre commercial est à proximité et nous pouvions garer notre voiture en toute sécurité. Les propriétaires vivent dans la maison mitoyenne, ils sont accueillants et très discrets. Nous avons apprécié le calme !
reviews.negative: Rien

reviews.title: פתרון דיור טוב ומשתלם למשפחה גדולה
reviews.positive:
הדירה גדולה  ומרווחת, במצב תחזוקה ממש טוב, נראה ששופץ לא מזמן.
בעל הדירה זמין וגר לייד
יש פרטיות שקט ורחוק מהכביש וממכוניות.
העיירה חביבה מאוד, אולם רוב מסלולי הטיול נמצאים בצידו השני של האי , זה לא הפריע כי היה לנו רכב.
זה מתאים למשפחה גדולה (היינו 7)
יש את כל כלי המטבח שצריך, וגם חנייה.
הבעלים זוג נחמד מאוד, ואני ממש ממליץ על היין שהוא מייצר בעצמו, (חבל שקנינו רק בקבוק אחד ולא יותר)  הוא נתן לנו טעימות וזה היה מעולה. היין הכי טוב שטעמנו בחיים !
reviews.negative:
הבעיה המרכזית בדירה היא מערכת המיים.
מותקנת בדירה משאבת לחץ מיים שמרעישה ומפריעה מאוד. ניתן לכבות אותה בלילה אולם אז לא אפשרי להתקלח כשהמשאבה סגורה.
היית מצפה שביחידת דיור ברמה כזו גבוה יפתרו את הבעיה הזו.
בעיה נוספת זה שגם אין מזגנים, וגם אין רשתות בחלונות.  זה קצת בעייתי מבחינת יתושים.
כמו כן קירות הפנים בנויים מגבס, אבל זה לא הפריע.

reviews.author: Lorphege
reviews.title: endroit agréable pour famille ou groupe d'ami

reviews.author: Jaroslaw
reviews.title: Pobyt uważam za udany i będziemy go miło wspominać :)
reviews.positive: Dom jest świeżo po remoncie co widać i czuć. Wszystkie pomieszczenia były czyste a dostarczone wyposażenie dobrej jakości (z pominięciem sztućców) Dom jest dobrze zlokalizowany, blisko do sklepów, lotniska, nabrzeża. Dom posiada miejsce parkingowe na dwa samochody - co na maderze nie jest takie oczywiste.
reviews.negative: W domu pracuje głośna pompa wody zimnej którą mocno słychać praktycznie w całym domu a już na pewno we wszystkich sypialniach. Pompa włącza się przy każdorazowym użyciu zimnej wody czyli również przy spłukiwaniu wody w toalecie i tym samym jeśli ktokolwiek z 8 osób w nocy skorzysta z WC to praca pompy budzi pozostałych mieszkańców. Było to mocno uciążliwe. Kolejna niedogodnością była zbierająca się w sypialniach wilgoć. W domu oprócz okien nie ma żadnej formy wentylacji i tym samym po nocy czuć wszechobecną wilgoci którą trzeba wietrzyć, co nie jest zbyt przyjemne szczególnie w chłodniejszym okresie. W domu nie ma żadnego ogrzewania, co nie stanowi problemu w sypialniach czy innych pomieszczeniach, jednak wchodzenie rano do zimnej i wilgotnej łazienki nie jest niczym przyjemnym. Sztućce które są na wyposażeniu domu są słabej jakości, posiadają spękane uchwyty i wypada część metalowa od plastikowej. Dom jest usytuowany w niedalekiej okolicy ruchliwej ulicy i przy otwartych oknach słychać ruch uliczny, szczególnie przelatujące motocykle na pełnym gazie.

reviews.author: Stefan
reviews.title: Ein wunderschönes Ferienhaus mit außerordentlich freundlichen Besitzern
reviews.positive:
Das Haus liegt in einer ruhigen Wohnstraße ohne Verkehrslärm, auch startende Flugzeuge vom nahen Airport sind bei geschlossenen Fenstern nicht zu hören. Das Auto parkt komfortabel auf dem Grundstück, aber auch auf der Straße stehen fast immer kostenfreie Parkplätze zur Verfügung. 
Das Haus ist neu und großzügig angelegt und macht seinem Namen Solarium alle Ehre. Zwei Seiten des Erdgeschosses sind verglast, sodass es immer hell und freundlich ist. 
Im Erdgeschoss befindet sich eine geräumige Küche mir viel Arbeitsfläche, allen Geräten und einem Esstisch. Daneben lädt eine kleine Sitzecke zum Entspannen ein. 
Im Obergeschoss sind drei Schlafzimmer (jedes mit eigenem Bad) um ein gemütliches Wohnzimmer angeordnet.
Bemerkenswert ist die Qualität der Matratzen und die Größe der Schränke. 
Der Kontakt zu den Eigentümern gestaltete sich äußerst angenehm. Wir würden nicht nur mit vielen nützlichen Informationen versorgt, sondern darüber hinaus mit Obst und Gemüse aus dem eigenen Garten und selbstgemachtem Wein verwöhnt. So viel Herzlichkeit ist selten und wir bedanken uns nochmals dafür. 
Wir können das Solarium in Machico uneingeschränkt empfehlen.

reviews.author: Robmtb
reviews.title: Ogólnie bardzo pozytywnie. Właściciele bardzo mili, częstują swoim winem i oferują lokalne owoce.
reviews.positive: Spokój, dom duży, wygodny, dobra lokalizacja niedaleko lotniska. Świetnie wyposażona kuchnia. Prysznice duże wygodne.
reviews.negative: Nie podobała mi się pompa wodna włączająca się nad sufitem mojego pokoju za każdym razem, gdy ktoś odkręcił wodę. Ale to chyba norma w tego typu stronach.

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.title: Świetny kontakt z właścicielem. Na miejscu przyjazna i gościnna atmosfera. Obiekt spełnia w 100% oczekiwania lokalizacji
reviews.positive: Przestrzeń, czystość, komfort
reviews.negative: Brak

reviews.author: Marshall
reviews.title: Very modern and clean, great location, but no A/C or window screens
reviews.positive: The property was extremely clean, and very modern.  The kitchen was great- spacious, modern, and stocked with plenty of dishes.  (I can't comment on the pots and pans- we never cooked.)  All three bedrooms upstairs had en-suite bathrooms, which was great.  Plus there was another full bath upstairs, and a half bath downstairs.  The owners, who happen to live right next door, were incredibly welcoming.  The location was terrific- a pleasant 7 minute walk to the big grocery store (Continente), and a ten minute walk to the town center of Machico, where there were about 7 restaurants.
reviews.negative:
Be aware that there is no A/C or heating system, and no screens on the windows.  There are mosquitoes.  We visited in early October, and it was warm and very humid.  A/C would have been nice, but we could have been happy without it because it cooled off every evening.  BUT when we opened windows to cool off the house, mosquitoes came in.  Not huge numbers, but even one will spoil your sleep.  So the choice was:  hot nights in the bedrooms; or, mosquitoes. 
One other important thing: the third bedroom (with twin beds) has a loud pump in the ceiling that the kicks on ANYTIME water is used, at any tap in the house.  It was quite loud.  So we all had to agree- no flushing of toilets after lights out.  So the 3rd bedroom was not a great place to be.

reviews.author: Mateusz
reviews.positive:
Wszystko 10/ 10. 
Właściciele obieku bardzo pomocni i sympatyczni, przez cały pobyt dbali o nasz komfort. Produkują własne wina oraz mają swoje świeże owoce.

reviews.author: Carmen
reviews.title: Casa con mucha paz y jardín tropical
reviews.positive: Fuimos dos familias con nuestros hijos respectivos y en cada habitacion tenía un baño completo por lo que estuvimos muy cómodos, una cocina amplia donde disfrutamos preparando los desayunos para salir y recorrer la isla. Los dueños de la casa nos ofrecieron fruta que tenían sembrada en el jardín de la casa. La isla de Madeira es muy bonita.
reviews.negative: Que el baño de una de las habitaciones tenía tupido el desagüe de la ducha, pero no fue un problema los solucionamos.
reviews.response:
Dear Carmen,

We are so pleased to read your kind words and to learn that you and your families had a comfortable and enjoyable stay. It’s wonderful to know that the spacious kitchen added to your experience, making your mornings more pleasant before exploring the lovely Madeira island. We’re glad you enjoyed the fresh fruit from our garden—a small gesture to make you feel at home.

We appreciate your patience regarding the shower drain issue and are grateful that it didn’t impact your stay. For any future stays, if you encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to contact us right away. We’re here to assist and ensure that your experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible. We look forward to the possibility of welcoming you back soon.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Krystyna
reviews.title: Jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni i na pewno wrócimy szybko na Maderę.
reviews.positive: Dom jest usytuowany niedaleko mało ruchliwej drogi, z widokiem na piękny ogród w którym rosną egzotyczne owoce. W domu znajdują się wszystkie potrzebne sprzęty i urządzenia jak w opisie. Są środki czystości, w każdej łazience mydło i ręczniki. Ku naszemu zdziwieniu były nawet kapsułki do kawy. Do plaży pieszo dostaniesz się w 10 minut, sklep i przystanek autobusowy blisko. Dobry punkt wypadowy na wycieczki po wyspie. Nie ma tłumów jak w innych turystycznych miejscowościach- idealnie aby odpocząć. W razie jakiś problemów gospodarze mieszkają nieopodal i zawsze służą radą. Zostaliśmy poczęstowani również pysznymi owocami i domowym winem. Bardzo polecamy!!!
reviews.negative: Widziałam opinie że nadal jest problem z termostatem w prysznicu. Myślę że to wina systemu nagrzewania wody- ja się szybko przyzwyczaiłam i mi to nie przeszkadzało. jak się włącza wodę to hałasuje boiler.najbardziej na górze nad sypialnią z oknem z tyłu domu.
reviews.response:
Dear Krystyna.

It was a pleasure reading your thoughtful review. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful setting of our house, the convenience of the nearby beach and shops, and the fully equipped amenities. We’re glad that the little touches, like coffee capsules and fresh fruit from our garden, made your stay even more enjoyable. It’s great to know that you found our location ideal for exploring the island while enjoying the tranquility.

Thank you for bringing up the thermostat and boiler noise. While we’re pleased it didn’t detract from your experience, we’ll continue to monitor and address these issues. For any future stays, please don’t hesitate to reach out if you need any assistance, we’re always nearby and happy to help. We look forward to the opportunity to host you again!

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Bertille
reviews.title: Je recommande cette maison est parfaite pour des vacances à Madère.
reviews.positive: La maison est très bien, localisé, très propre tout est neuf.
reviews.negative: Un seul petit détail serait l’odeur du WC du bas

reviews.author: Eligijus
reviews.title: Well located house with hospitable owners
reviews.positive:
The location is incredible - situated in Machico, the city is very calm and quiet, and only a 25 minute drive from Funchal. It is very close to the airport which was a great benefit when going to the property for the first time. There's the wonderful Machico beach within walking distance, as well as a Continente shopping centre where you can get your groceries.
Check-In process was simple - you put in the code and get the keys. 
All communication is done through Whatsapp with the rental company - they send you a video with instructions on the house.
The house is spacious and as advertised.
Any issues are promptly fixed.
The owners are very hospitable - we went on a hike with them, they also gave us their homemade wine and brought fruits from their garden.
There are a few cats visiting the house regularly, which was a welcome sight every morning, we made friends with one orange fella.
reviews.negative:
There were some unwanted "visitors" during our stay of two weeks - a lizard, some bugs, ants. Not much can be done about these but something to keep in mind when booking if that is an issue for you.

The below are mostly nitpicks that would make the stay even more enjoyable:
The showers could ideally be equipped with a thermostatic mixer as it's a bit difficult to get the right temperature.
The washing machine is a bit hard to open, but works fine.

reviews.author: Maricel
reviews.title: Eccezionale
reviews.positive: La casa è molto bella,la cucina è ben fornita il letto e comodissimo i proprietari di casa Luis e Marli sono molto accoglienti bravissimi persone,e vicino al supermercato,al mare,in farmacia e 8 min dal aeroporto ci ritorneremo di sicuro 🥰
reviews.negative: L’acqua nella doccia e difficile a regolare ma niente di grave

reviews.author: Ella
reviews.title: The holiday turned out to be excellent.Thanks to both the owners and the management company for this
reviews.positive: Very clean, comfortable, convenient. There are towels and all kitchen utensils. Located 15 minutes from the sandy beach, 10 minutes walk to the supermarket and the centre. Very friendly owners. They showed us the surrounding area and the best places for tourists, treated us to their own wine and fruits from the garden. Thanks to Louise and Marley for the company. I recommend! The organization of arrival, stay and departure was organized at the highest level. Thanks to the management company.
reviews.negative: Nothing. Everything was amazing. No flaws.  I recommend!

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.positive: Our stay was fantastic, the hosts ale really nice and helpful, the house was perfect for our big family. Very good location. Strongly recommand!

reviews.author: Sonia
reviews.positive: Todo, la verdad que tenia dudas al cogerlo porque no tenia comentarios, pero es porque estan empezando y me alegro de haber dado una oportunidad! Los anfitrones un 10, amables, atentos y detallistas y la casa estaba muy bien! Asi que totalmente recomendable!

reviews.author: Antonija
reviews.positive:
Very nice owners. Their beautiful cat was visiting us every day. 😻
We had some maintenace problems, and owners dealt with it emediately, so it did not effect on our stay.

reviews.author: Jakub
reviews.positive: Dům byl zbrusu nový, prostorný a pěkně zařízený. Klidné místo. Pěšky na pláž. Dobý výchozí bod pro výlety.
reviews.response:
Dear Jakub.

Thank you for your feedback it is highly appreciated.
We are glad to know everything was up to your standards and that you enjoyed your stay,
Please know it was an absolute pleasure hosting you on Solarium Villa by Atlantic Holiday and you are welcome back anytime.

Best regards,
Selma Santos - Atlantic Holiday Front Desk

reviews.author: Klaudia
reviews.positive: Apartment was clean , garden was beatiful and the view from the rooftop was amazing.
reviews.negative: At first sight everything looked perfect.  But then a few bad things came out. We found three dead cockcroaches in the kitchen, dead lizard and we saw a lizard in the sink once. The cockcroaches were big and disgusting, we had to clean them up. The front door was really hard to open. We struggled every single day. Jacuzzi didn’t work, when we tried to use it in the evening water was cold and didn’t heat up, even after few hours. There was some kind of error, we wrote about it to the owner, he said he would fix it, but nothing changed. Overall the contact with the owner was tragic, he didn’t respond to first message for two days. Coffee machine also didn’t work. I think this place has potential but is under bad manegment.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Soggiorno fantastico, Pedro davvero accogliente. Descrizione dell’appartamento accurata così come le foto, consigliatiss
reviews.positive: Casa pulitissima, ben fornita e in una zona ottima (strategica sia per raggiungere comodamente i vari cammini e sia per le spiagge/ristoranti)

reviews.author: Paweł
reviews.positive: The apartment was really cosy, comfortable, had an amazing view from the terrace and as a bonus a jacuzzi and grill. The kitchen was well equipped (coffee machine and toster as well). The location was perfect for planing trips. I had the impression that we could get everywhere on the island in half an hour. The host was very helpful and nice and I would like to thank him for his hospitabilty. We had an amazing time.

reviews.author: Ann-kathrin
reviews.title: Gute Lage, für uns nicht nochmal
reviews.positive: Einfacher Check in. Schnelle Antwort vom Vermieter. Parkplatz direkt vor dem Haus.
reviews.negative:
In der Unterkunft war es sehr warm und stickig sowie abgestandener Geruch. Kaum Möglichkeiten zu lüften, sowie allgemein sehr düster in der Wohnung - anders als auf den Bildern. 
Wir hatten zuvor von den Kakerlaken gelesen, und gehofft, dass dieses Problem beseitigt wäre. Leider hatten wir in der 2ten und 3ten Nacht ingesamt 3 Tote Kakerlaken neben dem Bett und im Flur. Der Vermieter kümmerte sich schnell um das problem - jedoch gab er an, dass dieses problem für ihn sehr überraschend kam - was laut den vorherigen Bewertungen jedoch schon bekannt sein müsste.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.title: Grandma's cottage with a hottub
reviews.positive:
Grandma's little cottage! Very spacious and quaint with a beautiful garden and a roof terrace with a hottub! Very quiet, although there is a local bar right next door.
It's a bit of a walk into town but doable. It's better to have a car.
Very nice young man running it. 
It had a fan, which was a godsend.
reviews.negative:
The driveway is only for locals who are used to fitting in weird angles or have tiny cars. I tried it for a day but ended up parking on the street after my anxiety took over. 
Its a tad dark in the house and I was visited by a couple creepy crawlies that the owner assured me he'd have taken care of. 

.

reviews.author: Kata
reviews.positive:
The house was perfectly equipped with everything we needed. Everything worked properly and communication was very smooth.
thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.positive: Super fast contact with the host, private parking spot, lot of space, washing machine, nice welcome gift, quite good location, big shop nearby.
reviews.negative: To use yacusi you must heat the water for at least 6h, little daylight inside the house, quite big moisture,  we could hear neigbours that were placed below.

reviews.author: Blénesi
reviews.title: Perfect place for a longer stay in the island.
reviews.positive: Well-equipped, perfect apartment for a longer stay. There is a gas station and supermarket near. You can explore the island by car from here very easy. The kitchen is also perfect for preparing food-even baking cookies :D . You can park your car inside the property. The jacuzzi was also amazing. Thank you! :)

reviews.author: Karine
reviews.positive:
L emplacement les équipements de la maison 
Le parking à l intérieur 
Le petit plus le spa
reviews.negative: Rien

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.title: Super na 4,5 dni, jako baza wypadowa również po północnym wybrzeżu
reviews.positive: Dużo miejsca, zarówno w domu jak i na zewnątrz.
reviews.negative: Zepsuta deska sedesowa, po prostu do naprawy lub wymiany

reviews.author: Federica
reviews.positive:
Casa con tutto il necessario, peccato non aver potuto usufruire dell' idromassaggio a causa del maltempo.
A 2km dal centro di Sao Vicente e dal supermercato e bar.
Comoda per raggiungere la cost nord.
reviews.negative: Resta un po' cupa all' interno poiché non passa molta luce naturale.

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.title: madeira family home style property
reviews.positive: lovely traditional style house. well kitted out in the kitchen. We had a couple of unavoidable issues which were taken straight away. caretaker was lovely and owner was staying upstairs and introduced herself. we would definitely stay again. car is essential anywhere in that area. our only gripe would be could do with mattress replacement.

reviews.author: Alberto
reviews.positive: ubicacion, terraza
reviews.negative:
El alojamiento estaba bastante sucio, había cucarachas por la cocina, había lavadora pero no  detergente. Para lavar los platos nos dejaron un culin de fairy  tuvimos que fregar todos los platos y vasos antes de usarlos por que estaban sucios, igual que el horno.

Las camas no eran incomodas, pero sonaban muchísimo.
Llevar un poquito de Cucal, os vendrá bien.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Wanted to love it, but couldn't.
reviews.positive: Rooftop with a hot tub (but didn't work 2 out of 3 days)
reviews.negative: Check in was difficult - had a 3 minute video with clear instructions but didn't get delivered due to low data and no wi-fi until long after we arrived and couldn't get in and had to walk to dinner and try to log on... Then the door manages to lock from the outside so we got locked out trying to explore the rooftop and though they were quick to solve our predicament, felt like a silly design...the hot tub was one of the main attractions and got luke warm after 7 hours of heating...required 12+ hours before we could finally use it...and the location is far from town- we walked once but wouldn't again. House was very hot and insulated and kept heat in, no AC and two standing fans were struggling to keep it cool enough even though outside was plenty breezy. Beds were mediocre and loud and squeaky and woke up other roommates with any rolling.

reviews.author: Hjj
reviews.positive: La struttura è stata ricostruita in modo affascinante e suggestivo
reviews.negative: Ci sono piccoli accorgimenti e miglioramenti da fare

reviews.author: Valeria
reviews.positive: Nice location, quite place, very good communication
reviews.negative: Generally needs better cleaning and there is no basic things like salt, olive oil, kitchen paper, trash bags which we think its a must at this price!

reviews.author: Berenika
reviews.title: Przepiękna lokalizacja domu, który wymaga większej uwagi ze strony właściciela.
reviews.positive:
Mieliśmy szczęście, że przydzielono nas do mieszkania na piętrze, do którego należy też piękny ogród z roślinami, grill oraz dodatkowy taras z jacuzzi z którego rozciąga się zapierający dech w piersiach widok. Bycie w ogrodzie domu to olbrzymia przyjemność. 
Dom zlokalizowany jest w przeuroczej wiosce, otoczonej malowniczymi górami. Wioska jest bardzo blisko wszelkich ważnych atrakcji na północy wyspy. Dojazd jest łatwy i wiedzie uroczymi drogami. Dom znajduje się w idealnym punkcie dla osób wybierających się na trekking.
Mieszkanie jest duże, na pewno ma ogromny potencjał, ale wszystko to co najlepsze znajduje się poza nim. 
Agencja była dość szybka w odpowiedziach na nasze ew pytania dot pobytu. Nie mieliśmy żadnego problemu z wejściem do domu czy zameldowaniem.
reviews.negative:
Obiekt jest daleki od doskonałego a wpływa na to olbrzymia ilość niedociągnięć. 
Po pierwsze parking - zaparkowanie na podjeździe wymaga większych od przeciętnych umiejętności parkowania i wysokiego podwozia. Duży auto o niskim zawieszeniu nie ma tam szans. 
Ogródek jest piękny, ale ławka przed domem zniszczona. Schody na taras nie maja żadnej poręczy wiec schodzenie i wchodzenie na taras z jacuzzi w nocy nie jest bezpieczne. 
W salonie czuć wciąż zapach pleśni i wilgoci - nie da sie go wywietrzyć. W kuchni w szufladach ze sztućcami śmierdzi pleśnią tak bardzo, że musieliśmy wyparzyć wszytko przed użyciem. Naczynia - talerze i kubki były brudne - miały zaschnięte ślady jedzenia po poprzednich najemcach. Lodówka się nie domyka. W kuchni nie było nawet jednej torebki herbaty, kapsułki kawy, nawet mililitra oleju czy oliwy - to bardzo niegościnnie podejście - w domach na wynajem goście mogą liczyć na takie podstawowe rzeczy chociaż na przywitanie. Zostawiono nam końcówkę płynu do naczyń na 7 dni. 
Łazienka jest niedoczyszczona - na deszczownicy były resztki papieru lub ścierki. W pojemniku resztka mydła do rąk. 
Łóżka są tak twarde, że nie są się w nich normalnie spać. Budziliśmy się w nocy z powodu bólu kręgosłupa. Nie bylismy w stanie nie sobie spać przez cały pobyt.
W domu jest dużo robactwa - w kuchni i jadalni są mrówki, w pralni spotkałam olbrzymiego prusaka. 
Pomimo tego co widzieliśmy na filmie instruktażowym przesłanym przez agenta w palenisku grilla nie było nawet jednego węgielka czy drewna nawet na jedno rozpalenie by przygotować posiłek po przyjezdzie - musieliśmy zawrócić do sklepu po węgiel. Nie mogliśmy też mieć dostępu do żadnych środków chemicznych zamkniętych w pralni. Musieliśmy wiec kupić cały proszek by zrobić jedno pranie. 

To rzeczy mogą wydawać się detalem, ale wpływają na odbiór całego domu. Niestety w negatywny sposób. Wystarczy odrobinę wysiłku by zmienić te minusy w zalety.

Communication facile et séjour sans aucun problème.

There was no problems with parking at all.  Getting to the apartment was very easy. A few days before our arrival, I received a WhatsApp message from the staff and a short video with clear instructions. The building is right next to a local road, but traffic wasn't a major issue.

reviews.author: Carina
reviews.title: Stayed over a week
reviews.comment:
We had a great stay and would happily recommend this apartment. It was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, well-equipped, with only a few minor cosmetic imperfections that didn’t affect our stay.
The location is excellent. The metro is just behind the stadium, with easy access to the city centre and airport. There’s also a large shopping centre nearby with a well-stocked supermarket.
The host was responsive and quickly resolved the only issue we had.
The building’s washing machine is coin-operated, so bring some coins if you plan to do laundry. There’s a clothes drying rack available, but bring a few clothes pegs as it can get windy on the balcony. The pool is clean and well-maintained, but there are no sun loungers, so bring a beach towel if you want to sunbathe.
Although the apartment is on the ground floor, the balcony is around 2–3 metres above street level, so it still felt private.
We’d definitely stay here again.
reviews.response:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your stay and found the apartment clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Your tips about the laundry and balcony are incredibly helpful for future guests—thank you for sharing! We appreciate your kind words about our responsiveness, and we're glad we could assist you during your stay. We’d love to welcome you back anytime for another great experience! 
Warm regards,  
The Host Wise Team

reviews.response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts with us! We appreciate your acknowledgment of our efforts and are glad to hear that your stay was acceptable. We’re always looking for ways to enhance our guests' experiences, so if you have any suggestions for improvement, we’d love to hear them. We hope to welcome you back in the future for an even better stay! 
Best,  
The Host Wise Team

reviews.author: Kseniia
reviews.positive: Great location—about a 15-minute walk to the Porto Moritz pools. The villa is spacious and warm.
reviews.negative: Unfortunately, the jacuzzi wasn’t working during our stay, which was disappointing as we were really looking forward to using it.
reviews.response:
Thank you, Ksenia, for your review and for highlighting the great location and spaciousness of the villa. We’re very glad to hear you enjoyed the proximity to the Porto Moniz pools and found the house comfortable and warm.
We’re truly sorry about the jacuzzi not being available during your stay. Unfortunately, unexpected technical issues can occasionally occur, and we understand how disappointing this must have been, especially as it’s a feature many guests look forward to. Please rest assured that this has been addressed.
We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future for a fully perfect experience.

reviews.author: Stéphane
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Très belle maison, fonctionnelle et très bien équipé, piscine magnifique. Echanges fluides et efficace avec Atlantic Holiday du début  à la fin du séjour. Je recommande!

reviews.author: Konstantin
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
Beautiful villa. Great view over the ocean. Nice pool. Had everything we needed to cook and bbq.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Simply perfect.

reviews.author: Bandar
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
The worst part and a spoiler was to wait for cleaners to finish well after the checking in time of 4.0pm. 
They left after 5.0pm
I consider that to be very disrespectful and unprofessional.
reviews.response:
Dear Bandar.
We would like to clarify your review, as it does not accurately reflect what happened.
You attempted to access the property well before the official check-in time and without our authorisation. When you later returned to the property, at approximately 17h00 the cleaning team was already leaving with their vehicle. Therefore, it is not accurate to state that you had to wait for the cleaning team to finish, as you attempted to enter the property before the official check-in time.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Elisa
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Logement fidèle à sa description, une villa très grande et très bien équipée

reviews.author: Allard
reviews.title: Stayed over a week
reviews.comment:
De villa is mooi en groot opgezet. Voldoende ruimte voor iedereen.
Heerlijk in de zon kunnen zitten ook in de aparte buiten ruimte naast de huiskamer. 
Helaas hadden we wat problemen met lekkage waardoor 1 kamer niet te gebruiken was. 
Dit was tijdens ons verblijf niet op te lossen.
reviews.response:
Dear Allard.
Thank you for your kind feedback. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the villa, its spacious layout, and the outdoor areas for relaxing in the sun.
We sincerely apologize for the leak that affected the barbecue area during your stay. This issue has now been fully resolved. We also want to thank you for your understanding and for accepting the refund we offered to compensate for the inconvenience caused.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Arne
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: If You Are not happy here. You will not be happy anywhere. House is perfect in layout. For all the best qualities. Not only well functioning aircon in all rooms, but a very quiet aircon. Not only kitschen, but big well equipped kitschen. Not only common areas, but common areas for every temperature and time of day. If you want to be downtown, this might not be best choice, but if you want a fantastic house, fantastic view and quiet surroundings, this might be amongst the best options in the world.

reviews.author: Hatim
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Great stay we really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Benoit
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Beautiful villa with a beautiful view from almost all the rooms. Living room + kitchen space very pleasant. 
Bed and bathrooms nice. Kitchen well equipped. 
Very easy to contact the owner and to exchange with him.

reviews.author: Hazqeel
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Absolutely lovely stay! The view was stunning — the kind that instantly makes you feel relaxed and on vacation. The location was peaceful and conveniently situated, making it easy to get around while still feeling like a true getaway. Our host was fantastic — great communication throughout and always available to help with anything we needed. Everything was smooth, comfortable, and exactly what we were hoping for. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Nabeel
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Avoid this host. We had issues with the AC as advertised in their listing. It first started off with the host denying the issue (although they sent a rep out and they confirmed the problem), then they claimed listing just says AC which means it’s not for the entire house, then they insisted that since it’s winter season we don’t need AC. Note that during the day, inside temps hit 27C and the bedrooms would be extremely hot all night although it was 19C outside. We couldn’t keep the balcony doors open as there are no bug screens. To make matters worse, the host refused to fix until our last night claiming no contractors work weekends. Easy Google search landed multiple HVAC certified techs that were available and when presented to the host, they started threatening us to deter us from raising issues. Also, as per their initial retaliatory suggestion, I raised it to AirBnB via refund request - how you escalate the issue - and AirBnB helped us out. Look for retaliatory response below.
reviews.response:
Dear Nabeel.
Thank you for your feedback. We believe it is important to clarify the events you described to provide a more accurate perspective.
Regarding the AC Issue:
After you reported the issue on Friday, we immediately sent someone to check the situation. It was confirmed that two of the six AC units in the house were not functioning, while the remaining units were operational and available to cool the property. Additionally, the indoor temperature was approximately 20°C, which is typical for this season.
Repair Scheduling:
We arranged for our trusted technician to visit on Monday at 2 PM to address the problem. While we understand your frustration with the timeline, resolving such issues requires skilled professionals we trust, not someone chosen randomly online. Ensuring quality and reliable repairs is part of our commitment to maintaining the property for all guests.
Technician Visit:
Initially, access for the technician was denied, which caused delays. When access was later granted, the situation escalated due to accusations and misunderstandings about our intentions, including unwarranted claims that we were attempting to document your actions. We want to clarify that our only goal was to resolve the issue effectively.
Communication and Behavior:
Throughout the process, we aimed to handle the situation respectfully and professionally, despite the challenges posed by some of the interactions. The private comment left in your feedback, “Grow up,” further underscores the unnecessary hostility encountered during this stay. We expect mutual respect from all guests, just as we strive to provide the same.
While this stay may not have met your expectations, we handled your concerns with diligence and within the reasonable limitations of the situation. Our priority remains delivering a comfortable and reliable experience for all guests.

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
super logement pour un petit groupe! un peu loin de Funchal (35 minutes en voiture), mais sinon c’est parfait. ça prend vraiment une voiture pour bien apprécié! n’oubliez pas d’aller boire un verre au Pukiki
parfait

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
This is a beautiful villa that we were very lucky to find. If it’s available you should book it now, you won’t be disappointed. 
It’s clear a lot of time, effort and money has gone into making this stunning villa while still managing to maintain its family feel. 
The views are second to none and the facilities are fantastic. I think this trip has ruined future holidays for us as they will have to live up to this one!
The team at Atlantic Holidays were fantastic and easily contactable via a messaging (WA) group set up the day before. 
Don’t be put off by the reports of the steep hill, it is true but once you have done it once it becomes second nature. The shop at the bottom of the hill provided everything we needed for the week. 
We enjoyed dinners cooked on the BBQ in the inside/outside kitchen area and also venturing down to the marina to spend an evening there. 
We would love to return and are already making plans.
reviews.response:
Dear Mark. 
Thank you very much for the top rating and your kind comments; we truly appreciate your feedback. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your stay at our property and felt that it offered excellent value for money.
We’re pleased that you enjoyed the views and the ambiance, and that it met your expectations of quality. We take great pride in your positive remarks about our team, as we strive to make our guests feel as comfortable as possible and ensure easy communication.
It’s wonderful to know that you found Ribeira Brava to be a peaceful place with all the necessities you needed nearby.
We would be thrilled to welcome you back and help you create even more great memories on the island. Thank you once again for sharing your feedback with us; your input is invaluable. Please feel free to contact us directly before your next visit if you need any assistance.
Warm regards,
From the whole Atlantic Holiday team!

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment: Very comfortable environment  , very responsive hosts …super quick for our only request .. they were helpful in our request for recommendations for excursions and restaurants…. Clean , spacious and great view with lots of furniture to relax on . Not a trendy area ; feel like you are lucky enough to live like a local .. highly recommend

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment: We enjoyed our stay in this lovely house.

reviews.author: Vincent
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: We had a very pleasant stay at the Atlantic holidays house. The villa was amazing and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, the infinity pool was stunning and also the overall communication with the host was fast & pro active! Great place to stay in Madeira!

reviews.author: Meaghan
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
We really enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. The host was responsive and timely whenever we had questions. 
Kitchen was stocked with essentials- pots, pans, silverware, utensils, etc. and the entire house was clean and well kept when we arrived. We did pay to heat the pool, and this fee does have to be paid up front on the day of check in for the total time of your stay (no picking or choosing certain days to heat vs not) in cash. As a reminder to guests- this is a slightly heated pool (about 28 Celsius) NOT a hot tub or jacuzzi- so make sure that is what your party wants to pay for before deciding to pay to heat or not.
The beds were comfortable, the balcony views are great (a note- the upstairs blinds do all seem to sync no matter which room draws them up or down- this could have been user error-but when one room remotely lifted the blinds it opened them for all 3 upstairs bedrooms)
Local stray cats love + feel comfortable at the house- an unexpected but pleasant surprise for us!
reviews.response:
Dear Meaghan. 
We are pleased to know that you found us responsive and timely in addressing your needs during your stay. We always strive to maintain the best possible communication with our guests.
The heated pool is considered an additional amenity, which is why it incurs a separate charge. The cost is determined based on the number of nights you stay at the property.
Regarding the blinds, we are unsure of the specific issue you encountered, but please rest assured that they are functioning properly at the moment. Thank you for bringing this to our attention either way!
We are also delighted that you enjoyed the surprise visit from the local cats!
Thank you again for your feedback, and we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the future.
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Pedro
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: La casa es mejor que como se ve en las fotos. Aunque esté a 35 kilómetros De Funchal, el distrito es muy tranquilo y la comunicación es buena, que era lo que nosotros buscábamos. La comunicación es muy buena, y los sitios recomendados son excepcionales.  Sin duda totalmente recomendable.

reviews.author: Paul-Michel
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Très belle villa au calme dans une région préservée du tourisme de masse

reviews.author: Arne
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Flott hus med nydelig utsikt og rolige omgivelser. Du er avhengig av bil da det er svært bratt!

reviews.author: Bruno
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: ótimo lugar. casa extremamente limpa e com excelentes condições. piscina impecavel. muito sossegado. aconselho

reviews.author: Gert
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Everything was perfect, one of the best places we ever stayed in. Large, well maintained and equipped, professionally managed, fantastic design and comfort, locations and views. We loved to stay there and will come again.

reviews.author: Clare
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment:
Madeira is beautiful but mountainous rather than hilly, so the roads away from the main roads are often very narrow and very steep, which can be a challenge!
The property was gorgeous, modern, beautiful, peaceful and with plenty of space, with 4 large en-suite bedrooms.
The villa was near a little supermarket, which stocked most of what you need but the hill back is very steep so you do really need to use the car.
We did some hiking, and the weather was gorgeous.
The only downside was that there are no restaurants in walking distance so you do have to use the car. That aside, we had a great holiday.
reviews.response:
Dear Clare. 
Thank you very much for the high rating and for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your stay and that our services and facilities met your expectations, from the room sizes to the beauty of the space.
There's a restaurant just a 5-minute walk away, and a small supermarket nearby should you need anything during your next visit.
We’re thrilled that you had a great holiday and appreciate your kind comments.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment:
Amazing place to stay!! I would definitely recommend for a a family trip here! The rooms were all beautiful and 3 out of the 4 had balcony access. 
The view was also wonderful! Vistas of the ocean and a small pasture below. This made for a wonderful time outside swimming, cooking (in the outdoor kitchen), or relaxing. 
Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I would recommend this place to everyone! The host was also very responsive. 
Also, about 15 mins to ponta do sol and about 35 mins to Funchal. Calheta had a couple of great places to eat and had a grocery store as well!
reviews.response:
Dear David. 
We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude for taking the time to share such a delightful review of your recent stay at Villa de la Ponte. Your kind words have truly brightened our day, and we are thrilled to hear about your positive experience.
We are delighted that you made the most of the property’s spaces and enjoyed the swimming pool and outdoor cooking, taking full advantage of the beautiful Madeira weather.
Thank you once again for your feedback. We hope to welcome you back in the future!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holidays.

reviews.author: Bojana
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: The house was as expected for a 5-star property. Very well designed, beautifully furnished and decorated, with plenty of space for multy-family use. Functional kitchen with a butler's kitchen was a rare experience. Outdoor areas expansive, the heated pool well sized. Minor flaws can be easily corrected: there was only one hair drier (four bathrooms), the drying rack had broken legs, several saucepans did not work on the induction stove. Most importantly, the kitchen and laundry appliances had no printed user instructions and were not intuitive. A set of instructions would be useful. The view is magnificent, neighbourhood quiet. Steep road access, but manageable. Supermarket and several very good restaurants within 15 min drive. The location of the property was ideal for our hiking week, dominating the western part of the island, with easy access to the main southern road to Funchal. We highly recommend this property.
reviews.response:
Dear Bojana. 
Thank you for sharing your comments and feedback on your recent experience at our property. We are pleased to hear that you enjoyed the location and that the villa met your expectations, allowing you and your family to make the most of your stay.
We appreciate you bringing certain issues to our attention. For future reference, if you need assistance with anything, such as using the kitchen appliances you mentioned, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We would have been more than happy to help. We have already replaced the drying racks and saucepans, and added more hairdryers to the property. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve.
We look forward to hosting you again in the near future and appreciate your recommendation.
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
I honestly couldn't rate this place highly enough. The property is stunning and exactly as described. We were blown away by it when we walked in and it had everything we needed. The pool is really big and the views from the pool were breathtaking. 
The hosts were so helpful. They did everything they said they would and more. They were always on hand to help whenever I contacted them. The location is a little away from things but we were able to arrange transfers with the hosts when needed and there is a really good taxi service nearby. There are a couple of restaurants close by but we only ate at one as we were only there 5 nights and the food was amazing. 
I would honestly recommend this place to anyone looking for luxury in Madeira.
reviews.response:
Dear Catherine. 
We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the property so much and that it exceeded your expectations. Your high rating means a great deal to us!
We strive to uphold our commitments and build trust with our guests, and we are pleased that our efforts to assist and support you were evident. It is important to us that our guests feel well cared for and valued.
Thank you very much for your kind recommendation. We look forward to the opportunity to welcome you back in the future!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Benyu
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: The pictures didn’t do justice for how beautiful the house was. If you like a place that is quite peaceful and away from the hustle I would wholeheartedly recommend this place. There were a few restaurants nearby but found one awesome place named as fontes do Horacio. The size of the house is huge and may have definitely been too big for us three but we loved our stay and wouldn’t hesitate to come back.
reviews.response:
Dear Benyu. 
Thank you for taking the time to write such a lovely review regarding your recent stay at our property. We appreciate your recommendation of the villa.
We’re glad that the size of the house, although larger than necessary for your group, added to your comfort. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be delighted to welcome you back anytime.
We can’t wait to welcome you back!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Monika
reviews.title: Stayed with kids
reviews.comment:
Wunderschönes Haus, ruhige Lage, gut ausgestattet. Restaurants und Einkaufsladen sind sehr nahe. Gute Ausgangslage zum Wandern und auch für den Strand. Traumhafte Aussicht.
Ein- und Auschecken sehr unkompliziert, gute Kommunikation.

reviews.author: Bogdan
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Absolutely amazing villa, straight out of MTV Cribs, that was so beautiful that we barely wanted to leave and explore the island. 
We were a group of 5 adults and 3 children (aged between 10 months and 6 years) and had an unforgettable 5 days at the villa. 
The photos on Airbnb don’t do the place justice as it is much more beautiful in real life. 
The host was more than helpful all stay long, super quick to respond to all our questions, needs and few requests. 
This villa deserves more than the 5 stars allowed, we will recommend it to all our friends and we will return for sure!
reviews.response:
Dear Bogdan.
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We are thrilled to hear that you and your group had an unforgettable stay at our villa and that it felt like something straight out of MTV Cribs! 
It’s fantastic to know that the whole group, including the little ones, enjoyed their time here. We always aim to make our guests feel at home, and we’re so glad to hear our hospitality met your expectations. Your kind words about the beauty of the villa and the helpfulness of the team mean a lot to us.
We truly appreciate your recommendation and can’t wait to welcome you back for another amazing stay in the future!
Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Mohamed
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Im in love with this villa! Everything was fine and we really enjoyed our stay!

reviews.author: Zbigniew
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Great place. The pool is heated what is worth mentioned.

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.title: Dom z grzybem i kłopotami
reviews.positive: Jedynie widok z domu był zaletą tego obiektu.
reviews.negative:
Dom jest położony w naprawdę trudno dostępnym miejscu. Podjechaliśmy na miejsce gdzie można było zaparkować samochód, a i tak trzeba było się przedzierać przez gęstą zabudowę domów, ale okej, taki urok Madery. Dom jest umieszczony na dosyć stromym zboczu, zatem trzeba się nachodzić góra - dół. Dobrze, że było nam dane zejść tam tylko raz.
Jak już przedarliśmy się przez wąskie uliczki i dostaliśmy się do domu, to okazało się, że apartament nie jest przygotowany na nasz przyjazd. Łóżka niezaścielone, kosze w łazienkach pełne śmieci, w kuchni bałagan, pozostawione butelki oraz śmieci. Ktoś zupełnie zapomniał przygotować dom dla następnych gości. Zdarza się. Jednak najgorsze jest to, że w dwóch sypialniach na ścianach jest grzyb i to już jest sytuacja nie do zaakceptowania! Podróżowałam z córką, która ma alergię, sama zresztą również reaguję katarem na przebywanie w zagrzybionych pomieszczeniach.
Reasumując, baaaardzo nie polecam tej lokalizacji.

Zarządzający lokalizacją umyli ręce i pozostawili nas samym sobie w piątkowy wieczór, tuż po przylocie na Maderę. Pomimo obietnicy, że manager się ze mną skontaktuje następnego dnia, nikt do mnie nie zadzwonił. Nie otrzymałam również potwierdzenia zwrotu pieniędzy.
W środę osobiście pojechałam do biura, żeby upomnieć się o potwierdzenie dokonania zwrotu. Niestety obsługa pracowników tego biura to totalna porażka. Młody chłopak, który ze mną rozmawiał, powiedział, że nie może wysłać mi potwierdzenia zwrotu, bo go nie ma. Manager nie odbierał telefonu. Chłopak z którym rozmawiałam, rozmawiając ze mną patrzył w monitor, chyba pracował, no, ale to już świadczy o jego kulturze osobistej i poziomie obsługi klienta w tym biurze. 
Zarządca nie poczuwa się do wypłaty rekompensaty za stracone wakacje, czas i pieniądze oraz stres i nerwy, które ta sytuacja wygenerowała.
Jedyny plus jest taki, że oddali okulary, które w tym nieszczęsnym, brudnym domu zostawiła starszą córka.

Bardzo nie polecam! Zagrzybiony dom

reviews.author: Cecelia
reviews.positive: How can I rate this place when we did not stay there. How my booking changed from Vila Formosa in Monumental road to that one still baffles me? Would take a very fit athlete to descend and ascend that road, to me was false advertising. We need access to places via roads. Also I told the lady to cancel it and also wanted my money back, something which has been refused. We had to put out extra money to book another place, an unnecessary expense which was something we had not expected and cost a lot of money. Your attention would be appreciated. And would like to be reimbursed. Thank you

reviews.author: Becerro2022
reviews.title: Frustrante
reviews.positive: A única cosa realmente agradável foi a vista
reviews.negative: Olá, sinceramente fiquei extremamente dececionado. Havia inúmeros pontos negativos: as toalhas estavam sujas, havia cabelos no lavatório, muitos cabelos no chuveiro, e a limpeza geral foi simplesmente vergonhosa. Os bancos, inclusive os de fora, estavam imundos; o toldo do pátio não funcionava e, para piorar, o pátio nem sequer tinha luz. O micro-ondas não ligava, não havia liquidificadora e, pelo preço cobrado, esperava algo infinitamente melhor. A única coisa realmente agradável foi a vista — mas nem mesmo isso conseguiu compensar uma estadia tão frustrante e desagradável.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Spacious villa but challenging location
reviews.positive: The villa is spacious and has lovely views. The hot tub was nice.
reviews.negative:
The location us very challenging to find. All taxi drivers struggled, including the one that dropped us from the airport. It is up very very steep hills and lots and lots and lots of steps! There is no supermarket or shop close by so a car or taxi (once you learn how to explain where it is!) is essential, but even then you can't drive to the door you still need to negotiate a very steep hill and steps even when you drive there.
Also the noise at night in the upstairs bedroom was very loud. There is some stangnant water behind the villa which comes alive at night with very loud creatures. And there are barking dogs all the time day and night in the area.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.positive: The villa's location is ideal—set slightly outside the city, offering peaceful surroundings while still being close to Funchal. The jacuzzi on the terrace is a dream, and the views are breathtaking. Each bedroom comes with its own private bathroom.
reviews.negative:
The parking spots are quite far from the house, requiring a strenuous uphill walk. Sometimes, you even have to park farther away. Unfortunately, the Wi-Fi in the house is very poor, barely reaching the balcony, which makes a comfortable workcation nearly impossible.

There was no more toilet paper or trash bags provided. In the kitchen, near the washing machine, there was a strong odor, likely coming from the drain. Some lamps were missing light bulbs, and overall, the decor lacked a bit of warmth and liveliness.

reviews.author: Clovis
reviews.title: Small paradise if you can walk the walk.
reviews.positive: The house is super comfortable, the view is beyond beautiful and the feeling inside the house is great for quiet leisure time. The green around the area (full of banana trees) gives it an exquisite touch. I fully refreshed my forces during the week I spent here: Madeira does that to you, and the house gives an extra help.
reviews.negative: As plenty of previous comments attest, the real downside of the house is: access is really hard. Even more than I expected after reading those previous comments. Be aware: this place is not for you if you have any difficulty to walk steep (really steep!) long distances. Guests with small children, or elderly people, or even overweight people, will have real difficulties, possibly critical ones. People without great confidence to drive within super-steep small roads should also be aware. Even for good drivers: I highly recommend to use this house only if you have got full insurance in your rental car, there are high chances someone will hit you (for example when parked) , if you do not hit someone or something as well.

reviews.author: Ewelina
reviews.positive: Piękny widok z tarasu, duża przestrzeń do wspólnego spędzania czasu, jacuzzi
reviews.negative: Trudne dojście do obiektu,.problemy z parkowaniem w okolicy

reviews.author: Aida
reviews.positive: La struttura è bellissima e ha una vista mozzafiato, è dotata di tutti i comfort
reviews.negative: La posizione. La struttura è situata in un punto non raggiungibile con la macchina, con una salita troppo ripida che ha reso il soggiorno a tratti troppo faticoso.
reviews.response:
Dear Aida,

Thank you for your lovely feedback! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the beauty of our property and the stunning views. Your comfort is our priority, and we’re glad you found everything well-equipped. We understand that the steep climb may pose some challenges, and we appreciate your feedback. Should you wish to return in the future, we will gladly assist you in selecting a property that better suits your needs.

Kind Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Melisa
reviews.positive: Sehr sauber und groß, unglaublich schöne Aussicht, tolle Ausstattung
reviews.negative: Die Lage ist etwas unvorteilhaft, da man einen wirklich anstrengenden Berg hochlaufen muss.

reviews.author: Rosa
reviews.title: magnifique vue, dommage que ce soit trop difficile d’accès
reviews.positive: oui la maison est très bien. très belle vue
reviews.negative: inaccessible en voiture, très difficile pour stationner dans les environs.

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.title: BELLE RESIDENCE A FUIR.
reviews.positive: Pas profité de l'emplacement puisque on était filmés.
reviews.negative: ATTENTION accès très difficile, maison située sur une pente à 25 degrés,  chemin très étroit. Montée  impossible avec les bagages. Personnes ayant des difficultés de marche ou respiratoires DANGER. Parking impossible après 18h, ou de plus en plus haut.Donc pas de soirées en ville. Vous êtes filmés . Caméras sur les espaces de vie privatifs en extérieur, table de repas, et douche extérieure. Refus de visionner les images. JACUZZI  devant la terrasse du voisin à 5 mètres, bonjour la détente. Odeurs d'égouts intenables dans la maison après la douche et toilette du matin. Frigo américain pas branché sur le service d'eau, pas de glaçons, pas d'eau fraîche. Pas top quand il fait chaud. Moustiques voraces, du à la présence d'une mare réserve d'eau au niveau du toit de maison. Colonies de petites fournies dans la cuisine, il faut fermer hermétiquement toute la nourriture et fruits. Quand il pleut il faut éponger l'eau dans la salle à manger et la chambre. Une chambre sans fenêtres. Résumé : A FUIR ....
reviews.response:
Dear guest.

Thank you for sharing your experience, and we appreciate your feedback. We're sorry to hear that your stay did not meet your expectations. We take your comments seriously and would like to address some of your concerns without excessive apologies or falsehoods.

Firstly, we understand that accessing our property may be challenging due to the steep slope and narrow path. However, it's worth mentioning that the local topography in Madeira often includes such features. 

Regarding parking, there is always free public parking available 5 minutes from the house.

As for the cameras on the outside of the property, they are clearly visible and not pointed at private areas like the outside shower. Their purpose is solely to enhance security for our guests, which is a standard practice in the hospitality industry. 

In response to the issue of water, we have a sink with drinkable water, and we regret any inconvenience you experienced in this regard. As for the mosquito situation, regrettably, it's a common occurrence in Madeira, and we provide measures to minimize their presence, but they can be challenging to control entirely.

We value your feedback and will use it to make any necessary improvements to ensure a more pleasant experience for future guests. We hope this clarifies some of your concerns and appreciate your time spent at our property.

Sincerely,
Lucas Abreu
Rental Manager

Coupure d'eau du au groupe interne à la villa mais le plus grave travaux de construction maison juste devant la villa avec grue très bruyant. Je ne conseille pas cette location surtout qu'ils n'ont pas accepté un geste commercial.

reviews.author: Piotr
reviews.title: Czuję się oszukany przez gospodarzy bo. ukrywają fakt, że obok jest budowa.
reviews.positive: Nie podobało mi się to, że obok prowadzona jest budowa z ciężkim sprzętem - bardzo hałaśliwa i uciążliwa. Gospodarz tą informację ukrywa publikując tylko w swoim opisie anie w opisie obiektu.
reviews.negative: Sam budynek jest świetny, wygodny i czysty.
reviews.response:
Dear Piotr.

Thank you for your feedback. We are pleased to know that you found the property great, comfortable, and clean.

We are sorry that the nearby construction affected your experience. However, we would like to clarify that we have never hidden this information. The fact that there are construction works in the surrounding area has always been clearly stated in the listing description, precisely so that guests can make an informed decision before booking.

We understand that noise can be inconvenient, but this is an external situation and outside our direct control. Nevertheless, we always aim to be as transparent as possible with our guests, as was the case here.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Mann
reviews.positive:
Traumhafte location. Atlantic Holiday hat uns kontaktiert und alle nötigen Angaben angegeben. Am Anreisetag hat dann alles wunderbar geklappt. Checkin unkompliziert und Schlüssel war am vereinbarten Ort.
Für die Touri Taxen muss man sich vorgängig schon via Portal von Atlantic Holiday einchecken inkl. Ausweiss Nummer.
Pool hammermässig, Küche super ausgestattet und die Räumlichkeiten waren sehr schön. Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt und haben es sehr genossen.
reviews.negative: Nichts

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.title: Die Unterkunft hatte viele Missstände und ich erwarte einen größeren Erstattungsbetrag.
reviews.positive: die Lage war gut
reviews.negative:
der Pool war nicht beheizbar und hatte nur 16 Grad, war also nicht zu nutzen; 

Die Klimaanlage hat nicht funktioniert und es war die ganze Woche über zu kalt in der Unterkunft. Der Gastgeber konnte kein Serviceteam bekommen und hat uns 2 kleine Radiatoren gebracht, die aber viel zu klein waren, um die ganze Villa warum zu bekommen.

Die Betten waren dreckig, die Bettwäsche hatte Flecken.

An 2 Tagen hatten wir kein fließendes Wasser.

In der Wohnung waren sehr viele Ameisen. Sowohl in der Küche, als auch in den Schlafzimmern.
reviews.response:
Dear Frank.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad to know that you found the location good.
Regarding the pool, we’d like to clarify that it is not heated, which is why it is not listed or advertised as a heated pool.
Unfortunately, the air conditioning was working correctly prior to your arrival. The issue occurred during the New Year holidays, which made it impossible to have a technician immediately available despite our best efforts. In the meantime, we did our utmost to provide a solution by supplying portable heaters. When used correctly, these are sufficient to heat the rooms they are placed in.
Concerning the bed linen, all linen and towels are professionally cleaned and changed between every stay. You contacted us a couple of days after check-in regarding this matter, after the linen had already been used. Nevertheless, we brought and provided fresh, clean replacement bed linen.
Regarding the water supply, there was a temporary interruption caused by a municipal issue, which lasted for a few hours and was outside of our control. We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.
As for the ants, this can occasionally occur, especially in warmer climates. Madeira is no exception, and despite regular pest control measures, it may happen from time to time.
We would also like to note that we responded and assisted whenever you reached out during your stay. Additionally, as a gesture of goodwill, we offered you a 10% discount.
We appreciate your comments and thank you for sharing your experience.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Tereza
reviews.positive: Lokalita skvělá, z vily krásný výhled na oceán, možnost použít gril, venkovní posezení. K dispozici sušička a pračka. Vše prostorné, velká lednice, vybavená kuchyně.
reviews.negative: Skřípající postel v 1 pokoji. Ve druhém pokoji ne příliš pohodlná matrace pro 2 osoby. 5.osoba  spí na rozkládacím gauči v obýváku. Pouze 1 sprcha. Ve sprchovém koutě chybí poličky, věšák.

reviews.author: Manuel
reviews.title: Empfehlenswert. Wir kommen wieder
reviews.positive: Schöne ruhige Lage oberhalb von Porto Moniz. Genug Platz für eine ganze Familie. Der Blick von der Terrasse ist traumhaft. Die Ausstattung im Haus war mehr als ausreichend.

reviews.author: Urszula
reviews.title: Było komfortowo jak w domu.
reviews.positive: Widok, pełne wyposażenie domu, czystość, kominek.
reviews.negative: Wszystko mi się podobało.

reviews.author: Kirsten
reviews.title: Großartiges Haus für warme Temperaturen
reviews.positive: Das Haus ist wirklich wunderschön! Es hat an sich eine 10 verdient. Es ist sehr stimmig, hochwertig und geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Ein Traum. Tolle Wandfarben, durchdachte Beleuchtung, alles super. Die Terrasse und der Ausblick sind sensationell, auch wenn wir sie wegen des kalten Windes in der ganzen Woche nicht einmal nutzen konnte. Man sollte im Blick haben, dass das Wetter hier rauer ist als auf der Südseite der Insel.
reviews.negative:
Leider war unser Aufenthalt trotzdem nicht so gelungen. Das Haus war sehr ausgekühlt als wir ankamen. Obwohl wir alle Heizkörper aufdrehten, wurde es auch nach Tagen nicht gemütlich, was sicher auch an dem stürmischen Wind lag, der heftig durch die Spalten der (schönen)  Haustür zog. Da müsste dringend ein schwerer Vorhang davor. Es gibt einen schönen Kamin, leider war das Feuerholz frisch und feucht. Es gab kein Papier, kein Anfeuerholz, keine Kaminanzünder und vor allem: Keine Axt. Es war unmöglich, ein Feuer zu machen, bevor wir uns selbst nicht ausgestattet hatten. 
Das andere Problem: Die Matratzen. Guter Schlaf ist für uns essenziell, um uns zu erholen. Diese waren für unseren Geschmack viel zu hart. Da es keinen Topper gab, spürte man  sogar deutlich die gesteppte Struktur des Matratzenbezuges. Mit einem guten Topper wäre dieses Problem leicht zu beheben.
reviews.response:
Dear Kirsten.

Thank you for your detailed feedback. We are very pleased to know that you appreciated the design, decoration, and overall atmosphere of the house, as well as the terrace and views.
We regret that some aspects of your stay did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to note that none of these matters were communicated to us during your stay. Had we been informed, we would have been more than happy to assist and find suitable solutions to improve your comfort.
We will carefully review the points mentioned, including the heating, fireplace setup, and other aspects highlighted.
Regarding the mattress, comfort can vary depending on personal preference, and what may feel firm for some guests can be ideal for others, however, we appreciate your feedback and will certainly have it in consideration.

Thank you once again for your feedback, which helps us to continue improving.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Soratessa
reviews.positive: Die Lage des Hauses oberhalb von Porto Moniz ist einzigartig, auch wenn im Winter (im Februar) der Sturm ordentlich heult. Die Einrichtung ist gemütlich und zweckmäßig.
reviews.negative: Keine Kritik, aber zu beachten ist, dass man ein Auto benötigt, das die Steigungen und Serpentinen gut bewältigt.
reviews.response:
Dear Soratessa.

Thank you very much for your kind feedback. We’re delighted to know that you found the place unique and enjoyed the cozy and functional decoration, even during the winter season.

We also appreciate you mentioning the access roads, Madeira’s landscape is indeed beautiful but can include steep and winding routes, so having a suitable car certainly helps guests enjoy their stay more comfortably.

Thank you again for sharing your experience. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

Per il resto nulla da dire.

reviews.negative: Everything was good

reviews.negative: Es hat nach unseren Geschmack eine Spülmaschiene gefehlt. Es gab keine abschließbaren Badezimmer. 1 Badezimmer mit Dusche. Da das Haus auf dem Berg steht ist es etwas mühsam es zu erreichen, aber total machbar. (Für Madeira normal, wenn man nicht in Mitten des Geschehens sein möchte).

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Große Haus für Dich alleine!
reviews.positive: Wunderschönes modernes Haus mit großer Terasse (EG) und Loggia (1. OG), beide mit Meerblick auf etwa 350 Metern Seehöhe. Das Haus wird von einer professionellen Hausverwaltung gemanagt, die gut via booking.com, WhatApp und Telefon erreichbar ist. Der Schlüssel befindet sich in einer Safebox am Eingang, der Code wird Euch 2 Tage vorher mitgeteilt. Im Untergeschoß der Außenanlage befindet sich die überdachte großzügige Grillstation für offenes Feuer. Garage vorhanden. Für den Winter wichtig: Zentralheizung für alle Räume über Konvektoren einer Wärmepumpe - es ist daher kuschelig warm. 2 Schlafzimmer, eines mit größerem, eines mit kleinerem Doppelbett. 1 Toilette im EG, ein(e) Bad/Toilettte mit geräumiger Dusche im OG. Wohnzimmer mit Schwedenofen im offenen Kamin - Holz vorhanden. Außergewöhnlich geräumige Küche mit allem, was man braucht + Waschmaschine. Trockner in der Garage. 5 (!) flammiger Gasherd und übergroßes elektrisches Backrohr. Die Liegenschaft ist auf Google Streetview zu finden, sie liegt in einer kleinen Siedlung oberhalb von Porto Moniz (5 Min. Fahrzeit über die Serpentinen). In Porto Moniz selbst gibt´s einen kleinen Supermarkt. Die Nordwestseite der Insel, wo sich das Haus befindet, ist allerdings die kühlere und wettermäßig instabilere Seite der Insel, dort stauen sich auch die Passatwolken. Hier wäre man im Süden natürlich auf der sichereren Seite. Dafür gibt´s hier spektakuläreren Wellenschlag und Wind. Mietwagen ist hier allerdings geradezu Pflicht, wie fast überall auf Madeira, mit Bussen kommst du nämlich nicht weit, die Öffis sind eher für gut orientierte Habitanten da.
reviews.negative:
Die Achillesferse von abgelegeneren Regionen auf Madeira ist das (zum Teil schwache und instabile) Stromnetz. Als wir das Backrohr in Betrieb hatten und Etliches an Beleuchtung dazu ist die FI-Sicherung gefallen. Daher ein wenig mit der Last aufs Netz haushalten. Der Sicherungskasten befindet sich in der Garage über dem Wäschetrockner.
Und die Heizungssteuerung (in der Küche an der Wand) ist während unseres Aufenthalts 4 (!) mal ausgefallen, beim ersten Mal brauchten wir Support der Verwaltung, hat aber anstandslos geklappt, man hebt bei der Nummer verlässlich ab.

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.title: Très mauvais traitement de l’agence de gestion
reviews.negative:
Lamentable / 
Nous avons réservé pour 3 personnes, mon fils a dormi sur un canapé lit sans drap et n’avait pas de serviette non plus. Lorsque nous l’avons signalé - à plusieurs reprises avant d’obtenir une 1ere réponse : « tout est rangé sous le canapé, au cas où » (?)… mais il n’y avait rien. Malgré les relances, aucune solution n’a été proposée, seulement des réponses dédaigneuses : « c’est rangé sous le canapé comme on vous l’a dit! ». 
Par ailleurs n’oubliez pas de prévoir gel douche et shampoing car ils ne sont pas fourni non plus, comme ils m’ont répondu « sinon ce serait indiqué dans la liste des fournitures » or, il me semble que c’est un service de base, que nous retrouvons partout. Enfin les photos sont largement améliorée et au vu de la qualité des travaux, cet appartement risque de bien mal vieillir très rapidement (+poêles rayées, hotte non fonctionnelle…).
reviews.response:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We are sorry that your experience did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to clarify a few points.

All the linen, pillows and towels for the sofa bed were available inside the sofa bed itself, as we told you earlier. We intentionally do not prepare it in advance because the living room is a shared area where guests can relax and watch television during the day. In this way, the space can be enjoyed both as a living room and as a bedroom whenever needed.

As soon as you contacted us, we immediately informed you where the linen was located. After confirming that everything was there, we tried to contact you several times to make sure that everything had been resolved, but we did not receive any further messages from you.

Regarding the amenities, we always provide hand soap and shampoo, and we apologise that shower gel was not available.

We are also sorry to hear that the property did not fully match your expectations. The photographs accurately reflect the accommodation, and no alterations have been made to them. We simply made every effort to present the property in the best possible way. As with any accommodation, some signs of normal wear and tear may appear over time, and we continuously work to maintain the property to a high standard.

Warm regards,
Your Key Madeira

We hardly heard the works from the building site next door when the windows were closed and it was not even intrusive when we were on the terrace. The workers did not start early or work on the weekend and it was quite fascinating to watch the progress from the side windows.
Atlantic Holiday's send detailed information and video on how to enter the apartment and all the amenities. They were very responsive and helpful to questions. Also they kindly let us check out a little later as there was no incoming guests that day. Would definitely return to this apartment!

reviews.response:
Dear Michael.
Thank you very much for taking the time to share your feedback. We truly value hearing from our guests, as it helps us ensure we’re providing the best possible experience.
As mentioned in the property listing, there is ongoing construction in the surrounding area, and this is also visible in the photos provided before booking. We understand that this can sometimes be inconvenient, but we make every effort to be transparent so guests can make an informed choice before their stay.
You contacted us regarding the window, some additional information, and a request for more wine glasses than the ones already provided. Our team visited the property at the time you requested, within just a few hours, and promptly resolved the window issue. We also brought additional wine glasses, although the ones already supplied were more than adequate and standard for the property.
We always strive to respond quickly and provide attentive service to all our guests. While it’s unfortunate that our efforts weren’t fully appreciated, we do value your comments and will continue working hard to maintain a high standard.
Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

You can find plenty of good restaurants in walking distance as well as the Madeira Forum (shopping center) directly opposite of the building.
The noise from the construction site nearby was not too bad, but Atlantic Holiday had mentioned that in the listing. A little annoying was the traffic noise during the night from the street in front of the building, especially by the crazy motor cyclists.
But we will definitely consider staying there again.
