reviews.title: Szép kilátás messzebb a várostól jacuzzi nélkül
reviews.positive:
A Sublime View Villa egy zsákutcában található fenn a hegyoldalban, messzebb a városközponttól. A bejutás széfkulccsal megoldott, házigazdával nem találkoztunk.
A panoráma a városra a teraszról fantasztikus. 
A Villa 4 szobával (mindegyikhez saját fürdő) hatalmas nappalival, konyhával, mosókonyhával és saját garázzsal rendelkezik. 
Az utcafrontól a garázsba és a felső szintre érkezünk. Ottjártunkkor nem működött a garázskapu, így az utcán parkoltunk, ahol mindig volt hely.
 A legfelső szinten a garázson kívül két hálószoba van. Az egyik, a fő szoba full panorámával rendelkezik Funchalra és az óceánra + hatalmas fürdőszobája van. Itt az ágymatrac süppedős, puha.
 Ezen a szinten a másik szoba a bal oldali szomszédházra néz, két külön ággyal.

A középső szinten van a kiválóan felszerelt konyha, ahol minden van, amire szükség lehet egy háztartásban. Ezen a szinten van a harmadik hálószoba, ami franciaágyas, keménymatracos és a bal oldali szomszéd házra néz. A nappali hatalmas, innen lehet kilépni a full panorámás teraszra, ahol le lehet ülni reggelizni, vacsorázni, beszélgetni. Itt van a jacuzzi is.
Az alsó szint a szuterén vagy pince szint. Itt van egy hálószoba, ami sötét, félős, csak alvásra jó. Itt található a mosókonyha és edzőeszközök. Az egész házban megoldott a wifi.

Összességében kiváló Villa, ha valaki csendre és szuper kilátásra vágyik a fő hálószobából és a teraszról és nem fontos neki a jacuzzi.
Én  8-as értékelést adtam a negatívumok ( jacuzzi, szomszéd stb) miatt.
reviews.negative:
Ami nem tetszett:
Garázst, autóbeállót nem tudtuk hasznàlni a rossz garázskapu miatt.

Jacuzzi vizét nem cserélik a vendégek között. 7 éjszakát voltunk a Villában, de a jacuzzit nem tudtuk használni, a vize undorító koszos és habos volt. Külön jelzésre cserélték az utolsó nap a vizet, de lassan fűtött fel, mi már nem tudtuk élvezni.

Este 23:00 óra után a teraszon nem lehet beszélgetni, mivel a bal oldali szomszéd átkiabál, hogy nem tud aludni.

Tv a nappalin kívül nincs egyik szobában sem. 

Kértük, h 10:00 óra helyett 11:00-kor távozhassunk, de nem engedélyezték.

A várostól való tàvolság miatt mindenhez autóval kell menni, egy étterem van gyalogosan 15 percen belül.

 A napi bevásárláshoz, reggeli friss kenyérhez is autó kell... az üzelteknèl pedig kevés a parkolóhely...

Összességében kiváló Villa, ha valaki csendre és szuper kilátásra vágyik a fő hálószobából és a teraszról.
Én  8-as értékelést adtam a negatívumok ( jacuzzi, szomszéd stb) miatt.

reviews.author: Cathy
reviews.title: Amazing views and lovely backyard. Large spacious house
reviews.positive: Gorgeous view and large open spaces

reviews.author: Philip
reviews.title: Highly recommended - smooth communication with the host and superb villa with exceptional views!
reviews.positive: Size, location and cleanliness of villa - exactly as described on the ad. Rooms were decent size and clean - true home from home experience. Kitchen is fully equipped for home cooking if that's your desire too!
reviews.negative: The one and only minor thing was that there was a dirty oven tray with lots of grease left on it when we arrived. We did not know this so when the oven was turned on the whole kitchen smelled of old grease.

reviews.author: Katerina
reviews.title: Чудове місце для сімʼї або великої компанії
reviews.positive: Чудове місце для відпочинку компанією. Нас було 8 дівчат. Всі комфортно розмістилися. Неперевершений вид на океан та Фуншал. Вілла укомплектована всім необхідним - посудомийка, кавова машина, правильна машина, система кондиціювання  та багато чого іншого. З переваг також - джакузі на терасі. Сподіваюсь ще повернемося.
reviews.negative: Не вистачає сушильної машини, бо через велику вологість дуже погано сохнуть речі

reviews.author: Yvonne
reviews.title: Heerlijke week Madeira met vriendinnen, genieten, wandelen en zwemmen.
reviews.positive: De villa was fantastisch. Groot genoeg voor 6 volwassen en 2 kinderen. Heerlijke veranda met uitzicht op zee waar je direct je ontbijt kunt nuttigen. De jacuzzi is eveneens heerlijk om 's avonds te genieten met uitzicht over de stad Funchal. Straat is superrustig. Parkeren is totaal geen probleem.
reviews.negative: De slaapkamer beneden heeft weinig tot geen daglicht. Die hebben wij dan ook niet gebruikt.  Er is mega veel opbergruimte, wat je eigenlijk ook niet echt nodig hebt,

reviews.author: Pascal
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Fidèle à la description. Calme. Vue sur la baie.

reviews.author: Miguel
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Casa muy agradable , cuenta con todo lo necesario y con unas vistas espectaculares. La zona es residencial y muy cerca en coche del centro de Funchal y del acceso a la carretera para conectar con otros lugares de la isla 
Los propietarios muy atentos a todo detalle
Casa totalmente recomendable ! 
Es una casa para 8 personas, teniendo en cuenta las camas disponibles

reviews.author: Cassie
reviews.title: Group trip
reviews.comment: The location is incredible! It’s in a very private, quiet residential area that overlooks the water. The home is gated and felt very safe overall. However, we did have some concerns - one sliding door on the main level did not lock. The garage door is inoperable. The biggest problem was the air conditioner did not work; it made sound when you turned it on, but no cold air ever came out. We were there in July and it was hot! The two top bedrooms were unusable because the rooms were too hot. We contacted the host and they claimed they sent someone to fix the problem but the rooms remained hot the entire time.
reviews.response:
Dear Cassie.
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed the peaceful setting, the views, and the sense of privacy the property offers.
We are sorry that some aspects of your stay did not fully meet your expectations, particularly regarding the air conditioning. After you contacted us, a member of our team visited the property to check the system, and at that time it appeared to be operating correctly. As we did not receive any further report during the remainder of your stay, we understood that the matter had been resolved. Nevertheless, we regret that the temperature remained uncomfortable for you, and we are currently working on the air-conditioning system to ensure it is functioning properly for future guests.
We also appreciate your comments regarding the other maintenance points, as this type of feedback helps us identify areas that require attention. Thank you again for staying with us, and we hope that, despite these inconveniences, you were able to enjoy your time in Madeira.
Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: The house itself was spacious and we enjoyed the jacuzzi and location of the house. But we ran into several problems. We requested that the maintenance team service the air conditioning, but it was never fixed—the bedrooms were without AC throughout our stay. Additionally, the garage door was non-functional and we had to park our two cars in the outdoor street parking. Which was fine safety wise, but the cars became really hot in the day time.  Most concerning was a phishing message we received before checkout asking us to pay via an external link, despite having already settled our full payment through Airbnb. We verified the request before complying and were later notified it was fraudulent. This is a serious security vulnerability—other guests could easily fall victim and lose substantial money.
reviews.response:
Dear Jessica.
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the spaciousness of the property, the jacuzzi, and its location.
We are sorry for the inconveniences experienced during your stay. Our team attended the property to assist with both the air-conditioning system and the garage access. We are currently working on the air-conditioning system to ensure it is functioning properly and the garage gate was resolved at that time.
Regarding the fraudulent message, we completely understand your concern. This was an isolated phishing attempt carried out by an external party and was not a payment request sent by Atlantic Holiday as payments are handled by Airbnb. We are glad that you verified the message before taking any action.
We appreciate your comments and are continuously working to ensure that our guests have a comfortable and secure stay.
Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.title: Best ever holiday apartment in lovely area
reviews.positive: Best holiday apartment we ever stayed in! It was spacious, elegant with quality fixtures and fittings, everything worked properly, kitchen was amazing, lovely spacious balcony with sea view- perfect for a leisurely breakfast. Pool really nice and clean. Lovely peaceful area up out of Funchal with buses into toen from both ends of the street. Local mini- market stocking basics.
reviews.negative: Would have liked the aircon to extend to the bedrooms. Thats the only drawback.

reviews.author: Didier
reviews.title: Très belle semaines dans ce super appartement
reviews.positive: L'emplacement dans une partie moins touristique de Funchal, les contacts fluides avec les propriétaires, la vue, la taille de l'appartement, l'équipement de la cuisine, la place de parking dans un garage.
reviews.negative: Les transats à la piscine étaient tous abimés.

reviews.author: Klaus
reviews.title: Tolle Unterkunft für längeren Madeiraurlaub
reviews.positive: Tollesgroßes Appartment mit Aussicht über Funchel und den Hafen. Die Einrichtung ist sehr ansprechend, neuwertig im modernen Stil. Die Ausstattung ist so komplett wie ich es noch selten bei einer FeWo gesehen habe. Sehr angenehm ist auch der Tiefgaragen Stellplatz mit Fahrstuhl nach oben. Man kann von diesem Appartment nach Funchal in die Altstatdt problemlos runter laufen (knapp über 1km). Der Weg zurück ist allerdings anstrengend. Die Steigung ist enorm. Wir sind meistens mit BOLT zurück gefahren. :-)

reviews.author: Stefan
reviews.title: Wir das Apartment jederzeit wieder buchen.
reviews.positive: Als erstes der spektakuläre Blick über Funchal und das Meer. Das Appartment ist sehr bequem und geräumig und mit allem ausgestattet was man sich wünscht. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

reviews.author: Casper
reviews.positive: Fantastic facilities for a small family and awesome view and location
reviews.response:
Dear Casper.

Thank you very much for your kind review. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment’s facilities and that the location and views added to your experience.

We truly appreciate your feedback and would be happy to welcome you and your family again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: László
reviews.title: Spacious, well-equipped apartment with a great balcony, garage, and central location
reviews.positive: Very spacious apartment, fully equipped with everything you might need. The large, comfortable balcony offers a great view, there's a convenient garage, and the city center is within walking distance.
reviews.negative: Getting the keys was difficult because the lockbox was stuck, and I eventually had to use some force as the host wasn’t responding to my calls; additionally, the AC is located in the living room, quite far from the bedroom, so its cooling effect there is far from ideal.
reviews.response:
Dear László.

Thank you very much for your kind words and for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We are delighted to know that you found the apartment spacious and well-equipped with all the amenities you needed. It’s also wonderful to know that you enjoyed the beautiful view, convenient garage space, and the great location.

We’re sorry to learn about the issue with the key box. We usually respond promptly, so we’re not sure why your calls were missed on this occasion, we have also checked and we did not find any record of calls from you at that time. However, we’re glad that you were still able to access the apartment using the check-in instructions provided.

Regarding the air conditioning, the unit in the living room is designed to help guests maintain a comfortable temperature throughout the apartment, especially given the size of the apartment.

Thank you once again for your thoughtful feedback. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be delighted to welcome you back anytime.

Warm regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Vivien
reviews.title: Great apartment and view in a residential area but with lots of uphill walking
reviews.negative:
Keys had to be collected from a separate location.
The taxi had to take us to the key collection location first then on to the apartment. This wasn’t far but not walkable for us with our luggage. It was also difficult to explain to the taxi driver. Although he was very helpful the taxi fee was more due to the additional time.
In a residential area and restaurants not close. Great facilities for eating in though.
reviews.response:
Dear Vivien.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re glad to know that you enjoyed the apartment and the excellent on-site dining facilities.

Regarding the key collection, we understand that having to pick up the keys from a separate location was less convenient. While we are unable to place a keybox inside the apartment building, we have now moved the key collection to a location even closer to the property to make access easier for our guests. In addition, all check-in information is sent to guests in advance to help ensure a smooth arrival.

We truly value your comments and would be happy to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Monique
reviews.title: Aanrader: heerlijk verblijf!
reviews.positive:
Appartement had een fantastisch uitzicht over Funchal. Er was een parkeergarage voor onze huurauto en het appartement was van alle gemakken voorzien (wasmachine/droger, vaatwasser, oven/magnetron. 
Vanaf appartement loop je in 20 minuten naar centrum Funchal.
reviews.negative: Eigenlijk niets, maar Funchal kent steile wegen en om bij het appartement te komen moesten we een steile weg omhoog lopen (zweet op het hoofd bij aankomst in appartement). Maar... dat hadden we er voor over.
reviews.response:
Dear Monique.

Thank you very much for your kind review. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the fantastic views over Funchal, the apartment’s full range of equipment, and the convenience of the garage.

We appreciate your understanding regarding the steep roads leading to the property, while the climb can be a bit of a workout, the apartment is still very close to the city center, making it easy to explore on foot. We’re glad to know it was worth it for the experience.

We truly value your feedback and would be happy to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Danny
reviews.title: Fantastisch
reviews.positive: Uitzicht, grootte van het appartment, uitrusting, locatie
reviews.negative: Het ophalen van de sleutels in een sleutelkluis bij het kantoor van atlantic holidays. Een sleutelkluis bij het appartement zelf is prettiger
reviews.response:
Dear Danny.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment’s views, size, equipment, and convenient location.

Regarding the key collection, we understand that having a keybox in the building would be more convenient. While we are unable to place one inside the apartment building, we have now moved the key collection to a location even closer to the property to make access easier for our guests.

We truly appreciate your comments and would be happy to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday,

reviews.author: Johan
reviews.title: Séjour à Madère
reviews.positive:
L'appartement est très grand et très confortable. 
Il y a tous les équipements nécessaires pour passer un bon séjour. 
La piscine est très bien et agréable à la fin de la journée.
reviews.negative:
Quartier bruyant. 
Il y a un chantier juste en face, il est donc impossible d'utiliser la terrasse dans la journée. 
Beaucoup de chiens juste à côté n'arrêtent pas d'aboyer. 
Même fenêtres fermées nous étions dérangés.
reviews.response:
Dear Johan.

Thank you for your review. We’re glad to know that you found the apartment spacious, comfortable, and well equipped for your stay, and that you enjoyed the pool as a relaxing space at the end of the day.

Regarding the construction, the main part of the works has already passed, though some activity may still be visible. We apologize for any disturbance caused by nearby dogs. This is the first time we’ve received comments about this, and unfortunately, there is nothing we can do to control them. Some level of noise is to be expected in apartment buildings, but we understand it can still be inconvenient and appreciate your patience.

We value your feedback and would be happy to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Marie-france
reviews.title: Je conseillerais ce logement à des amis.
reviews.positive: Appartement très bien rangé, très bien équipé et avec goût. Très belle terrasse très bien aménagée et avec une vue sublime.
reviews.response:
Dear Marie,

Thank you for your lovely feedback. We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the apartment, especially the tasteful decor and the well-equipped amenities. It's wonderful to know that you appreciated the terrace and its sublime view, as we take great pride in creating a space where our guests can relax and enjoy their stay.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the future for another memorable stay.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.title: Super séjour à Madeira dans un super appartement très ein situé, confortable
reviews.positive: Espace,équipement, confort
reviews.negative: Le bruit de la rue la nuit
reviews.response:
Dear Eric.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts on your recent stay. We are delighted to hear that you found the apartment comfortable and well-equipped, and that its location suited your needs.

Our apartment is situated in a generally calm area, away from major roads, which usually ensures a peaceful environment. We are sorry to hear that you experienced noise disturbances and will explore ways to address this issue. Your comfort is very important to us, and we hope to have the pleasure of hosting you again and providing an even better experience.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Ileana
reviews.positive: Location was great, quiet and clean, with the view of the ocean (not as close as photos). But you can feel the real Funchal life there. Great terrace for a quiet morning breakfast and a bear in the evening.
reviews.negative: The fact that we have to stop for keys and it was late (there is enough space at the property to have a key storage). Would very much appreciate some info on tap water because coming from the airport we didn't have any place to buy, some info on good locations to eat and general info on Funchal. And at least 1-2 capsules of coffee for first morning.
reviews.response:
Dear Ileana.

We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. It’s fantastic to know that you enjoyed the quiet location, clean surroundings, and the view of the ocean. We’re glad the terrace served as a lovely spot for both breakfast and evening relaxation.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the key collection process. To help facilitate smoother late check-ins, the keys are located in a keybox at our office, which is just 5 minutes away from the property. This setup allows guests to access their accommodations at any time without needing to coordinate with anyone. 

For future stays, please don’t hesitate to ask us for recommendations on local dining and general information. We would be more than happy to provide helpful suggestions.

Thank you for your valuable feedback, and we look forward to hosting you again soon.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.positive: Super große Terrasse mit tollem Ausblick.
reviews.negative: Das zweite Bett ist für 2 große Personen etwas klein.
reviews.response:
Dear Sebastian.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. We are delighted that you found the terrace and its views to be a highlight of your stay.

Regarding the second bed, we regret that it was not as comfortable as anticipated for taller individuals. We are taking your feedback seriously and will review our options to better accommodate our guests' needs in the future.

We would be pleased to have the opportunity to host you again and ensure a more comfortable experience.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Souhilab
reviews.positive:
Superbe appartement a Funchal! Nous avons apprécié l emplacement a qq minutes a pied ou en voiture du centre, la vue exceptionelle de la terrasse, le calme du lieu et la qualité de ce logement. On était dans un cocon comme a la maison :)) 
La gentillesse et le professionnalisme de l agence Atlantic Holiday est sans failles.
reviews.negative: Tout était parfait!!
reviews.response:
Dear Souhila,

Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the apartment, the exceptional terrace view, and the calm location. It’s fantastic to know that you felt like you were in a cozy home during your stay.

We are also delighted by your kind words about our team. Providing excellent service and ensuring our guests have a memorable experience is our top priority. We look forward to welcoming you back to Atlantic Holiday for another enjoyable stay.

Best regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: John
reviews.positive: Beautiful modern apartment that was spotlessly clean. Amazing view from the balcony. Even better than the pictures. Hosts were very nice to deal with. Would definitely stay here again
reviews.negative: Nothing
reviews.response:
Dear John,

Thank you so much for your positive review! We’re thrilled that you enjoyed the modern apartment, the stunning view from the balcony, and the cleanliness of the space. It’s wonderful to hear that your experience was even better than you anticipated.

We appreciate your kind comments about our team. Your feedback means a lot to us and is a great encouragement. We are excited to welcome you back for another stay and are here to assist with anything you may need. Please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: Logement de qualité avec une piscine et une vue incroyable

reviews.author: Mathieu
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour, tout était parfait: la cuisine est très bien équipée, la literie très confortable, la terrasse et la piscine vraiment agréable. Le tout dans un environnement très calme.
Nous sommes ravis et reviendront sans hésiter si l'occasion se présente.
Merci pour votre accueil!

reviews.author: Anna-lena
reviews.title: Wir hatten einen guten Aufenthalt.
reviews.positive:
Der Ausblick ist wunderschön, das Haus war einfach, Bad und Küche aber hochwertig und der Garten ist sehr schön.
Wir konnten es aufgrund des Wetters leider nicht so sehr genießen wie wir wollten. 
Die Heizung funktionierte einwandfrei. 
Genügend Decken vorhanden.
Sehr gute Kommunikation mit dem Host.
reviews.negative:
Die Küchenausstattung innerhalb der Schränke könnte ein bisschen einheitlicher und vollständiger sein. 
Im unteren Bad roch es etwas modrig. 
Der Wäscheständer sollte ausgetauscht werden.

reviews.author: Sofiia
reviews.positive:
Очень красиво, великолепные виды, сам дом довольно комфортный, все есть для жизни. Хорошие инструкции по поиску дома, без них сложно найти. Нужно заранее загрузить их, потому что мобильная связь в горах хуже. 
В доме очень тихо и расслабляюще, соседи так расположены, что их вообще не видно.
reviews.negative: Если оставить крошки или грязную посуду, придут муравьи на кухню, но это нормально для дома в деревне. Пищевой мусор тоже лучше на ночь выставлять во двор.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Nice, simple apartment - the scenery was the best bit.
reviews.positive: Location was amazing, completely private with a perfect view. Scenery and garden were definitely the main highlights alongside a well equipped, clean kitchen. Winery 10 minutes from the house!
reviews.negative: Could benefit from some more personal touches, tricky to find on google maps initially (need to go well beyond where it takes you to), priced for 4 people so for 2 people was expensive for the quality compared to other places we stayed in Madeira.

reviews.author: Ignacio
reviews.positive:
Casa con vistas maravillosas a todo el valle de Sao Vicente desde un punto elevado, con jardín mirador y terraza en el dormitorio.
En una zona tranquila, en plena naturaleza, donde cada mañana te despiertas con una orquesta sinfónica de pajaritos.
La situación es excelente para ir a cualquiera de los principales destinos de la isla en tan solo 30 y 60 minutos, y junto a la espectacular zona norte de la isla.

reviews.author: Ines
reviews.positive: Lovely stay in the north of Madeira! The house was cozy and well-equipped, with a beautiful little garden and a peaceful location with great views on the valley. Communication with the agency was super smooth. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Karina
reviews.title: Даже не знаю как описать наш восторг от этого места - оно превзошло все ожидания . Удобная локация , красивый интерьер ,
reviews.positive: Все!
reviews.negative: Все было идеально

reviews.author: Anca
reviews.title: Appartamento in buona posizione con vari aspetti da migliorare.
reviews.positive: La posizione e la vista del oceano anche se laterale!
reviews.negative:
Purtroppo la nostra esperienza in questo appartamento, dove abbiamo soggiornato per 6 giorni, è stata deludente, soprattutto considerando il rapporto qualità prezzo.
 L'appartamento presentava diversi problemi di pulizia: abbiamo trovato capelli in più punti e il tappetino della doccia e uno dei asciugamani era macchiato ( ci tengo a precisare non sporco pero con macchie).
Inoltre, la doccia necessiterebbe avere più pressione ma forse perché si trova al 7 piano.
Anche alcuni dettagli della struttura hanno influito negativamente sul soggiorno. La porta d'ingresso, non essendo ben fissata, sbatte continuamente quando c'è corrente nel corridoio, risultando piuttosto rumorosa e tutte le porte sono vecchie. All'interno dell'appartamento abbiamo persino trovato uno scarafaggio morto in entrata.
L'isolamento acustico è insufficiente: durante la notte si sentono chiaramente rumori provenienti dall'appartamento accanto, che hanno disturbato il nostro riposo ( orari del tipo 2 e 5 del mattino). Inoltre, gli odori di cucina provenienti dalle ristorante al piano terra dietro ( sapori d'india) erano dopo pranzo onnipresenti.
La vista sull'oceano è sicuramente uno dei punti di forza dell'appartamento, ma il balcone è poco sfruttabile nelle ore di sole perché è privo di un ombrellone o di qualsiasi altra soluzione che permetta di utilizzarlo comodamente.
 Anche l'atmosfera nel condominio non ci è sembrata particolarmente accogliente nei confronti dei turisti ma potrebbe essere colpa del fatto che certi turisti siano rumorosi (era scritto in entrata accanto al ascensore gli orari quando non si poteva fare rumore però il nostro vicino era uno locale e guardava le partite a tutto volume nel cuore della notte)
Nel complesso riteniamo che ci siano molti aspetti da migliorare come il cambio del armadietto in bagno vecchi e rotto senza una mensola e l'armadio della camera matrimoniale vecchio e non in linia con il resto!
reviews.response:
Dear Anca.

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the location and the sea view from the apartment.

We are sorry to know that some aspects of your stay did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to mention that none of the concerns regarding cleanliness or the condition of the apartment were reported to us during your stay. The property is prepared before every arrival by a professional cleaning team, following the high standards we require. Had we been informed of any issue, we would have arranged for our team to return to the property and address it promptly.

Regarding the noise from neighbouring apartments, the activity within the building and the restaurant located nearby, these are unfortunately external factors that are outside our direct control. As the apartment is located in a residential building in an active area, the normal day-to-day activity of neighbours and surrounding businesses can occasionally be noticeable.

We regret that we did not have the opportunity to assist with these concerns while you were still at the property, as our team is always available throughout the stay and would have been happy to help wherever possible.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Ash
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.positive: Loved how modern the property was. It’s well located with everything nearby. The views from the balcony was amazing just overall loved it. Staff were very helpful and so nice which made things so much easier.
reviews.negative: It was very noisy in the early mornings which made it hard to sleep but that was the only thing

reviews.author: Nuno
reviews.title: Surpresa agradável
reviews.positive: De uma forma geral,  de tudo, sobretudo a localização..
reviews.negative: O estacionamento do edifício. Muito difícil arranjar estacionamento,  lugares muito estreitos e por vezes com bloqueios dis fornecedores do supermercado. Em termos do apartamento em si, ter mais uma tomada na casa de banho e até na sala, seria bastante útil.

reviews.author: Larisa
reviews.title: Щиро рекомендую це помешкання для комфортного та приємного відпочинку!
reviews.positive:
Помешкання розташоване в максимально зручному місці — усе поруч і дуже комфортно для відпочинку.

У квартирі було чисто, затишно, а посуд — охайний і в достатній кількості. Окремо хочеться відзначити неймовірний вид з балкона на океан — це справжнє задоволення щодня 🌊

Приємним бонусом став комплімент від господарів: вино Мадейра, вода, напої, печиво, традиційний мадейрський пиріг та свіжі фрукти — дуже уважно і гостинно 🍷
reviews.negative: Негативних вражень не було

reviews.author: Atletiforever
reviews.title: Bonita isla, pero hay alojamientos mejores y mas baratos.
reviews.positive: La localizacion, y las vistas desde la casa.
reviews.negative: Las llaves que dejo el propietario no permitian abrir la puerta exterior, y tampoco había llave para acceder a la zona de parking. No entiendo que haya que pagar un extra adicional y tan caro por el calentamiento del agua de la piscina. Tengo dudas de que incluso se haya calentado el agua. Ademas, en general hay muchas cucarachas y en especial en el baño de la piscina, que es inusable por esta causa.

reviews.author: Donny
reviews.title: Geweldige centraal gelegen villa met heerlijk zwembad en een prachtig  uitzicht
reviews.positive: Geweldige locatie met supermooi uitzicht. Goede centraal gelegen uitvalbasis om  het eiland te verkennen. Goede faciliteiten met mooi zwembad, goede bedden en mooi meubilair. Goede keuken met alle mogelijke apparatuur. Buitenbarbecue is top. Er is voldoende bestek, borden, pannen, glazen, et cetera. aanwezig. Eigen oprit om auto te parkeren, is echt een luxe op Madeira. Er werd inderdaad gebouwd ten tijde van ons verblijf, maar dit was prima vermeld en we hebben er niet echt last van ondervonden. Verhuurder reageert goed en snel op vragen.
reviews.negative: In de douches in twee van de 4 badkamers loopt het water niet goed weg en dat zorgt voor een onaangename geur. Wij verbleven er 12 dagen en dan was een keer schoonmaak tussendoor van huis en zwembad , wellicht fijn geweest.

reviews.author: Mykola
reviews.positive: Casa grande e muito confortável, bem situada, a vista incrível.
reviews.negative: Em geral foi tudo bem, mas, se fosse nos meses mais frios, a piscina aquecida só com preço a parte que torna o preço mais caro. Como não tem casa de banho lá fora, melhor ter um tapete pequeno na entrada da casa do lado da piscina. Para crianças que podem cair da cama a noite, precisa algumas cadeiras, porque tem só na sala. Casa tem algumas coisas pequenas para arranjar, mas sem grande importância.

reviews.author: Antoine
reviews.title: On s’attend à mieux au vu du prix. Maison correct mais rien d’exceptionnel.
reviews.positive: La vue, la taille de la maison.
reviews.negative:
Certain équipement de la cuisine ne fonctionne pas.
La nuisance des travaux périphériques 
La piscine n’a pas été utilisable du à une non capacité de chauffage, qui plus est, en option avec surcoût.
Les odeurs dans les salles de bain

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.title: Vraiment un beau logement proche de la vielle ville !
reviews.positive: Très bonne localisation , près de tout( marina, vielle ville , accès autoroute). Très pratique d'avoir une épicerie dans laplaza de l'immeuble. Grande terrasse. Logement très bien équipé avec literie de bonne qualité. Stationnement très pratique!
reviews.negative: Environnement bruant car terrasse en bordure d'une rue achalandée.
reviews.response:
Dear Caroline,

Thank you very much for your kind review and for sharing your experience with us.

We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the apartment, its convenient location, spacious terrace, well-equipped amenities and parking facilities.

Regarding the noise, due to the apartment’s central location and proximity to the city, some urban traffic noise may occasionally be noticeable.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would be very happy to welcome you back in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.positive: Localización y decoración.
reviews.response:
Dear Ángel,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us your review.

We are very pleased that you appreciated the property’s location and decoration. Thank you as well for choosing to stay with us.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again on a future visit to Madeira.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Floor
reviews.positive: We hebben enorm genoten van ons verblijf in Eco Monte. De villa is modern, ruim en van alle gemakken voorzien, met een fantastisch verwarmd zwembad en een mooi uitzicht over Funchal en de oceaan. De rustige ligging maakt het de perfecte plek om te ontspannen, terwijl alle bezienswaardigheden toch goed bereikbaar zijn. Absoluut een aanrader!
reviews.negative: Het ligt aan een steile weg, maar ook dat is goed te doen.

reviews.author: Elswood
reviews.title: Superb accommodation
reviews.positive: A beautifully appointed villa high up and secluded. Spotlessly clean with a well provisioned kitchen. Infinity pool heated and easy to operate. Beds comfortable. Really everything you could wish for. The house manager Heliodoro was very helpful. Fully recommend.
reviews.negative: No bedside tables for reading.

reviews.author: Heike
reviews.title: Perfect place
reviews.positive: Incredible view, very nice apartment, very well furnished, nice pool with the same view
reviews.negative: To walk into town is a challenge: the distance is short, but you have to walk on a steep curvy road without side walk. So we always took the car.
reviews.response:
Dear Heike.

We are pleased that you had such a positive experience at the property and were able to enjoy both the apartment and the shared facilities during your stay.

As Madeira is a mountainous island, some routes can be quite steep and are not always the most convenient for walking. For this reason, having a car can make getting around much easier, and the apartment has a dedicated parking space for guests.

Thank you for choosing to stay with us. We hope to welcome you back to Madeira in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.positive:
La vue incroyable depuis la terrasse 
Voir les dauphins et souffles de baleines depuis l'appartement
L'appartement est super
reviews.negative: Le seul point négatif est la route pour aller au centre à pieds
reviews.response:
Dear Nicolas.

We are very pleased to know that you enjoyed your stay and had the chance to experience such a special setting. Being able to spot marine life directly from the property can certainly make a visit to Madeira even more memorable.

Regarding the walk into the centre, the island’s terrain naturally includes many slopes, so some routes can be more demanding on foot. A car can be a convenient alternative when needed, since there is a parking spot for the apartment.

Thank you for staying with us, and we hope to welcome you back in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Filip

reviews.response:

reviews.response:

reviews.author: Danielle
reviews.positive: Het uitzicht en de zwembaden
reviews.negative:
Het parkeren het is lastig om de bochten te maken, krappe doorgang. Je moet niet een te grote brede auto hebben.

Achterkant is de plek heel mooi met uitzicht op zee.maar andere kant vonden wij erg druk en niet zo gezellig.

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.title: Amazing spacious clean appartment
reviews.positive: It's an evening amazing appartement with views of the ocean and ocean sounds. Everything available, gym, pools, washing machine etc. Loved it.
reviews.negative:
Nothing.. Only thing is you have te be aware that the parking garage is really narrow and if it was for me I could not have used it. Luckily my husband did the driving but found it also challenging.. Furthermore if you are not fit to walk,. this appartement is not a good choice. You have to walk some hills and even to come to the gym etc you have to walk some meters to get through the huge complex.

Tip for the owner, some new pans could be nice. Also a vacuum cleaner.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: The apartment had plenty of space, a view of the sea and access to a great pool. The host is extremely helpful throughout the stay. Thank you!

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: God rolig beliggenhed uden trafikstøj og stadig i gå afstand til Forum Madeira, bus og taxa. Parkeringsplads i garage. Dejlig udsigt over park og til havet fra 7 etage. Man kan sidde 4 personer og spise på altanen. Pool hade liggestole og parasoller.  Køkken kunne være lidt bedre udstyret med større pande og flere tallerkner, men fungerede ellers fint. Super rent og super vært.

reviews.author: Carine
reviews.title: Grandiose
reviews.positive:
L’établissement est neuf, très propre et sécurisé. La place de parking réservée à l‘appartement était un plus. Il y a un super supermarché juste en face. L‘appartement est grand, très bien aménagé et très confortable. Le balcon avec la vue sur la fontaine et la mer est grand et très agréable. Nous avons pris tout nos repas dessus. Il y a en plus un accès direct à la plage ! La piscine est grandiose. Le Check-in est très personnel, tout nous a été montré et même la poêle très usée, a été remplacée dès le lendemain. Un super service ! 
L‘emplacement pour visiter l’île est tout simplement parfait. Je ne peux que recommander cet appartement
reviews.negative: Rien

reviews.author: Pallares
reviews.positive: El apartamento ha sido increíble; limpio, moderno, con productos locales de cortesía, las instalaciones es todo un paraíso.
reviews.negative: Qué se había estropeado los motores de la depuradora de la piscina que se solucionó a los dos días.
reviews.response:
Dear Pallares.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to share your feedback. We are thrilled to hear that you found the apartment clean, modern, and wonderful, and that you enjoyed the local welcome products and the facilities.

We also appreciate you mentioning the issue with the pool filtration motors, and we are glad it was resolved promptly by the complex management team.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and the entire team would love to welcome you back to Madeira again soon!

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Kurt
reviews.title: zeer goed
reviews.positive:
mooi appartement met alle voorzieningen
grote supermarkt aan overkant
private toegang tot domein/bewaking
reviews.negative: zwembad was wel moeilijk toegankelijk, beperkt aantal stoelen voor teveel mensen
reviews.response:
Dear Kurt.

Thank you for choosing Atlantic Holiday and for taking the time to share your feedback. We are delighted to hear that you found the apartment beautiful and well-equipped, and that you appreciated the convenient location near the supermarket as well as the private, secure gated access.

We also appreciate your comment regarding the pool access and sun lounger availability. As the pool and complex facilities are managed by the building's administration, we will gladly pass along your observation to them for their awareness.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and the entire team would love to welcome you back to Madeira again soon!

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Alexandru
reviews.title: Ok appartment for 4 people
reviews.positive: The location. The rooms were ok. Good issolation.
reviews.negative:
We were missing toilet paper(only 6 rolles for one week) no coffee.. no clothes detergent, no dish washing tergent. Some dishes were not clean.
We had to take the key from the city.. nothing available for the location.
We had issues with the waste.. the door handle at the 3rd floor was missing.
reviews.response:
Dear Alexandru.

Thank you so much for choosing Atlantic Holiday and taking the time to share your thoughts with us. We are really glad to hear that you appreciated the great location, the comfortable bedrooms, and the good sound insulation of the apartment.

Regarding the items you mentioned, we provide 3 rolls of toilet paper per bathroom. As for items like coffee and detergents, while they are not a standard amenity provided by us, our cleaning team always leave them behind whenever previous guests leave them at the property for others to enjoy. As for key collection, it is conveniently located right on your way to the property, but please know we would have been more than happy to meet you in person if you had let us know it was causing an inconvenience. We also appreciate your feedback regarding the dishes, waste disposal, and the door handle, and we have shared these notes with our team to ensure everything is polished.
It was a true pleasure hosting you, and our entire team would love the opportunity to welcome you back to Madeira again soon!

Warm regards,
The Atlantic Holiday Team

reviews.author: Cláudia
reviews.positive: Tivemos o prazer de ficar hospedado durante cinco dias no apartamento Ocean Refuge e a experiência foi verdadeiramente muito positiva. O espaço é extremamente acolhedor, confortável, muito bem cuidado e equipado com tudo o que é necessário para uma estadia tranquila, proporcionando desde o primeiro momento uma agradável sensação de bem-estar e serenidade. A localização é excelente, permitindo fácil acesso a diversos serviços, comércio local, restaurantes e agradáveis percursos para caminhadas junto ao mar com uma bebé de 2 meses, o que tornou a estadia ainda mais prática, relaxante e enriquecedora. A varanda com vista fantástica para o oceano é, sem dúvida, um dos grandes destaques do apartamento, criando um ambiente perfeito para descansar e desfrutar da tranquilidade envolvente. Gostaríamos ainda de salientar a atenção, simpatia e cuidado dos anfitriões, que nos receberam com deliciosas iguarias regionais, como vinho da Madeira, bolo de mel, rebuçados de funcho, Brisa maracujá, água e fruta — um gesto muito gentil e acolhedor que tornou a chegada ainda mais especial. Sem dúvida, um alojamento a recomendar a quem procura conforto, tranquilidade, boa localização e um ambiente harmonioso junto ao mar. Será certamente um local a revisitar numa próxima oportunidade.
reviews.response:
Cara Claudia. 

Muito obrigado por partilhar a sua experiência tão detalhada e positiva!

Ficamos imensamente felizes por saber que a estadia no apartamento Ocean Refuge proporcionou momentos de conforto, serenidade e bem-estar desde o primeiro momento. É gratificante saber que o espaço, a varanda com vista para o oceano e a localização contribuíram para uma experiência prática e relaxante, especialmente com uma bebé de 2 meses.

Também nos alegra imenso que tenha apreciado a atenção, simpatia e cuidado da nossa equipa, assim como o pequeno gesto de boas-vindas com as iguarias regionais. 

Será um enorme prazer recebê-los novamente numa próxima oportunidade e esperamos que possam desfrutar mais uma vez do conforto, tranquilidade e beleza do nosso alojamento.

Melhores Cumprimentos,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Hélder
reviews.positive:
Tivemos uma excelente estadia. Fomos extremamente bem recebidos... à chegada tinhamos um cesto de boas vindas com produtos regionais...foi bastante simpático. O alojamento tem ótimas comodidades, limpeza e estava totalmente equipado com tudo o que precisávamos. A localização é excelente, perto de tudo: supermercados, shopping, restaurantes, paragem de autocarro e outros serviços. 
Apanhámos dias de bom tempo, o que nos permitiu desfrutar da piscina, que era muito bem cuidada e perfeita para relaxar, assim como o ginásio, que foi um ótimo complemento. O ambiente é bastante calmo e tranquilo. Apesar de haver outros hóspedes ao lado, não se ouvia qualquer ruído. Foi uma experiência muito positiva e, sem dúvida, voltaríamos a repetir.
reviews.response:
Dear Hélder,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and positive review. 
We are immensely happy to know that your stay at our accommodation exceeded your expectations. It is gratifying to know that you appreciated the welcome basket with regional products, as well as all the amenities of the accommodation, from the cleanliness and complete equipment to the pool and gym, which provided moments of relaxation and well-being.

We are also pleased that the location was convenient, allowing easy access to supermarkets, shopping, restaurants and transport, and that you enjoyed the calm and peaceful environment, even with other guests present.

It will be a pleasure to welcome you again for future stays, we eagerly await your return!

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.title: Top 👍 alles fein!
reviews.positive: Top 👍

reviews.author: Jiri

reviews.negative: Nothing, just the weather.

reviews.negative:

reviews.author: Rok
reviews.positive: Good location, cozy, new
reviews.negative: During my stay apparently the sewer got clogged & the bedroom & bathroom got flooded when it rained at night. The staff was helpful but unfortunately the situation was beyond salvageable :/ Hopefully the issue gets fixed because otherwise I had a great stay
reviews.response:
Dear Rok,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are pleased to know that you appreciated the location, comfort and overall condition of the property.

We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused by the drainage issue during your stay. We understand how disruptive this situation must have been, particularly as it affected both the bedroom and bathroom. Although our team attended the property and tried to resolve the matter as quickly as possible, we regret the inconvenience caused at the time.

We are happy to inform you that there have been no further issues, as the problem was fully resolved shortly afterwards.

We are nevertheless glad to know that, despite this inconvenience, you still had an enjoyable stay overall.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Shaibur
reviews.positive: Great facilities, location and the pool.

reviews.title: Great villa, highly recommended!
reviews.positive: Great villa, very clean and spacious, high quality equipment, we loved the inside and outside space. The view over the bay is superb.
reviews.negative: There wasn't anything we didn't like.

reviews.author: Gilberto
reviews.title: Le séjour c’est très bien passé, très agréable.
reviews.positive: La maison est bien situé dans un endroit calme elle est fonctionnelle, très bien équipé, propre et grande,la vue est magnifique.
reviews.negative: Personne ne nous a accueilli, c’est un peu dommage,et quelques difficultés avec l’utilisation de la télévision.

reviews.title: Ha van autód és keveset tartózkodsz a szálláson akkor jó
reviews.positive: Ha bírod a meleget, az utca zajt és a város közontjának távolságát akkor ez a te legmegfelelőbb szállásod . A saját parkoló a mosógép és a konyha felszereltsége kitűnő! A nappaliban lévő ágyról inkább nem szeretnék írni, ne akard kipróbálni. Két heti ott tartózkodásun ideje alatt a medence kb. 1 hétre le volt zárva, mert bezöldült a vize :(
reviews.negative: Autó nélkül nagyon messze van a központ , a boltok stb.

reviews.author: Karolina
reviews.title: Convenient, but check location on the map - power station next door
reviews.positive: It was located close to the Camara de Lobos town (about 10-15minutes walk), which was convenient for pedestrian use. Nice, good-enough equipped kitchen. Two bedrooms, one with very little light, comfortable for rest.
reviews.negative:
There is a power station next door that makes LOUD humming noise 24/7. Very much worth noticing.
There were roadworks on the way in, fairly difficult location to get to with a car. Certainly difficult for a driver that does not drive a manual transmission car (driver needs to back into a garage from a narrow slanted one-way street).
Additional town tax included that is not explained/included in the pricing. EUR2 per adult person per day. Another company is managing this property, so it adds a layer to communication...

reviews.author: Irina
reviews.positive:
The house is absolutely lovely and very well-equipped with everything needed for a week-long stay. The interior is beautiful and very comfortable.

​However, I feel it is important to mention for future guests that there is a factory nearby that operates 24/7. The noise is constant and quite loud, which makes it impossible to enjoy the balcony. More importantly, it was very difficult for me to fall asleep at night due to the noise, which significantly affected the quality of my rest.

​Overall, the house itself is great, but please consider the noise factor if you are a light sleeper or looking for absolute quiet."

reviews.author: Iwona
reviews.positive: Wszystkiego zagrało. Dominika zaopatrzony we wszystko, czego zapragniesz. Polecam.

reviews.author: Stefano
reviews.title: Perfetto soggiorno a Madeira
reviews.positive:
L'appartamento appare come nuovo, completamente accessoriato, luminoso, in grado di ospitare comodamente fino a 4 persone. La posizione è ideale per visitare l'isola e trovarsi al tempo stesso a pochi minuti da Funchal.
Le poche volte che abbiamo avuto bisogno di ricevere un supporto abbiamo trovato qualcuno in grado di fornire rapidamente la soluzione. Il parcheggio coperto privato è estremamente comodo e funzionale.
Se tornassi a Madeira, lo utilizzerei nuovamente.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We always try to make each stay as comfortable and easy as possible, so it is great to know that both the apartment and the support from our team met your expectations. Having a private parking space is also a real advantage when exploring Madeira by car. We would be very happy to welcome you back on another trip to the island.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday

reviews.author: Olena
reviews.positive: Good, clean and cosy apartment. Near apartment there are many restaurants to eat and to grab some coffee.
reviews.negative:
I was in March. It was cold in apartment. there was no air conditioner to heat it. 
It doesn’t have to be much ( to add a couple of coffee capsules for the coffee machine, washing powder for the washing machine, and dishwasher capsules )- just enough to get through the first 24 hours comfortably.
reviews.response:
Dear Olena.

Thank you for your feedback and for highlighting that the apartment was clean, comfortable, and well located.

As a self-catering apartment, we provide a starter set of essential amenities such as toilet paper, dishwasher soap, and other basic items to help guests settle in at the beginning of their stay. Additional supplies have to be then purchased according to each guest’s needs and preferences.

Regarding the temperature, we would like to note that as soon as you informed us that the apartment felt cold, we promptly provided a heater to ensure your comfort.

We appreciate your comments, as they help us continue improving the guest experience.

Best Regards, 
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Bogdan
reviews.title: Beautiful place in a great area
reviews.positive: I liked the location on the island, how big the apartment is, how well equipped it is, self check in with clear video instructions, parking garage, beautiful neighbourhood. We really enjoyed here rather than staying on Funchal where  traffic can get worse and parking is a big problem. From this stay, you are 15 min drive to Funchal centre and 10 min drive to airport.
reviews.negative: Communication with the host went really slow. Hope this will change in the future
reviews.response:
Hello Bogdan.

Thank you for your detailed feedback and for highlighting the apartment’s location, size, equipment, and the convenience of the self check-in process, as well as the garage and surrounding area. We are glad to hear you enjoyed staying outside Funchal and found the location practical.

Regarding your comment about communication, we would like to clarify that we consistently responded to your messages promptly, and at no point did our response time exceed one hour, as we always aim to respond as quickly as possible and, in your case, we replied within short timeframes throughout your stay. 

We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

Nice clean apartment

reviews.negative:

While windows open, very noisy from the street.

reviews.author: Orsolya
reviews.positive: It is in a lovely, sunny part of Madeira, with a great balcony. It was also useful to have a store and a nice bar on the ground floor of the building.
reviews.response:
Dear Orsolya,

Thank you very much for your excellent review and for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are very pleased to know that you enjoyed your stay. We are very happy that the balcony and the location contributed to making your stay even more enjoyable.

It was a pleasure to welcome you and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Michele
reviews.negative: Il parcheggio, non era ben definito e qualche volta ha creato conflitti con altri.
reviews.response:
Dear Guest,

Thank you very much for your review and for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are very pleased to know that you appreciated the cleanliness of the property and found your stay comfortable.

Regarding the parking, the check-in video clearly shows where the car should be parked. However, had you informed us during your stay that you were experiencing any difficulty or conflict regarding the parking space, we would have been more than happy to assist you and help resolve the situation.

Thank you again for your feedback. 
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.title: Great apartment, poor communication
reviews.positive:
The property is beautifully maintained in an excellent location. The view from the balcony is fantastic and we spent most evenings sitting out. There is a small infinity pool which was a bit of a trek through the garages but a nice bonus. 
The area around has many restaurants and close to the lidos for swimming. Short taxi/bolt ride into Funchal (download bolt as very reliable and much cheaper than the yellow taxis).
reviews.negative: Our experience with the booking and communication with the company was not good. We were asked to pay tourist tax separately through cash or iban which is not a booking.com policy. When I confirmed with booking.com and questioned the company I suddenly started getting lots of spam WhatsApp about the booking from random numbers asking for money which I was told to then ignore. The tax was sorted but overall a stressful experience despite the great apartment.
reviews.response:
Dear Kathryn.

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are pleased that the apartment itself provided such an enjoyable setting for your stay and that you were able to make the most of the surrounding area.

We would, however, like to clarify the points raised regarding the tourist tax and the messages received. The tourist tax is a mandatory local charge and is collected directly by the accommodation provider using the payment methods made available to guests. Its collection is therefore handled by us.

Regarding the WhatsApp messages requesting money, these were not sent by Atlantic Holiday and did not originate from any of our official contact numbers. As soon as you mentioned them, we advised you to disregard them precisely because they were not legitimate communications from our team.

We understand that receiving unsolicited messages can be unsettling, but we hope this clarification distinguishes them from our official communication and payment procedures. We are nevertheless glad that, despite this situation, you were able to enjoy the property and your time in Madeira.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Niels
reviews.title: Prachtige, rustige locatie met een zeer ruim en comfortabel appartement; helaas deed de gebrekkige communicatie flink af
reviews.positive: Locatie en staat van het appartement.
reviews.negative:
We hebben helaas een erg slechte ervaring gehad met de communicatie en de check-in.

Wij kwamen rond 16.00 uur aan en volgden de locatiegegevens die we hadden ontvangen. Hierdoor kwamen we aan de verkeerde kant van het complex terecht. Vervolgens hebben we geprobeerd telefonisch contact te krijgen met de beheerder, maar kregen we niemand te pakken.

Pas om 16.47 uur ontvingen we via WhatsApp een bericht met de vraag hoe ze ons konden helpen, omdat ze hadden gezien dat we geprobeerd hadden contact op te nemen. De daadwerkelijke check-ininformatie, met de juiste locatie, toegangscodes en instructievideo’s, ontvingen we vervolgens pas om 16.52 uur, terwijl we dus al bijna een uur bij het complex stonden. Deze informatie hadden we uiteraard vóór aankomst moeten ontvangen.

Daarna werd aangegeven dat iemand ons zou komen ontmoeten. Om 17.08 uur stonden we bij de juiste ingang en om 17.09 uur werd opnieuw aangegeven dat de medewerkers er “shortly” zouden zijn. Uiteindelijk konden we pas rond 17.30 uur daadwerkelijk het appartement in. Van aankomst tot toegang tot het appartement heeft het daarmee ongeveer anderhalf uur geduurd.

Bij de check-in werd ons verteld dat we het direct moesten aangeven als er iets ontbrak. De volgende ochtend om 09.16 uur hebben we daarom via WhatsApp gevraagd naar een vaatdoek, theedoek en eventueel wasmiddel. Omdat we geen reactie kregen, hebben we om 12.12 uur nogmaals gevraagd om een reactie.

Pas twee dagen later, op de ochtend van onze check-out, kregen we antwoord. De verklaring was dat de medewerker de afgelopen twee dagen vrij was geweest. Voor een organisatie die vakantieappartementen beheert, vinden wij het bijzonder dat vragen van gasten daardoor twee dagen onbeantwoord blijven.

Dat is extra jammer, omdat het appartement zelf absoluut veel pluspunten heeft. De locatie is erg mooi en het appartement is zeer ruim, netjes en comfortabel ingericht. Ondanks de ligging is het er bovendien heerlijk stil.
reviews.response:
Dear Niels.

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are pleased that, despite the difficulties mentioned, you enjoyed the apartment itself, its location and the peaceful surroundings.

We would, however, like to clarify a few points regarding the communication and check-in process. The full check-in instructions, including the access information and guidance for reaching the property, were sent several days before arrival. Once we became aware that you were having difficulty locating the correct entrance, a member of our team went to assist you in person as soon as possible. Based on our records, the assistance and access process did not take as long as described in the review.

Regarding the messages sent during the stay, we did not receive any communication from you through the booking platform, which is the channel we always ask guests to use for requests and stay-related matters so that the whole team can follow and respond accordingly. WhatsApp is mainly used to support telephone communication, and guests also have access at all times to our official contact number should they require more immediate assistance.

We are sorry that the communication did not feel as smooth as expected on this occasion. We take these situations seriously and will continue working to ensure that our communication procedures are as clear and efficient as possible for future guests.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Viktor
reviews.positive:
Magnificent place.
• The provided check-in instructions were very detailed and easy to follow.
• The hosts responded to messages quickly and helped us with all our requests.
• Convenient, spacious parking garage.
• Decent wifi (enough for video calls).
• Other reviews mention difficulties locating the gym an the pool, but luckily now the hosts provide video instructions that make everything clear.
• Always a nice touch to see some basic necessities like salt and dishwasher tablets provided in the kitchen.
reviews.negative:
• A single set of keys for 5 adults is not enough.
• In the beginning of our stay one of the toilets broke down (water wouldn't stop running). The maintenance team of the building came and just shut the water off, never actually fixing the problem. Surely they can do better in such a luxury apartment complex.
reviews.response:
Dear Viktor.

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that the instructions, communication and overall set-up of the property contributed positively to your stay.

Regarding the bathroom issue, we did our best to have it resolved as quickly as possible. As the building was newly completed, however, the repair ultimately required intervention from the developer responsible for the property, which limited what our maintenance team could do directly. We are very sorry that a permanent solution could not be completed before your departure.

As for the keys, had we known that one set was proving inconvenient for your group, we would have done our best to arrange an additional set where possible.

We appreciate both the positive comments and the points raised, as they help us continue improving the experience for future guests. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in Madeira.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.title: Elements of luxury in a beautiful apartment overlooking the sea.
reviews.positive: The property was well situated with a lovely view over the sea from the spacious main balcony. Every room opened onto a balcony. Access to the shared/quiet rooftop pool was a welcome bonus. Elements of Savoy was cleverly designed and filled with greenery.
reviews.negative: The beds were a little uncomfortable but possibly a preference rather than a negative. One of the toilets did not flush although an engineer did resolve this the day before we left.
reviews.response:
Dear Caroline.

We are pleased to know that you had an enjoyable stay and that the property offered a comfortable setting for your time in Madeira. The outdoor areas and the overall design of the residence certainly help create a pleasant atmosphere.

Regarding the beds, we understand that comfort can vary from person to person and appreciate you mentioning this. We are also sorry about the issue with the bathroom during your stay, but we are glad our technician was able to attend and resolve it.

Thank you for your feedback and for staying with us. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Mauro
reviews.positive: Mi è piaciuto la posizione dell'alloggio, la sua dotazione e l'abbinamento con un ampio garage doppio. Piccola ma bella la piscina condominiale con acqua riscaldata.
reviews.negative: Piuttosto complicato l'orientamento e lo spostamento a piedi all'interno del condominio con poche indicazioni utili sui vari piani e i diversi ingressi
reviews.response:
Dear Mauro.

Thank you for sharing your experience. We are pleased that the property provided a convenient and comfortable base for your time in Madeira.

We understand that navigating the building can feel a little confusing at first due to its layout. For this reason, we provide video instructions to help guests reach the different areas more easily, and our team is always available to assist with any directions or questions during the stay.

We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again in the future.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: An amazing holiday in Madeira, made special by staying in this apartment

reviews.negative: The gym and pool were a bit of an adventure getting to but it didn't affect our stay

We are very pleased to know that you had such an enjoyable stay and were able to make the most of the property and its surroundings.

We always provide clear video instructions to help guests find their way around the building and easily access the different facilities, including the pool and gym. We understand that the layout can take a little getting used to at first, and our team is always available to assist with any questions or directions guests may need during their stay.

We are glad this did not affect your overall experience, and it would be a pleasure to welcome you back for another stay in Madeira.

Kind regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Jchtenerife
reviews.title: Excellent stay. Great location. Responsive host.
reviews.positive: Great location, a minute from the beach. Easy walk to local shops, cafes and restaurants. Beds were very comfortable and the apartment has all the conveniences you could need.
reviews.negative: Only thing we missed is that we would have liked a balcony but that is a personal thing and not a criticism of the apartment itself. The location itself made up for that.

reviews.author: Beatriz
reviews.positive: L'apartament és confortable i està a tocar de la platja. La gestió i comunicació ha estat excepcional.

reviews.author: Oryna
reviews.positive: Все было хорошо

reviews.author: Daniela
reviews.title: Topp!
reviews.negative: Geschirrspüler roch ungenehm

reviews.author: Sidonia
reviews.title: You won’t have any regrets booking it
reviews.positive: It’s one of the best penthouses I’ve stayed in and I do travel a lot. Very big and spacious, amazing panoramic views over the Atlantic, every bedroom had an on suite bathroom, equipped kitchen and laundry room. Very friendly staff, very attentive to all our needs. Location is  amazing, out of the craziness of old town but still in Funchal, very easy drive to all the PRs and activities

reviews.author: Elisabeth
reviews.title: Un séjour exceptionnel dans un appartement idéalement situé, offrant une vue magnifique sur l’océan, où tout était réuni
reviews.positive:
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement, qui est parfaitement conforme à l’annonce. La vue sur l’océan est tout simplement exceptionnelle et offre un cadre idyllique.

L’appartement est très propre, parfaitement équipé et offre tout le confort nécessaire. Son emplacement est idéal : à deux pas de la plage, des commerces et des transports en commun, ce qui permet de tout faire facilement à pied.

Tout était réuni pour passer un séjour parfait. Nous recommandons cet appartement à 100 %

reviews.negative: Dojazd nie należy do najłatwiejszych, brak sklepu w poblizu

reviews.positive: Apartamento muito agradável em local sossegado e bem localizado
reviews.negative: A limpeza de uma forma geral estava bem feita no entanto havias certas zonas especificas como debaixo do sofa e atras do frigorífico que pareciam não serem limpas a algum tempo mas nada que afetasse as instalações e o seu uso.

reviews.positive:
Apartamento com uma ótima limpeza, muito bem localizado numa zona sossegada e perto de tudo. 
Foi uma ótima estadia para uns dias intensos a visitar a ilha e fazer praia.

Velké prostorné, výtah, vana, velká TV, po rozložení pohodlný gauč pro dítě.
Vlastní parkovací místo sice těsné, ale fabia se tam vešla viz. foto.
WiFi stabilní. Pračka se sušičkou.

Nepochopil jsem třídění odpadu nikde to není kam odnést.

reviews.author: Nataliia
reviews.title: Нам очень понравилось это место. Здесь уютно, комфортно и приятно отдыхать. Всё было чисто, продумано до мелочей, а атмо
reviews.positive: В апартаментах было всё необходимое для комфортного проживания: стиральная машина, фен и вся необходимая бытовая техника. Это очень удобно, так как всё было под рукой.
reviews.response:
Dear Nataliia,

Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We are very pleased that the apartment met your expectations and contributed to an enjoyable stay. It was a pleasure hosting you.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Błażej
reviews.title: Great apartment, location and the view!
reviews.positive: Apartment was fantastic! Our family (4 people) felt really good during the stay. Check-in process went without any problems, contact with the renting comapny was at the highest level. In the apartment there was everythning you can imagine to have at home, or even more. The only small thing which was not matching the highest level of the apartment itself was the connetion woth the pool area. To reach it, we had to go through underground garage - it was quite odd, I saw such connection for the first time :)

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.title: A perfect stay in a beautiful apartment with breathtaking sea views, an excellent location, and outs
reviews.positive:
We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was spotless, very well equipped with everything we needed, and offered an incredible sea view. The location is perfect, centrally situated on Madeira, making it easy to reach all parts of the island and its main attractions. The pool was an added bonus and a great place to relax after a day of exploring.

The communication and support from the host were excellent throughout our stay. They were always checking in, keeping us informed of any updates, and ensuring everything was going smoothly, which made us feel very well looked after.

I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Madeira and would happily stay here again.
reviews.negative: all was perfect.
reviews.response:
Dear Peter,

We sincerely appreciate your generous feedback. It is rewarding to know that both the accommodation and our team contributed to such a memorable time in Madeira. Your endorsement means a great deal to us, and we would be delighted to host you again.

Best Regards,
Atlantic Holiday.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: The apartment had plenty of space, a view of the sea and access to a great pool. The host is extremely helpful throughout the stay. Thank you!

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: God rolig beliggenhed uden trafikstøj og stadig i gå afstand til Forum Madeira, bus og taxa. Parkeringsplads i garage. Dejlig udsigt over park og til havet fra 7 etage. Man kan sidde 4 personer og spise på altanen. Pool hade liggestole og parasoller.  Køkken kunne være lidt bedre udstyret med større pande og flere tallerkner, men fungerede ellers fint. Super rent og super vært.

reviews.author: Marine
reviews.title: Stayed over a week
reviews.comment:
Par où commencer ??? 
Notre hôte Osanarah est une perle, un vrai cadeau ❤️🙏. Gentille, attentive, prévenante et très compréhensive. Elle nous a attendus jusque 22h30/23h avec un panier garni très apprécié par notre famille. Elle a pris le temps de tout nous expliquer et s'est montrée disponible lors de notre séjour. Encore mille mercis pour tout 🙏
Nous avons passé un séjour merveilleux dans cet appartement incroyablement entretenu et d'une propreté irréprochable. Il y a tout ce qu'il faut (même plus !) Les équipements sont de qualité : literie, serviettes de toilette, serviettes de plage, machine à laver, lave-vaisselle...
La place de parking en sous-sol est un réel plus. La piscine est agréable et correctement entretenue, il y a une douche et des WC à proximité.L'appartement est idéalement placé ! Au calme, dans une résidence de qualité. Vous avez des commerces et des restaurants juste à côté.Des promenades sont faciles d'accès aussi. Allez y  les yeux fermés ☀️☀️☀️

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.title: Stayed about a week
reviews.comment: Osanarah was a perfect host who we would highly recommend. She was flexible with check-in time and was there to greet us when we arrived The Apartment was beautifully maintained and spotlessly clean. The area where the apartment is has restaurants, bars and shopping and is convenient for travel into the centre if Funchal (€6 Bolt ride) if using taxis definitely download the Bolt App it gives you access to both normal taxis and Bolt cars with bolt being up to half price of normal taxis. We would highly recommend the apartment and Osanarah as a just. She is definitely worth the Super Hist title. We will be back

reviews.author: Juste
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment: It was a great spot for exploring the island, the appartment had everyhting we needed, was very tidy and clean. Osanarah was very friendly and helpful, would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Paulo
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Notre hôte a été très accueillante et flexible sur nos horaires d'arrivée.
L'appartement est très lumineux, propre, bien équipé, les photos sont fidèles à la réalité. L'appartement est également bien situé, plusieurs commerces à proximité ainsi que de bons restaurants. La mer est également assez proche. Je recommande cet appartement.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.title: Stayed a few nights
reviews.comment:
Great location, a short walk to a shopping center with a supermarket. It's a lovely spacious apartment with a well equipped kitchen. It also has a pool, which is nice for a quick dip after a long, hot day out exploring. 
Osanarah was lovely. She met us on arrival at the apartment to show us around. 
I would highly recommend this place.
Thank you once again for our lovely stay
